dkar chagadapar skrun gsal bshad/ phyosngon gleng / 911 1 sman rtsis bstan pa'i srog shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mong mkhyen rab chodar bu'i mdzad rjes rnam thar rjes su dran pa skal ldan 'tsho mdzad dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ 12 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i sku bcar bla sman bstan 'dzin chos grags mchog gi mdzad rnam snying bsdus dad blo'i so/da dkar rgyas pa'i zla gzhon/ 413 kun khyab bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod snying bsdus su brjod pa gtsug lag snang brnyan gas la ba'i me 'o/nga 614 nyes pa gsum gyi ldang dus skor la cung zad dpyad pa blo gsar rig sgo 'byed pa'i lde'u mig/ 875 mchog gi dang 1rware sangs rgyas dpal ldan dus 'khor rgyud kyi 'grel chen dri med 'od las bstan pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi mtshon dzaXl gleng ba/ ( 109snyo gso/ rig rgyud bzhi las mabashad phyi gsum gyi rgyud chog snga na gnad 'ga' zhig thad cung zad dpyad pa'i tshul gling ba be+eḍūr+ya ྅ na po'i bzhed dgongs 133

1 5 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig lhu gas bsdus bzhugs 11//7 rtsabashad phyi gsum gyi rgyud tshig snga na gnad 'ga' zhig thad cung zad dpyad pa'i tshul gleng ba be+eḍūr+ya sngon po'i bzhes dgongs zhes pa las rgyud tshig gi dpyad pa dasngo sa gsal ba'i re'u mig 1658 yobashad phyi gsum rgyud tshig thodan gnad 'ga' zhig la cung zad dpyad pa'i tshul gling ba baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i bzhed dgongs zhes par bskyar zhib zhus pa'i snyan lnga / 1999 bskyar zhib snyan tho'i lnga na gnad las 'a'o/sa pa'i zhu lan klu'i grangs su nges pa'i gsal sgod dogs sel rnyog ma drungs byin/ 20710 phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud kyi reg pa rtsa masnga las rtsa'i blta gnas las 'phros pa'i gtam lung rigs dpyad gsum dag pa'i rjes su 'jug pa blo gsar gachodan nu'i mdzes rgyan// 221

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ra༅/ /rang re bod mi rnams mi yul du gyar nas mi lo lnga bcu tham pa 'khor ba'i dus dran srung brtsi zhu slad bod kyi dpe mdzod khang la las 'char mang po zhig yod cing / de dag gi khongs su rig gzhung nyams zhib dang ro/da yig dpar skrun sde tshan nas da lam dmigs su bkar nas rgya che'i mang cenags kyi khe phan 11 nar bsams te dpe deb mi nyung ba zhig 'don 'char yod/ sman rtsis gnyis gar byang chub pa'i na galhaṭan snyu mkhapa 1/leg pa ba11da nams rin chen lags kyis so1 mang nyams zhib bgyis 'bras/ bod kyi sku la rgyun sman rtsis rig pa'i dpyad yig mu tig phreng mdzes stod cha dang / smad cha/ 'di ga bod kyi dpe mdzod khang la dpar skrun zhu slad 'bul 'thus byung bar/ 'di nas rtsom pa por bsngags brjod tshad med dang / 'di nyid 'byung 'gyur na gachodan gzhan rnams la yang mig dpe bzang lnga zhig tu 'gyur bar re/'di ga'i spyi khyab 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag sna ra mchodag gi lam stodan cadag 'byung 'gyur 'di nas dpar skrun rnams shākya thub pa'i deb phreng dang / skad yig deb phreng / nang chos deb phreng / rnam thar deb phreng / lo rgyus deb phreng / sna tshogs deb phreng bcas su 'char 'god bzhin dpar skrun zhu 'char yod cing / da lam gyi sman rtsis rig pa'i dpyad yig khag gnyis sna chodags deb phreng dang khrod dang gnyis pa'i nang du bkod yod /

51 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig 〈snags bsdus bzhugs sku //bzhugs sgar thodad kyi dpe mjo da khang ni/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mthodan chen po'i bla med kyi dathodangs gzhi las grub cing / phyi 'o/ 1971 nas da bar chos rig gi gsung rab ji snyed cig dpar du bskrun yod cing / nye ba'i char la mtshon na nang bstan gsung 'gyur gyi zab sbyong dang / tshan rig dang nang chos kyi 'brel ba'i steng nyams zhib dang bod 'gyur/ gsung chos 'dzin grwa 'phar ma/ bod rig pa'i zab phyu nga bcas ni las gzhi gsar gdodad kyi dpe mchopan tsam yin/ las gzhi de dag thams cad/ nga tsho'i 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag ྅ ra mchodag gi thad /ra gzigs thegeg casag las ro/na sgrub bzhin pa lags sku//bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi rig gzhung nyams zhib dang bod yig dpar skrun sde tshan nas 2009 zla 7 tshes 21 nyin/

༄7/ /sngon gleng /'tshesāstiḥ e legs kun khyab rtsis rig thabs kyi mkhar/ /waṃ yig bde gsal gasku rig thabs 'byung nyi/ /zung 'jug khyab bdag dge ba'i lam gyi gzhir/ /spro mdzad dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor los skyongs/ /zhes sman rtsis rig pa'i nges gsang gi 'byung gnas dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lor sgo gsum gus pas phyag mchod 'bul ba sngo na du song ste/ skabs su bod kyi sredal rgyun sman rtsis rig pa'i dpyad yig mu tig phreng mdzes zhes pa'i deb phreng 'di nyid par du bskrun pa'i sngon 'gro'i mtshams sbyor snying bsdus zhu ba la/de yang slob da1/na sangs rgyas gnyis pas/ cesas rnams thams cad sgrib pa med pa'i spyan/ /masnga rgyud yin pas tshad bzung dpang dze btubs/ /bstan bcadas rnams dang gang zag tshad mi bzung / /dpang wa mi btub kha 'dzin phyogs cha yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang cag kha ba'i ljongs su dar khyab byung ba'i sredal rgyun gso/ rtsis rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi maba'i sa wa na nam 'a'o/da gzhi ni/ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bus bstan pa'i mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa tshad ma gzhir byas pa'i thun min gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs zhig yin la/ ris med bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyis kyang yang dag rig lam gyi sgron me de nyid la bsten te dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bathodas rab dang rim pa bskrun gnang mdzad yodad pa de dag deng

57 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyo gas bsdus bzhugs so///gi dus su 'dzam gling skye 'gro'i lus sems kyi gdung ba sel ba'i sman masprosad kyi gter nyag cig tu 'gyur yodad la/ rang re ro/na gnyer mkhan gyi rnam dpo da rig stobs kyis 'jon phyin rig gzhung gi ma lag mdo rgyud rin wa che ni/ mdzad mtha' mi masngagan pa rgya mchod lta bu'i zab brlings dang ldan pa ji tsam 'jug kyang de tsam 'jug pa'i yul du gyur pa las 'jug yul thog dug med pa dang lhan/'jug don 'jug pa po yi rnam dpyod dang mthun pa'i 'jug 'bras shes bya'i gnas kyi dgos nor thob pa dang / ji tsam dpyad kyang de tsam dpyad pa'i yul du 'gyur pa las dpyad yul 'gal ldan du mi 'gyur ba dang lhan/ dpyad don dpyad pa po'i rnam dpyod dang mthun pa'i dpyad 'bras gang yang dri med sa le sbram dang 'dra ba/ ji tsam brtags kyang de tsam brtag bya'i yul du gyur pa las brtag yul cadag byed kyis brgal nus bral ba dang lhan/ brtag ro/na brtag pa wa'i rnam dpyod dang mthun pa'i zhi ba'i ro bcud brnyes pa mchog gi ro dang 'dra ba so/gas gang zag phal pa'i rnam dadrodad kyis dalnga ga par dka' ba'i zab gling gi khyad chodas ldan yodad/de lta'i 'byung khungs dang rig pa tshad dang ldan pa'i sku la rgyun rig pa'i gzhung lugs las skabs su bakhyodam ldan 'das sman bla be+eḍūr+ya codad kyi rgyal wa'i 'phrin las drang srong sman bla rigs lnga dang bathe ma ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'kho ra 'o/ dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs rigs ldan grags pa chen wa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul rigs ldan pad+ma dkar wa sku gas kyis legs par bstan cing / gangs lha ngas mkhas pa du ma'i snyan spyan gsum las brgyud pa'i gasku rtsis gzhung lugs gnyis dang / de las kyang gasku rtsis lugs gnyis 'bral med zung du cadab cing

sngon gleng / spelag len zung du 'jug pa'i sngar srol mkhas pa'i rnam thar las 'phros gso rtsis lugs gnyis kyi zab don la cung zad myangs pa'i mngar skyur gyi don gnad khag gcig yi ge'i lam du spel ba yin te/ ci phyir zhe na/ rang gi yid la dran gso bya phyir dang / /rang mnyam grogs la gros su 'debs phyir dang / /mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis byi dor 'ong phyir dang / /blo gsar 'ga' la phan du re phyir te//de rkyen yang dag srol rgyun rig gzhung 'di/ /don du gnyer yun bgrang bya bcu phrag nang / /de dang de yi zab lha na tshul bzhin du/ /lha gas par nus pa min yang bshes gnyen gyi/ /lam ston mdzub mos drangs dang dad rtson gyi/ /grogs la brten pa'i dbang gis rig pa 'di'i/ /'phrin las 'gyur med phan dang bde ba'i rgyur/ /mjal ba'i yid ches lhag tu thob phyir ro/ /de yang dus dang gnas skabs kyi 'gyur 'gros la blta sa pa med par rtag tu phan bde 'ba' zhig grub nus pa'i srol rgyun gasku rtsis rig pa'i 'phrin las la gzhan dang gzhan gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyis 'gran du med pa'i yid ches lhag par rnyed pa'i phyir ro//bcas pa'ang e pa bas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa glang rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs su sbyar ba'o//

sngon gleng / sgolag len zung du 'jug pa'i sngar srol mkhas pa'i rnam thar las 'phros gso rtsis lugs gnyis kyi zab don la cung zad myangs pa'i mngar sgyur gyi don gnad khag gcig yi ge'i lam du spel ba yin te/ ci phyir zhe na/ rang gi yid la dran gso bya phyir dang / /rang mnyam grogs la gros su 'debs phyir dang / /mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis byi dor 'ong phyir dang / /blo gsar 'ga' la phan du re phyir te//de rkyen yang dag srol rgyun rig gzhung 'di/ /don du gnyer yun bgrang bya bcu phrag nang / /de dang de yi zab don tshul bzhin du/ /rtogs par nus pa min yang bshes gnyen gyi/ /lam ston mdzub mos drangs dang dad rtson gyi/ /grogs la brten pa'i dbang gis rig pa 'di'i/ /'phrin las 'gyur med phan dang bde ba'i rgyur/ /mjal ba'i yid ches lhag tu thob phyir ro/ /de yang dus dang gnas skabs kyi 'gyur 'gros la blta sa pa med par rtag tu phan bde 'ba' zhig grub nus pa'i 10la rgyun gasku rtsis rig pa'i 'phrin las la gzhan dang gzhan gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyis 'gran du med pa'i yid ches lhag par rnyed pa'i phyir ro//bcas pa'ang e pa bas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa glang rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs su sbyar ba'o//

༄༅༅/ /sman rtsis bstan pa'i srog shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen snu mkhyen rab chodar bu'i mdzad rjes rnam thar rjes su dran pa skal ldan 'tsho mdzad dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs sku //ra༅༅/ /'asgo ā thaḥ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i ye shes lha lam na/ /'acad ba'i dug gsum nad mun sel ba'i gnyen/ /be+eḍūr+ya codad mtshan rab 'bar nyin byed dbang / /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma rgyal gyur cig /de bzhin rgyal bstan cadags bral mkha' dbyings na/ /thub bstan sku ngas sngo gas khyab bdag dus 'khor lo'i//'phrin las 'gro ba'i blang jo ra kun gsal nyi/ /gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo 'dir snying nas dad/ /gang de'i 'phrin las 'jug sgo yangs pa'i mkha'/ /sprul pa'i sdudas gar gza' skar phreng ba bzhin/ /srid 'dir sman rtsis snang ba'i dpal ster ba'i//brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen sku ngas la phyag bgyicod/ /blang dodar gnad dang mi 'jigs 1—ga sbyin gyi/ /sman rtsis bstan pa'i gsal byed dge pa'i bshes// mkhyen rab thogs med yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog /gang de'i mdzad rjes rnam thar thung ngu gleng / /de yang bdag gis thol byung brjod min dam pa gang gi zhal rlangs drod ldan yin/ /smra 'dod lce yi zlos gar ngom min yun ring bkur zhing mchod pa'i bgo skal yin/ /'asngo/da cadags brgyud pa'i che ba tsam min byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa mcho na phyir yin/ /rnam thar bcadad pa'i lha bas pas khengs min gzhan

/ lha na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig dre gas bsdus bzhugs sku //gyis bskul ba'i lcags kyus drangs pas yin// zhes masnu da par bcadad pa dang brtsam par bya ba'i rkyen dam bca' dang bcas pa spyodan du btang ste skabs su gleng bar bya ba ni bdag cag kha ba'i ljo ngas kyi sman rtsis bstan par bka' drin bla na sda mchis pa'i bshes gnyen 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen wa'i sku bcar sman pa mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar rjes su dran pa skal ldan 'tsho mdzad dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba rang gis yun ring mchod pa'i bgo skal du thob pa dam nga gang gis snga rjes su bstsal ba'i mdzad spyod bka' slob/ de bzhin rang gi dad blo'i bzhin sdod du 'char ba'i dam pa'i gshis spyod dang bka' drin chen pos mdzad 'phrin bskyangs tshul bcas gleng ba la'ang /dang wa / rigs rus gang las 'khrungs pa/ gnyis pa/ sman rtsis rig gzhung la sprodas bsam mdzad tshul/ gsum pa/ 'alha ba'i dodan du sku ga skyodab sman gyi rig pa dang / blang dor 'byed pa'i rtsis rig gis yid drangs te nyams len dang gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa bskyangs tshul dang / skabs skabs su gsang ba'i rnam thar dam pa gang gi zhal las dngos su gsungs pa thar thor dag mcher bzung nas bkod pa/ bzhi pa/ gdul bya spyi'i snang sngo ra dathodangs pa gzhan ro/na du gshegs tshul dang gsang ba zhal chems lugs su byang cadags sham bha lar gshegs tshul te rgyas bsdus rang gi dran dbang du bcol ba'i rig ngor ji ltar gsal ba bzhin dgod par bya ba la/ de la 'dir thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo 'di nyid dus ji tsam la rigs rus gang zhig las gnas gang du 'khrungs sam snyam na/ dam pa 'di nyid yul dze da kyi 'acad ba mi lnga ga mar chags pa'i gnas/ 'o/ rgyus spyi la grags pa rtsed

ske bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 3thang zo dang gong po ri'i nub cadas/ yar klung shel bo brag gi zhabs pad du chags pa'i bya sa lha khang gi nye 'dabs bya sa cosag ma zhes par yab gtsug lag rtsis rig smra ba krang macad leb dang / yum bud med kyi yon tan kun dang ldan pa dbyangs can gnyis rang bzhin gyis mdza' bar thugs sras che chung gnyis 'khrungs pa las che ba mkhyen rab dbang phyug ni chung ngu'i dus nas rab tu byung ste gdan sa chen 1— 'bras spungs dgon du slob gnyer la zhugs/ dam pa 'di nyid bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu lug (ye lo 1883)(1)rjodan zla'i rdzogs pa gsum par 'khrungs shing / gang gi skyed byed 'di ni yul du grags che ba'i bla mkhyen (rtsis pa )rnga bo che zhes blang 1—ra rten 'brel gyi rtsis la snu/sa pa zhig yin stabs 〈snang gis thugs sras 'khrungs par skye dus gza' skar gyi rtsis brtag pas skye dus zla skar spyi bor so/nga / de yang /kun gzigs dbyangs 'char ba'i rgyud las/ /skyes rtags skar ma spyi sngo ra sku nga //rgyal cadar 'gyur ba the mārgam med/(2) /ces bstan pa bzhin rang gi thugs sras 'di ma 'ongs par rang gzhan gnyis kyi ro/na byed nus pa'i skyes bu rang ga ba zhig ma yin pa'i masngo na mkhyen 11ba pas thugs gtsigs chen 1/sa gces par bskyangs pa'ang /chung dus yarba dam pa grong gang du rtsis dpyad dang zhabs rim la phebs rung / kho bo mnyam du khrid gnang gi sku da pa de dus ha cang skyid dze tshor gyi sku da/ ces dam pa gang gis zhal las yang yang gsungs gnang ba las ཿthogs sku / /sku nar son pa dang yab kyi thugs 'dod bzhin lto kha rtsed thang lnga mchod grwa tshang du rab byung bsgrubs te snu sa zhugs cadab gnyer mdzad/ grwa sar bzhugs ring stsodab gnyer thad gzhan las mkhyen daX/da kyi rtsal che la/ snying rje dang gzhan phan gyi gshis spyod ni kun smon pa'i yul du gyur/ sku na chung ngu'i dus 'dir shing 'bras kham

/ e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//bur ha cang mnyes sngo sku da la/ lhag par dbyar dus grwa tshang nang gi gzim shag che ba'i chu len pa gnang ba'i skabs cad ru'i nang gi kham bu smin pa dag gzigs dus mchod 'dod kyis zhal la mchil ma yang yang sngo sku/nga gi sku/da/ ces dang / phyis su bar klu sgug gzim shag g.yas g.yon du kham bu'i sdong po mang po ched 'dzugs gnang ba'ang sku na chung dus kyi bag chags yin par gsungs/de nas ring por ma thogs par sngon sbyangs las smon bzang wa'i mthu las mkhyen rab nor bu mchog grwa rgyun du lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling du sman pa slob par grwa gzhon mang wa'i dbus nas bdams gses byung / skabs der lcags ri rig byed 'gro phan gling gi mtshan thos ma nyid du rig byed 'gro phan gling de'i phyi nang gi bkod pa mtha' dag thugs la gsal ler 'char zhing/ deng nas bzung 'bo ba nad pa rnams kyi don du sman pa rjodang rgyu las lhag pa zhig mi 'dug snyam pa dang / gasku/ rig sbyong 'dod kyi thugs bskyed bcos ma ma yin pa thugs la 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum tsam la dngos su rdzo kha lnga mchod grwa tshang las thon te lha sa lcags po rir slob gnyer du phebs/ yul nas thon nyin yum gyis sa thag ring po'i bar skyel ma gnang la ma bu gnyis po bral mi phod pa'i brtse ba dang dam pa 'di nyid sku na chung bas yum la thugs pham gyis lan 'ga' phyir so/ga gnang dbo/sa byung / de skabs dgung mnyam gyi chos grogs shig kyang dga' ldan du slob gnyer la phebs pa lhan du lha da dkar la brgal te lha sar bgrod pa'i lam du zhugs/ khong gnyis dga' ldan dang lha sar 'gro sa'i lam kha las zhal gyes skabs dam pa 'dis ku rtsed kyi tshul du ngas lcags po rir sman pa bslabs te 7rgyal ba'i bla sman pa zhu thub pa bya rgyu dang /khyed kyis dga' ldan du slob gnyer yag po gnang ste rjes su dga' ldan khri pa gnang

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 5thub pa yin dā/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phyis su khong dga' ldan khri pa dang nga rang bla sman pa byed thub pa byung zhes gsungs pa ni rten 'brel gyi gnas mkhyen pa'i dam pa'i rang gshis sngag mtshar ba zhig lha / /lha sar phebs pa'i thog mar lcags po ri mjal skabs lcags po ri'i phyi nang bkod pa rnams de snga thugs su 'khrungs pa ji bzhin 'khrul med du gzigs pas lcags po rir phebs myong zhig 'dug snyam pa'i sngon goms las smon gyi bag chags bzang wa'i thugs nyams sad/ lcags po rir slob zhugs gnang rjes lcags po ri'i rgyun srol bzhin thog mar lcags po ri'i gzhon khral gyi phyag las gnang ba dang sbrags lcags ri'i sman pa se ra sman sbyin pa ngag dbang chos ldan gyi zhabs la gtugs nas sman gzhung gsan sbyong gi dbu tshugs/ dam pa 'di nyid gasdud rig gi gzhung dang gso rig smra ba'i skyes bu la dad pa'i blo bcos ma min pa ni de'i skabs lcags po rir sman gzhung thon pa'i gral las grags che ba rgan skal bzang legs bshad yin pas khong gi chab gsang gnang ba'i shul la'ang gang byung du mi 'gom par rgyud gsum thon pa'i skyes bu'i chab gsang yin zhes mcher gnang / phyag dpe blo 'dzin thad snga dgong gnyis su chu len pa dang me 'bud pa'i zhor du'ang dpe cha thugs 'dzin gyis dus tshod chud zos su ye mi gtong / lhag par na bza' gsol chas sogs la legs 'dod mi mdzad par grwa rkyang bya btang ba'i tshul kho na bzung ba yin/ na bza' sku gzan hrul po dag la lhan pa'i tshab tu mdud pa mang po 'bor bar mdzad pas slob ma cho sa lnga mchod brgya mdud pa zhes mtshan 'dogs kyang zhus yod/ de ltar ga'o/na khral gyi phyag las gnang ba'i lo gnyis lhag gi dus yun nang lha/gas snga langs dang / dgong 'phyi nyal gyis dpe cha blo 'odzin thad brtson 'grus drag po gnang

( e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//mthar dus yun thung ngu zhig nang sman gzhung dang grwa tshang gi tshogs 'don chos spyod cha lag dang bcas pa bde blag ngang rgyugs 'bul gnang thub pa byung / lcags ri grwa tshang gi 'ake+on chos blo 'dzin thon rjes grwa shag zur du gnang srol yod pa bzhin dam pa 'di nyid kyang gon lags kyis gnang ba'i ja rtsam gasku la mar gyi skal ba rnams dang / de snga yum gyis gnang ba'i thog sgrom (3)zhig yod pa bsnams te grwa shag zur bzhugs kyis mu mthud dpe cha thugs 'dzin hur thag gnang / 'on te de skabs lcags ri grwa tshang du sman dpe thugs 'dod khengs pa zhig khrid mkhan ma byung stabs/thugs dbo/ngas su bla sman pa bkras khang byams pa thub dbang mtshan snyan che la gso rig gzhung bshad la mkhas pas ci nas kyang khong gi sku gam du bcar snyam pa'i thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' brtan po thugs la 'god par mdzad/ de yang / lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu las/ dam pa khas 'che mang po mi byed cing / /gal te dka' ba'i khas ni blangs gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa ji bzhin du/ /shi yang gzhan du 'dor bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin yid kyi dam bca' bsu ba'i ched bla sman pa spyi khyab bkras khang byams pa thub dbang gi sku gam du bcar te rang nyid gso rig la sbyang bar 'dod pa'i blo bskyed tshul dang / da lta 'dir sman gzhung thad gzhung bshad gnad smin gyi lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis phongs pas bla sman pa gang gi sku gam du bcar tshul sku/gas zhib cha snyan du gsol la mgon po gang gi thugs rjes 'dzin par yang yang bskul/ der bla sman pa bkras khang byams pa thub dbang nyid dgyes tshor chen pos mkhyen rab nor bur dpe cha slob khrid gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba smos ci/ de skabs khong sku ngo mas mkhyen rab nor bur rten 'brel gyi mjal dar bsgron cing / 'e gas gsol la ma rngan pa/'i tshul du gsol

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 7gsol lam rngan pa'i tshul du gsol mar gdar gcig kyang gnang ste phyi nyin nas bzung dus tshod 'di 'dra zhig gi thog sman dpe bka' khrid gsan par yong na chog ces pa'i gsung gi gru char bsil mas yun ring shes bya'i skom pas mnar ba'i dam pa'i thugs kyi zhing sa chen por dal gyis dbab par mdzad the / /de nas bzung dam pa 'dis sku'i bla sman pa bkras khang byams pa thub dbang mchog gi zhabs la 'bral med gtugs te rig gzhung spyi dang yang sgos gso rin/ rgyud bzhir thos bsam dang 'brel dogs gnad kyi dra ba ji yod ji bzhin gcod par mdzad/ bla sman pa sku nyid 7rgyal ba'i sman pa gnang rgyu sogs mdzad brel shin tu che yang / mkhyen rab nor bur dpe khrid gnang rgyu gal cher dgongs la slob bu 'dis ma 'ongs par 'gro don gang legs byed nus pa'i yid ches blos 'khel yang gnang bzhin sku/da/lcags ri dgon gyi sgrig srol bzhin dpe cha thon rjes bar klu sbug tu zla drug ring jo khang sku gnyer res mos gnang dgos pa bzhin/ mkhyen rab nor bu mchog la yang res mos 'khel bas slob ma spyi ltar snga dgong gnyis sku mdun du sman gyi dpe khrid gsan par chag med phebs bzhin yod/ de'i skabs rta mgrin brag phyag tu bzhugs pa'i bla ma tsa ri cig car gdung 'dzin dgong dro jo khang gnas gzigs la yang yang phebs kyi yod pas/ thengs shig mkhyen rab nor bu mchog sman dpe gzigs pa dang skabs 'khel bar thugs brtse ba chen sngo/sa sman gzhung dpe cha gzigs kyi sku da min bka' 'dri gnang bar ma zad/ sman gzhung 'di gzhung gzhan dang mi 'dra bas gal te sum rtags dang snyan ngag sogs rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi yag po med na sman gzhung bltas kyang brda 'phrod dka' bas thor mar rig gnas kyi rmang

: e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//gzhi yag po yong ched sum rtags sogs la sbyangs pa byed dgos pa'i slob ston gnang bar thugs bskyed rlabs po che 'khrungs/ bla ma'i sku mdun nas rig gnas sbyong ba'i 'gog med kyi 'dun pas thugs kyi 'dod don snyan du gsol ba ji bzhin bla mas sum rtags slob khrid gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob/de la bla ma'i bka' bzhin nyin shas rjes nye gnas shig mkhyen rab nor bu 'bod du byung bas gang mgyogs rta mgrin brag phug tu bla ma mjal bar bcar skabs der bla ma bzhugs gdan 'bol nyis brtsegs ma zhig gi steng du dkyil krung du bzhugs la/ mdun gyi gsol lcog steng zho blugs shel dam gcig dang zhal dkar dmar khra cha gcig gra sgrig gis phebs sgug gnang yod/ de rjes bla ma'i kha sprod du 'bol gdan gcig bting 'dug pa de steng mkhyen rab nor bu 'dug dgos gsungs te bla slob kha sprod kyi tshul du bzhugs/ bla ma mchog nas thog mar kha stong par dpe khrid mi legs pas/ gasku la zho re mchod gsungs te/ chod blugs zhal dkar cig shos de mkhyen rab nor bur gnang ste rig gnas la sbyang ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad ma 'phyug par mdzad/ de skabs gsol zho phran tsam bzhes 'phror lus yod pa lhag bzhag na mi rung ba'i rten 'brel gsungs pas lhag lus med par mchod rjes sum rtags dpe khrid kyi dbu tshugs/ de yang bla ma tshul bzhin mnyes pa'i bkur stis brda sprod rig gnas kun gyi rmang gzhi sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa/ de bzhin dag yig mngon brjod/ snyan ngag la sogs pa brda sprod rig gzhung dang / khyad par dus 'khor skar rtsis lugs kyi zhag gsum rnam dbye stong 'jug bcas par chodas bsam gyis brtson pa la 'jug pa'i mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la mngon du phyogs par mdzad/ bod kyi thun min thun mong gi rig gnas spyi dang lhag par sman rtsis

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 9rig par bka' drin gzhal du med pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen snu/ mkhyen rab cadar bu mchog zhal 'tsho bzhugs skabs rgyun du sman rtsis don gnyer can gyi slob ma tshor thun mong brda sprod rig gnas slob khrid gnang rgyu phan chad gal cher brtsoganang gi yod/lhag par slob ma tshor rig gnas gang zhig yin rung mthong chung byed mi nyan pa'i bka' slob nan 1/ gnang ba dang sbrags sku nyid lnga ga mar rig gnas gsan sbyong gnang skabs dngos su byung ba'i myong byang gi mdzad spyod thung thung 'di bka' slob kyi tshul du yang yang gsungs gnang gi yod/ de yang / dam pa 'dis bla ma'i drung du brda sprod rig gnas sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa la thog mar slob sbyong gnang ba'i skabs bla ma'i thugs la dper brjod mnyam 'jog gnang thub na legs dgongs te/ yi ge yag po 'bri shes kyi yod med bka' 'dri gnang / de'i tshe sku nyid kyi dgongs par yi ge 'bri ba las sla snyam pa'i sla bcos kyi dbonangs tshul zhig thugs la shar ba'i rkyen byas/ yi ge 'bri ma shes/ 'on te yi ge 'bri bar mi dka' ste lha ris bzhin mig bltas nas 'bri na cesag zhus par/ bla ma thun/sa pham chen sngo/ gnang bzhin dutsog kha da byas na 'grig ma song / khyed kyis dbyangs can lha mo'i chod 'phrog zin song / yag po yong gi ma red ces gsungs/ phyis su sku nyid rig gnas smra ba'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang du son rung / yi ge 'bri skabs yig gzugs legs po zhig rtsab nas yong gi med/ ces gang nyid yig gzugs legs po med pa'i rgyu mtshan yang thog mar rig gnas sbyong ba'i rten 'brel 'phyug pa'i nyes par gsungs shing rgyun du rig gnas che chung gang la'ang mthong chung sla ba3)sa bya mi nyan pa'i bslab bya yang du gnang gi sku/da/de ltar bla ma'i sku gam nas rig gnas la thos bsam gnang rgi yod tshul bla sman pa bkras khang byams pa thub dbang gi snyan du ga1/la bar bla sman pa'i bsngags brjod

10 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//thob pa smos ci/ lhag par sman dang rtsis gnyis kyi 'brel ba ni kha bral thabs med pas nges par rtsis la sbyong dgos pa'i bka' slob nan che phebs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo bla sman pa bkras khang byams pa thub dbang gi bka' slob bzhin spyir bod kyi thun mong gi rig gnas bar gyi 'brel ba dang / yang sgos sman rtsis gnyis kyi 'brel ba ni de bas kyang kha bral thabs med pa'i gnad dka' dag rtogs la rtsis rig skar nag dbyangs gsum gyi ngo mtshar che bas thugs yid dbang med du 'phrog pas de nas bzung 'tsho byed slob dpon rgan do snga rgyal mtshan lags gtsug lag rtsis kyi slob dpon du bkur te gtsug lag rtsis la gsan sbyong sngar lhag gnang /skabs der nyin ltar slob dpon gsum gyi drung du res mos phebs te bka' khrid ma chag par gsan rgyu mtha' 'aX ngas gnang zhing / chodab khrid zhus pa rnams thugs nges ma byung tshe nyin gung bag leb gzigs nas zhol rdo ring 'khris la yud tsam bzhugs te sku ngal gso ba'i tshul mdzad pa yin/ lhag par chodab dpon gsum gyi drung du rgyugs sprod yag po zhu thub dus lha sar spyi mda'i za khang zhes par phebs nas spro gseng bi tshul mdzad par ma zad/ zhal lag mchod pa'i bar du'ang phyag dpe gzigs rgyur dbu 'khor te gsol ja mchod rgyu sogs brjed de sbyin bdag gis kho nga gcig pur gsol chas za khang gi thog khar 'dren pa'ang gnang gi yod/nyin par slob khrid gnang ba rnams thugs la nges shes yag po zhig ma 'drongs bar sku gzim mi gnang bar 'phri por dpe cha gzigs pa'am rtsis kyi sa ris bskyon te bzhugs gnang ba sogs sman rtsis rig gnas la thos bas ma rgya cher gnang bas ring por mi thogs par mkhyen dpyod kyi rtsal thon pa byung / lhag par spyi khyab mkhan po bkras khang byams pa thub dbang gi drung nas dpal ldan rgyud bzhi dang / rgyud

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 11'grel be+eḍūr+ya sngon po/ lhan thabs dang mes wa'i zhal lung la sogs pa'i sman gzhung mang wa'i khrid lung man ngag lag len dang bcas par sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa gnang bar ma zad/ lnga rig dbang po 'tsho byed rdo rje rgyal mtshan las skar rtsis dang nag rtsis dbyangs 'char sogs rtsis gzhung dang le tho rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi sbyor ba'i cha lag ma tshang ba med par gsan sbyong gnang / khyad par 'tsho byed rdo rje rgyal mtshan yer par bzhugs dus sungang zhabs thang gis sdudan te 'bri lugs sman nag 'khrul 'khe ra chen morware gsang sman man ngag skor gsan bzhes mdzad pa dang /7skyabs rje dharma seṅge'i slob ma grub dbang 'jigs med 'phrin las kyi drung nas g.yu thog snying thig gi chos skor dbang lung dang gso rig rgyud bzhi'i lung rdzogs par gsan/dgung grangs nyi shu mgrangs la phebs skabs lha sa smon lam du thengs dang wa'i sman sbyin du sman pa rgan gras 'ga' dang lhan du phebs/ de skabs lha sa spyodan lam chen snu ra dge 'dun pa mang sngo/ zhig tshad rims nad kyis zin par dam pa 'dis rang nyid kyi thugs rig rtsal las thon pa'i nad bathodas kyi khyodang ba lag tu blangs gnang mdzad pas nyam thag nad pa du mar dmigs su thon pa'i phan bskyed byung / deng 'dir dam pa 'di'i mkhyen sku/na dang rnam rig de bzhin thun snu/nga ma yin pa'i gzhan phan rlabs chen gyi mdzad spyod dag rim pas 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen wa'i snyan du gasku la bzhin pa red/de rjes dgung 'o/ nyer dgu lcags phag (ye 'o/ 1911)'o/ra 'bras spungs dathodan gyi sman sbyin pa'i thugs 'gan bzhes te yang bskyar sman sbyin du phebs par mdzad 'phrin sngar bas rgyas par 'gyur/ 'bras spungs sman sbyin gyi las thog mtshan

12 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sku //bzhes pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa 'dis le tho dang sman dpe/ dpal ldan rtsaba'i rgyud kyi sdong 'grems gso rig rgya mtsho'i snying po/ gso ba rig pa'i rgyud las bshad pa'i lus thig zla ba nor bu'i me long / byis pa btsa' thabs kun phan zla ba'i me long bcas ce ma sgrig gnang bar ma zad/ gasku rtsis rig pa'i gzhung lugs la zab 'jug gnang ba'i dbu tshugs/dper na/ gso ba rig pa nas bshad pa'i lus thig zla ba nor bu'i me long gi mjug don nang / de sngon rab tshes lcags khyi (ye lo 1910)lor rang nyid bgrang bya nyer dgu pa dpal ldan 'bras spungs sman sbyin las jo ga gi ming 'dzin skabs rtsed thang khang tshan ma'i lho rgyud nang gi sman grong gnyis par rgyud pi sngon dang bris cha sku gas sgo du mar zla gnyis tsam ring zhib stodag nan tan gyis lag len du thebs par byas te 'ga' zhig sar rgyud tshig gsar len gyi mchan dang / mchan bu/ rgya skag gis legs par btab ste slob dpon bka' drin zla med rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhal snga la'ang gzigs zhib phul bas dgyes 〉rgar chen 14sa bka' 1/ba balcal rigs kyang mnos te bajo sa bsgyur gdeng 'khel byas shing zhes pa dang / lhag par dpal ldan rtsaba'i rgyud kyi sdong 'grems gso rig rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes pa legs par brtsams grub pa'i rjes gzim shag sge'u khung gi steng 'jo ga gnang bar/ nyin zhig slo bur du rlung bus ded de sdong 'grems gyi phyag dpe tshang ma grwa gling gi phyogs mtshams kun tu brdal/ de rjes gzim shag g.yas gasku/na dang gdan sa'i dge 'dun pa rnams la bka' rtsad gnang bas bdun gcig nang phyag dpe chad lhag med par phyag sku na byung ba 'dis ma cadangs 'acad dodan rgya cher nus pa'i rten 'brel lta bu byung gsungs/

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 13gzhan yang / sngo sman 'khrungs dpe gser gyi snye ma 'di nyid legs par brtsams grub zin rjes rab gsal mdun gyi thog yangs su ri mthor skye ba'i sman/ sro lo dkar po dang / hong len/ tsher sngon/ srad sngon/ sum tig klu sman srad nagamakhan dkar/ bdud rtsi zil pa mo gas khyon sman sna so/ bdun skor gsar du 'khrungs/(4) de lta bu'i rtags rten gyi la nye ngo mtshar can gyis phyis su me 'brug (ye lo 1916)lo nas bzung chodas ldan rgyal khab chen pos mnga' ris kyi bde rtsar sman rtsis la bdag rkyen tshad med kyis chodab grwa btsugs nas dngos chodab yang slob sum brgya sko ra la nye bar 'chad spel 'phel rgyas kyis bstan rgyun la cung zad sman sku nga ba'i dge mtshan du masngo na/ zhes dam pa 'dis rab rgyal sa skyodang (ye lo 1945)gnam 'o'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes la ce ma sgrig gnang ba'i lus thig zla ba nor bu'i do shal du gsungs pa las kyang rtogs nus so/ /mkhyen rab thegar bu macodag 'bras spungs sman sbyin pa'i phyag las gnang ba'i 'o/ der 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos 'bras ljongs su 'bras ljongs rgyal sras kyi snyun gzhi gzigs par chibs zhabs sman pa'i tshul du bskyotshod dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba bzhin 'bras ljo ngas su chibs zhal bsgyur/ de la dam pa 'dis thog mar gzim shag 'gag tu ma phebs khyodan 'bras sgyu ngas rgyal cad dang zhal mjal sku/nga min dbyangs 'char gza' bdun ma'i rtsis shig balha na par rgyal sras macesag zhal mi mjal bar masngaran pas 7rgyal ba rin 1/ cher rgyal sras ched sman bathodas su phebs rung zhal mjal rgyu mi yong ba'i slor snyan du gsol bar 7rgyal ba rin po ches zhal mjal min la ma lta sa par lam seng phebs dbo/sa pa'i bka' bstsal gnang /'on te 'bras ljongs su phebs 'byor ma zin pa'i sngon sna dkar rtse sa char phebs

11 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//pa'i nyin der/ 'bras cadangs nas rgyal sras 'das bo ngas zin pa'i gnas tshul tar lan brgyud thad /ra chibs zhabs sman par 'byor yod pa red/ der mkhyen rab nor bu mchog nas rgyal sras 'das grongs zin pa'i gnas tshul dang da lta sku nyid kyi phyag las gnang ༷/gas thad bla sman pa bkras khang byams pa thub dbang mchog la tar 'phrin rgyud bka' dri gnang bar de skabs bla sman pa mchodag nas byis pa gasku/ tshul gyi lag len dang byis pa gso tshul thad rang re'i spyi tshogs nang ma 'dang ba'i nyes skyon ji yod bka' slob gnang bar ma zad/ mkhyen rab nor bu mchog de gar phebs pa dang stabs bstun nas gzhi rtse'i mi dmangs la byis pa nyer spyod kyi skor slob ston gnang dbo sa pa'i gzhung 'brel bka' phebs gnang bas stu na zla ba drug ring gzhis ka rtser byis pa nyer spyod kyi 'gro don bskyangs par dge mtshan chen po byung / chu glang (ye lo 1913)lor bshad sgra blon chen sem la'i chings yig don du rgya gar la phebs skabs dam pa gang nyid sku bcar sman zhur byon zhing / dbyin ji dang / rgya gar sogs phyi rgyal gyi nad pa gso dka'i rigs 'ga' zhig la sman bathe sa kyis bde blag tu gso bar mdzad pa dang / lhag par phyi rgyal sman pa 'gas snying gi nad gzhi dang lus sems 'brel ba'i skor la bka' 'dri gnang bar rgyu rkyen yul dus rang bzhin na tshod sogs dang sems sems byung gi rnam gzhag chodag nas gzhung bshad thugs tshims kyi bka' lan gnang bar ngo mtshar gyis bsngags brjod dang sku par bsgron pa/ dngos skyes 'bul ba sogs zang zing bkur bsti dang gso rig mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan gyi ba dan rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du g.yo bar mdzad de slar gangs ljongs kha ba'i yul du chibs zhal bsgyur/

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 15bod rab byung bco lnga me 'brug (ye lo 1916)lor bod dbus gzhung gi 'char gzhi bzhin lha sa bstan rgyas gling gi sa kho ngas gdo/ra rgyag gling gar gzhi khyon che ba'i dbyin ji'i slob grwa zhig 'dzugs 'char gyis 7rgyal ba rin sngo cher snyan seng zhus kyang de don bka' 'khrol ma byung / de rjes 7sku'i bla sman bkras khang spyi mkhan byams pa thub dbang mchodag nas sngar gyi sa der sman rtsis 'phrod bsten khang chung chung zhig 'dzugs 'char sku/da skor 7bo nga sa mchog la snyan du gsol/7rgyal mchodag sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mchong mchog gis thodad kyi gasku rig dang rtsis rig pa 'di bzhin skye 'gro drag zhan mtho dma' spyi dang / lhag par sngo/ 'tshal ba nyam thag dag li/ sman pa khyad du 'phags par gzigs nas ci nas kyang dar rgyas yong ba dgongs te snga sor lcags ri 'gro phan gling gi do dam la shugs snon dang / sngar brkos rgyud bzhir slar yang sku ngo mas dpyad zhib zhus dag mdzad pa'i tshe chad lhag tshig nor sogs kyi nongs pa mchis par bskyar zhus nan tan dbonas pa'i bka' khyab dag ther mdzad par ma zad/ bkras khang byams pa thub dbang gi dgongs 'dun la dgyes mnyes chen pos zhal bzhes gnang ste dbyar gyi rnga bo ches lo'i rgyal por dbang ba'i bgrang bya der gso rig slob gso dang / sman bcos lag len/ sman rdzas sbyor bzo/ gnam rig skar rtsis/ rig gnas/ skad yis bcas phyogs bsdus byas pa'i slob grwa chen mo bod ljongs lha sa sman rtsis 'gro phan gling zhes pa gsar 'dzugs thog bod dbus gzhung gis thad sha'i do dam sde tshan gyi khongs su mdzad/ 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku sngo mas 7sku'i bla sman bkras khang pa spyi mkhan byams pa thub dbang la spyi khyab dbu 'dzin dang / mkhyen rab nor bu mchog la gzengs bstod dang 'brel sman rtsis slob grwa'i 'chad spel

16 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sku //'dzin skyong do dam 'gan 'dzin du bsko bzhag gnang ba sogs sngar yab kyi skyes skar brtag pa'i 'bras bu'ang ji bzhin byung / mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gis 'dzin skyong do dam cher bzhes gnang ba'i 'og sman rtsis 'gro phan gling gi tshad khag sgrig gzhi dang / gzhung tshad chodab yun/ gzhung lugs 'chad spel/ lag len dmar khrid rgyugs 'bul/ slob thon lam lugs/ sman rdzas 'thu sgrub dang sman khyodar bzo/ de bzhin rtsis dkar nag dbyangs gsum la zhib 'jug dag ther gyis le tho 'don spel dang gzhung tshad spus dag legs nyes lha gas kyi sgrig lha la gsar btod rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgo 'phar yangs por dbye bar mdzad/ khong sku ngo mas sman rtsis don gnyer rnams la sman rtsis gtso bor gyur pa'i rig gzhung spyi la slob khrid nan tan gnang bas sngar drodan mkhas pa'i rgyun sku/la bla na med pa sman dang rtsis kyi bstan pa zung 'brel gyis 'gro ba nad pa'i don chen grub pa'i mdzad pa dbyar gyi chu gter la 'gran par byed/ mdzad pa'i snyan grags bod ljongs phyi nang gang sar khyab pas chos lugs ris med kyi dgon sde khag dang / dmag sgar/ sngags 'chang rgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa'i zhal stsodab dang / tso gas mtha'i rgyal khab/ 'brug pa dang / 'bras ljongs/ la dgas/ khu nu bcas nas slob ma mang po bung ba ke sa rar chags pa bzhin 'du ba'ang / klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ dam pa ring na gnas gyur kyang / /yon tan pho nya nyid byed de/ /ke ta ka yi dri bsnams nas/ /bung ba rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'dus pa'i slob ma brgya phrag mang por sman rtsis gtso gyur gyis rig gnas gzhan dag yig dang / snyan ngag sum rtags/ sgra la sku/gas pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub lam sgron/ bshes pa'i springs yig chodab springs/ spyodad 'jug theg

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 17dgu'i don ston/ lam gtso rnam gsum sogs rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham pa'i zhi ba chos kyi bdud rtsis gdul bya rnams dbugs dbyungs bar mdzad/de ltar rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang khyad par sman rtsis smra ba'i khyu mchog lta bur gyur kyang lnga sa bsam rgyun chad med par gnang ba ni/ rgyal po cadar gyis 1rims pa med/ /rgya ma25 chu yis 1rims pa med/ /mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi sngogams/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang nyid mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes kyang mu mthud de mgo log bla ma skyabs rje 'jam dpal ro/la pa'i blo gros dang / khams mtshan nyid sprul sku 'jam dpal cadar bu gnyis kyi drung nas g.yu thog snying thig gi brgyud pa mi 'dra ba so so'i dbang lung cha chang dang / 'jam dpal rol pa'i blo gros lasa.a mdo zhwa dmar ba dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mcho'i gsung gi lam rim dang /rig byed ma'i dbang lung skor/ sum rtags/ sgra rig sogs mang du gsan/ 'bras spungs khang gsar rin po che las dus 'khor dbang chen/ mtshur phu dge slong 'jam dpal tshul khrims las g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang lung rin chen gter mdzod du bzhugs pa'i kong sprul gyi kha skong skor cha tshang gi brgyud pa dang / ser smad gzhung pa lha btsun rin po che dang / 7skyabs rje pha bong kha pa'i drung nas g.yu thog snying thig gi chos skor dang / rgyun dkon pa'i rigs 'ga' gsan/gzhan yang / rong tsha tha chung chod bzang dam cosas rgya mtsho las bi dkar bu dpe'i tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rtsis cadag nas tshe rabs las rtsis dang / bag rtsis/ gshin rtsis/ dbyangs 'char 'grel pa/ dpal lha na 'grel pa/ dpal sgron steng nas le'u bcu ga'i 'khor lo bcas kyi khrid rgyun gsan/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas sngo mtshar rtogs byed ri mo bcas gsan bzhes dang / da dung

13 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//sku/ga sngo dge bshes dga' ldan pa zhes pa sgra la shin tu mkhas pa zhig gi drung nas sgra 'grel gsal ldan gyi steng nas brda sprod dbyangs can sgra mdo'i ri mo cha tshang gsan bzhes gnang /bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa rta (ye lo 1918)lor sku bcar bla sman chung ba bya sbug dam chodas dpal 'byor sku na bgres pa'i stabs kyis dgongs zhu mdzad pa'i tshab tu 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku sngor mas mkhyen rab nor bu mchog la gzigs bskyangs bla na med pas bla sman chung bar bsko bzhag mdzad/ de yang /gang zhig rigs ldan de bzhin dang / /dam pa 'phangs kyang yon tan gtong mi byed//nyi ma'i rang bzhin tsha bas gdung yang ni/ /kha ba grang ba'i rang bzhin gtong mi byed//ces gsungs pa ltar dam pa 'di nyid 7rgyal ba'i bla sman pa gnang rgyu dang / sman rtsis don gnyer can la slob khrid bskyang rgyu dang / nad par sman bcos gnang rgyu/gsol sman sbyor rgyu sogs dang / gzhung sger gyi rtsis dbyangs 'char las rtsis bcas pa bskyon rgyu'i mdzad brel shin tu che yang nyin re'i 'don chos mtshon pa'i sbyor chos dag chag med gnang ba'ang zhogs pa'i chu co da gsum pa tsam la sku bzhengs thog byi dor legs par gnang rjes bzhugs sgrom steng lus rnam snang bdun ldan nam brgyad ldan gyi sgo nas skyabs sems rgyud dang 'dres nges su gnang rjes zhal 'don thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / g.yu thog snying thig marlung sgom rgyu sogs khyon chu tshod gsum gyis sbyong ba mdzad/ de rjes slob ma rnams la zhogs pa'i bka' khrid gnang ba dang / bka' phri/ da zin rjes brtag dpyad khang du dbe phrug gnyis re res mos su mnyam khrid thod nad pa mtho dman gang la'ang chags sdang dang rnam g.yeng med pa'i thog sman bathodas gnang ba yin/ nad bcos thad mig 'byed

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 19rgyus mtshon pas thur ma'i lag len dka' ba dag thog mar lug mgo ra tshod lta byang chub par gnang ste nad thog dngos gzhi'i steng nad pa'i dka' ngal bde blag tu sel thabs mdzad pa dang / gtar bsregs las lnga'i bcos thabs rnams kyang gal cher dbe|ngas te rgyun gtan nas phyag bzhes 'phyugs med gnang bar ma zad/ mnyam khrid slob ma rnams la dmar khrid lag len mdzub tshugs su rdo na mdzad pa yin/nyin gung gasku la tshigs zin ma thag gzim chung du phyag dpe gzigs pa dang /gzhung gi sku drag lha gas dbus sger rtsodan bcar rnams la 'jig rten gyi mtshar gtam spangs nas sngo na dalnga sa dbyangs 'char bskor rgyus mtshon pas 'ardo da wa na gyi re ba yid bsam du skong bar mdzad/ rgyun du dathodang dro'i gsol tshigs mthodad zin pa dang gling sko ra la phebs kyi sku da/ de skabs ched mngags ra mo che sku gas ngan sprang sdod yul du phebs te nad par lta rtog dang khyad par sku nyid kyi zla re'i gsol phogs las gang 'tshams shig gamo la zhib 'thag gnang mdzad de lha sa bo nga khyer gyi ngan lho nga la sbyin gdonang gnang ba yin la gang 'tshams shig bshad sgrub gnyis kyi lha nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong gnang ba'i dgon sde khag gi bya bral rnal 'byor pa la chos rgyun du phul gnang gi sku da/ sku re'i bod zla lnga pa'i tshes mabo ra bshas khrims spo la ba'i rjes lha sar 'brog sde khag nas bshas lug mang po 'tshong bar yong dus dam pa 'di nyid gling lha ra la phebs skabs thug phrad byung tshad sku ga blu gnang ba sku gas kyis sman rtsis khang du g.yag lug tshe thar btang ba du ma malnga nga rgyu yod/dgong dro ma gzim gong zhal 'don bla mchod bde stong dbyer med dang / rig byed ma/ sman rtsis bka' srung dam can sde dgur gasku la kha sku gas gnang rjes nye gnas slob ma rnams la sman rtsis bka' khrid dang skabs re mtshan snu/ phyi log tu nam

20 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//mkha'i gza' skar ngo sprod dang / gza' phyir ldog byed tshul sogs ngo sprod gsal bshad gnang ba yin/ gzhan yang 'o/ ltar ྅ped zla bzhi par rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchodad sprin brgya tshar chag med phul gnang gi yod la/ yodad zla bdun pa'i nang sman rtsis slob ma rnams dang lhan du dog sde phug gzim mal la/ yer pa lha ri/ lug nag tshal ka bcas la phebs te khra ba ma tshor sngo sman sngo sprod gnang ba dang / tshes brgyad dgu'i dgong snga slob ma rnams la sman ngo bsher rgyu dang / tshes bcu'i zhogs pa brag yer dgon par tshes bcu zab rgyas phul rjes gong gsal sman ngo rnams sbyangs 'bras legs nyes la gzhigs pa'i gasdudal ras bong bu dkar nag khrab rgyu sku gas sngon sde srid rin po che bzhugs pa'i skabs dang 'dra bar gnang ba yin/rab rgyal chu sprel (ye lo 1932)lo'i bod zla brgyad pa'i nang 7rgyal dbang mchog nas rtse sgang du phebs dgos pa'i bka' rgya gnang ba ltar 'phral mar ngo bcar zhus par 7bo/nga sa mchog nas rkyen gzhan gang yang ma gsungs par mkhyen rab ca/ra bu de ring nas sman rtsis khang gi 'gan 'dzin mu mthud gnang thog re zhig bla sman nas/ phyir 'then yin/ zhes bka' bsgyur phebs/ de skabs thugs dgongs su gnas lugs rgyu mtshan gang yang ma gsungs par bla sman nas phyir 'then zhu dgos gsungs pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas sman rtsis khang gi 'gan 'dzin mu mthud gnang dgos gsungs pa dbo/sa pa gang gi slad du yin nam snyam pa'i the 〉rgam gyi gnas su gyur/ de rjes 7gong sa mchog la phyag rtsadang gsol sman 'bul mkhan spyan bsal kun 'phel lags thugs 'dris yod pa nyid kyi dasngo sa slob byams pa lags nas gnang / de'i phyi lo chu bya (ye lo 1933)lor 7gong sa mchog mgul cham lta bu'i snyun gzhi phran bu bzhes te lo de'i bod zla 10 pa'i tshes 30 nyin

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 21dgongs pa gzhan don du phebs pa'i tshul mdzad/ de dus 7rgyal dbang mchog la sman pa byams pa lags nas gasku/la sman cham 'joms dpa' ྅the bcu bzhi phul sku da 'dug pa gasku la sman 'bul sdudags la bsnyad de rang gzhung nas sman pa byams pa lags kong por rgyang 'bud btang / de skabs gzhi nas mkhyen rab nor bu mchog la gasku la sman 'bul tshulags sku gas la bsnyad pa'i lnga ho/ga nyen kha gang yang ma byung ba dang / sman rtsis bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum sngar rgyun ltar bskyangs thub pa byung stabs ma 'ongs sngo na gzigs kyi mdzad par mkhyen nas dad pa bla lhag tu 'phel ba byung zhes gsungs/dam pa 'di nyid dgung grangs drug cu skor du phebs la nye ba'i skabs de sngon dbyangs 'char gza' dgus tshe la spyod pa'i rtsis 'bras las rang nyid kyi sku che'i bzhugs yun brtag pas dgung grangs re gcig la nges par stodags pas nye gnas slob ma 'khor bcas la ma 'ongs las don bya phyogs thad zhal gdams rim pas gnang ba dang dgon sde khag la mchod 'bul gnang rgyus mtshon chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba che phra kun la masngo na gzigs 'phyugs med kyi tshul mdzad par ma zad/ tshe sgrub sogs dam chos la nyams len gnang rgyu gtso bor gnang /lcags 'brug (ye so/ 1940)7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog gser khrir mnga' gsol skabs/ sku'i dgung keg gi mtshan ma ngan pa zhi thabs dang / sman rtsis bstan pa yun gnas srung skyodab bya phyir bar klu sgug tu yi dam rta mgrin yang gsang gi brag phug gsar bzhengs gnang / de skabs lha bzo pas mngon rtogs lugs bzhin dam can mo gathe nga du bzhengs gnang bar dam can stag gdong can gyis dam pa 'dir dasngo sa su stag sham

22 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//brdzes te pho rtags bstan gnang mdzad pas/ de nas bzung stag gdong de nyid pho gasnga nga du zhal bsgyur gnang bar ma zad/ masngo na rtogs nang byang du gcadad sbyin shan pa dmar mo mtshal cog la'am byu ru'i mdog can/ stag gi gdong pa rab khros (5) ma zhes pa byang du gnod sbyin shan pa dmar po zhes pho mo'i rtags kyi mtshan bsgyur gnang / gzhan yang de skabs sham bha la'i bo nga khyer gyi bsnodad pa khyad du 'phags pa gsar bzhengs kyis zhal thang du sku nyid sman rtsis zhal slob du mas balha ra te sham lha la'i sems dpa' chen sngo rnams dang lhan du bzhugs pa zhig bzhengs 'dug pa ma 'ongs nged cag tshang ma sham bha lar skye ba'i rten 'brel dang lhag par dam pa nyid 'di nas sham bha la'i grong khyer ram yang na sman thodang lta na sdug tu gshegs kyi yin zhes gsungs pa ni kho snga sa dam pa'i zhal las dngos su thob pa'i tshig rmad du byung ba zhig thod /dgung grangs re gcig tu phebs pa shing sprel (ye so/ 1944)'o'i nyin zhig gi zhogs pa nyi shar 'brug dus kyi lnga char sku mtshams bo/la ba gnang ste rgyun gtan ltar bar klu sbug nas pho brang zhabs skor brgyud sman rtsis khang du phebs lam la gru 'dzin pho brang ri bo'i rtse nas slo bur sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug gi zhing khams khra lham mer mjal ba dang / de'i ngang la 'ja' 'od kyis nam mkha' khyab ste rlung dmar zhig brgyab pa'i snang bar mthing cadag (cod pan stag ris can zhes kyang gsal)sgril ma zhig gang nyid kyi zhabs mdun du lha ra ba lan gsum byas nas 'a〈per bar phyag gis ga ler bzhes te gzigs zhib gnang skabs sku nyid dgung grangs gya gcig bzhugs zhes pa'i yig 'bru gzigs/ gzim shag tu 'byor rjes sngar gyi mthing shog der lan gcig gzigs dgos snyam pa'i ngang la mthing shog de gar song

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar pocha med du gyur/ de na thugs dgongs su bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can dgung grangs gya gcig bzhugs par shod ྅pe yang dgung grangs gya gcig tsam bsdad na chodab ma rnams rang mgo thon te sman rtsis bstan pas 'gro ba'i don byed thub pa yong ba 'dug dgongs/ de yang / nyid kyis brtsams pa'i bdud rtsi sman gyi phan yon snying po zhes pa'i tshigs bcad ma'i mjug tu'ang / sman rta zhal bzhes sman sbyor brgyad cu yin/ /phan sku/na spel ba'i dge bas ma23ga dman kun/ /nad med lang tsho brgyad cu'i tshe thob nas/ /don ldan chos 'byor 'chi med sku brnyes shog /ces gsungs pa 'dis kyang skyes chen dam pa bsam bzhin du 'jig rten 'di'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shar ba rtogs nus so/ /dgung lo drug cu re bzhir phebs pa me khyi (ye lo 1946)lor lcags po ri'i shar ngos brag ldebs su grub thob thang stong rgyal wa'i sku gser zangs las grub pa'i mi tshad che mchog las brgal ba tsam nang gzungs ring bsrel rnam bzhis gtams pa bzhugs khang bcas grub thob lha khang du grags pa gsar bzhengs gnang /'di nad yams 'gre+ogre byed dang sa pra legyes bcos kyi ched du yin par bsungs kyang / don du gzigs snang la byung ba yin tshul 'ga' zhig zer/ de mtshungs thang stong gi sku chung ba 'bum phrag lhag tsam la zhal gser bsgron pa/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung sogs bzhugs pa gsar bskrun gnang zhing / lcags po ri dang / dmar po ri'i 'dabs zhol sa bcos kyi tshul du bzhugs par rab gnas rgyas par mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu lhag tsam na/ thugs nges 'byung gi skyo ba'i rnam pa bcas ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dka' ba brgya phrag spyad tshul gsungs nas dran rten du bzang gos 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i ston pa'i dka' spyad dang sangs

21 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//rgyas pa'i mdzad thang nyis lnga ga tsam bzhings te nga'i skye rtags yin gsungs/ gzhan yang rje g.yu thog pa'i gos sku nyis thog tsam yod pa dang / sman bla bde gshegs mched brgyad/ rje gzigs pa lnga ldan/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong bcas tshem drub ma'i gos thang dang bris thang mang du bzhengs pa smos kyi mi lang / gser zangs kyi sman rgyal gyi sku che ba dang / jo bo rje'i sku/ sman 'dam las jo bo rje'i sku mang du bzhengs/ gsung rten bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur/ rin chen gter mdzod sogs chos skor ches mang bar na bza' bkur sti/ mchod 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ gtsug lag khang dang / dgon sde khag la mchod sprin bsnyen bkur/mchod rgyun thebs sbyar sogs mtha' yas/ 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog gnas gzigs phebs skabs grub thob lha khang du bla sman pa dang lhan du lo rgyus sku/gas kyi bka' snu/la la thugs dgyes pas lhod bzhugs gnang bar dus mārgad la zhabs bskul zhu dbo sa pa'ang byung zhing / mkhan chen dar han gyi bo gnas bstsal ba sku gas gzigs bskyangs che/ 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gi drung nas lam rim dang dus 'kho ra da bang chen/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang sogs kyang gsan/gnam lo gnangs chags su zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar sman pa dpon slob bdun cu skor sman 'thog tu dog sde dang / yer pa lha ri snying po/ brag yer pa chu sbug sogs su phebs bzhugs mdzad de/ sman sna lnga brgya bdun cu skor la sngo sman 'khrungs dpe nang gsal ltar thon skor gral sgrig la slob ma rnams kyis sngo sa 'dzin la gzhigs pa'i thig rtsis dang kur rtsis kyi ang grangs bzhin gzigs bzos gnang ba bcas sa skyong bud+dha sā ra'i phyag bzhes nyams med skyodang ba gnang /

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 25dam pa 'di'i sku tshe hril sngo ra sman bcos lag len gyis 'acad ba mang por lus srog gi sbyin pa bla med gnang ba ni brjod kyis mi langs shing / khyad par 'jig rten sngo mtshar lhanas pa'i brtag thabs rtsa'i rig pa las sngor mtshar gyi brtag thabs bdun po dang dbyangs 'char gnyis ྅/ phyag len 'phyugs pa med par gnang ba'ang / rgyun du dbyangs 'char ba'i rgyud 'di dang / ngo mtshar rtsabadun ma bu dgra grogs 'di ni thun snu/nga ma yin pa'i brtag thabs khyad par du brtsis la dbyangs 'char dang 15 mtshar rtsa'i brtag thabs kyi rig pa gnyis kyi che ba'ang / dbyangs 'char dang dgra grogs phud sngag mtshar ba'i cangabartag thabs 'di zhes yang yang gsungs la dam pa 'dis snga rjes su dbyangs 'char dang dgra sku gas kyi lam las sngo mtshar ba'i gnad du ma ston gnang mdzad pa'ang / sku nyid kyi sku tshe'i tshad dgung grangs re gcig la nges pa rnyed pa dang / phyis su 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa dathodangs pa gzhan the na du gshegs nas sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen sngo/ra chab srid kyi 'gan dbang ma phul bar 'dir rwa sgreng dang stag brag rin po che nas bod kyi rgyal tshab gnang ba red/ de skabs me phag (ye 'o/ 1947)lor se rar zing 'khrug byung bar ma zad gzhung gis rwa sgreng rin po cher dbu nyes phebs te shar chen lcog tu do dam byas/ de dus shar chen lcog nas sman rtsis khang du sku ngo mkhyen rab nor bur rwa sgreng rin po che sku gzugs bde min la brten shar chen khyodag tu phebs dathodas zhes bka' yig 'drolar bar rin po che'i sku gam du ngo bcar zhu skabs ('di tshe phran dang blo bzang bstan pa gnyis lhan du sku bcar zhus kyang rgya lha nas ma thar)rin sngo ches de ring gangs ljongs bod kyi sman pa'i rgyal sngo ngo mjal byung bar dga' spro chen po byung zhes bsngags brjod tshad med gnang ba dang / sku nyid gzugs wa bde thang yin pas gasku la sman

26 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//gzhan gang yang mi dathodas/ cadan te dam rdzas mtshon byed du a gar 1/ lnga thun gcig gnang rogs gsungs pas thugs 'alnga da ltar brtag dpyad kyis a gar so lnga thun gcig phul gnang / nyin shas rjes bshad srol 'dra min la tos pas rwa sgreng rin po che sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul thon/ rwa sgreng rin po che dgongs pa gshegs rjes rwa sgreng dza sag la nyis skyon phog ste btson 'jug byas par ma zad/ mig ril 'the na rgyu'i mi ྅ da las 'das pa'i nyes pa tshabs cher gdo/nga gtan 'khel/ ya nga ba'i gnas tshul de mkhyen rab theṭar bu mchog nas gsan rjes thugs kyis ma bzod par lam seng gzhung la ྅/da ljongs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing 〉kyis ldan gyi rgyal khab gcig yin par ma zad/ 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen sngo/ dngos su bzhugs yod pa 'di lo dgung keg tu phebs yod stabs sman rtsis khang nas 7rgyal ba'i sku phyar 'gan len mi bzod pas rwa sgreng dza sag la nyes pa spyod rgyu mtshams 'jog ma byas na mi 'grig ces pa'i snyan zhu phul ba'i mthar gzhung nas de don khas len ma gnang thabs med la brten rwa sgreng dza sag chag sgo'i nyen 'phrang las thar ba red/me phag (ye lo 1947)tsam gyi nang ka shod sa dbang dang lha lcam gnyis pos rgyun gtan nas dam pa 'dir ma bu dgra thodags balha ra rgyu sogs dad pa chen pos zhu gi yod pa ltar lo der ka shod lcam gyi thugs 'dun ltar lha lcam gyi gzim shag tu ngo mtshar gyi rtsagazigs gnang bar phebs/ de tshe dam pa 'dis lha lcam gyi phyag rtsar/ skyer tsher 'dra na sdug bsngal thar med rtsa/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid 'di tshang 'dug pas lha lcam nyid re zhig sdug bsngal du tshud nges par 'dug gsungs pas/ yun mi ring bar se ra dang rgyal tshab stag lung brag gnyis mi mthun pa'i

bla sman mkhyen rab cadar bu'i rnam thar 27rkyen ngan sku/gas kyis ka shod sa dbang chen snu/ 'dzin bzung byas te lha kha sne garo/nga rnam rgyal chos khang du rgyang phud btang bas de nas bzung lha lcam sdug bsngal gyi dra bar tshud/ de'i phyi lor slar lha lcam gyis gdan zhu mdzad pa ltar ngo mtshar rtsa'i brtag pa mdzad pa de skabs lha lcam mchodag la thugs khral mi dbo/sa/ dgra yi cangal dgra mabyung na thub/ /ces pa'i mtshan nyid tshang 'dug pas khyodad dang sku cad mchog ring min ngo mjal yong gsungs par sa glang (ye lo 1949)lor chab mdor rgya dmar gyis btsan bzung byas rjes rgyal tshab stag brag nas spyod bur du 7bo nga sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen sngo ra (dgung grangs bcu drug la phebs skabs)chab srid kyi 'gan dbang sku ngas cadags 'bul bzhes gnang ba dang / de dus bod rgyal sku ngas kyi batho na pa rnams blo da bamo/la gdodang gnang mdzad pa'i kho ngas nas ka shod pa sa dbang yang btson las thar te lha lcam dang thug 'phrad byung bas khong gnyis por yid ches kyi dad pa bla lhag tu 'phel ba byung ngo / /gzhan yang / lo 'di'i bod zla 7 tshes 1 dgong dro nor gling lha mo'i gzigs phud nyin bsam yul las 'das pa'i sa sku/ma chen sngo/ zhig brgyab par gzhung nas de lha ra mtshan ma bzang ngan ji 'ong sman rtsis khang du dbyangs 'char bakhyodan dgos pa'i bka' phebs par de'i tshe dam pa 'dis kun gzigs dbyangs 'char ba'i rtsis brtag pa'i 'bras bur/ yul gyi rgyal sngo 'a'o/ 'gyur byed/ /ces pa'i mtshan ma masngo na du byung ba bdag la dbyangs 'char gyi 'bras bu 'di bzhin gzhan la bshad tshe lce breg rgyu las 'os med ces gsungs byung ba phyis su gang 'dra byung ba ni tshang mas mkhyen gsal lags/ chu yi 'brug sprul (ye 61 1952 1953)tsam gyi nang gzhis rtse rdzong nas rang gzhung bka' shag la snyan zhu zhig 'byedar ba'i nang 'di

28 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs mo //khul sa gnas shig la pha therted skyid dang ma a 'alhunams gnyis la sras gcig 'khrungs pa de yang dbu la u rgyan pad+ma'i pad ris yod pa dang / lag na lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thogs pa/ dri chur 'bol gdan steng dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba sogs ngo mtshar du ma dang ldan pa zhig btsas yod pa de don thag gcod yong ba zhes 'khod sku/da/ bka' shag nas rgyun du gzhung gi gal che'i phyag las rnams lam lha nga gang 'dra yong min sngon tshud nas sman rtsis khang la dbyangs 'char zhu yi yod stabs/ de dus snyan zhu dang bcas pa sman rtsis khang la gnang ste de don thag gcod dgos pa'i bka' phebs/ de skabs slar dbyangs 'char gza' bdun ma rtsis pa'i 'bras bur/lha tsan dan nags kyi dkyil rum du/ /snu na chu shing lnga na sngo gzhung nas skam/(6)/zhes bstan par rtsis 'bras 'dir don du 'bras bu med ces gsungs par phyis su shes the gas byung gsal ltar na de ni pha ma gnyis sngo sa rdzun baX byas te phru gu btsas ma thag lag mthil du gnam lcags rdo rje chung chung re bcugs pa dang / mtsho 'gram las lnga na pa'i dung dkar chung chung dga' chab gdan du bkrams nas rang nyid kyi phru gu de skye sprul zhig yin tshul grong pa khyim mtshes la 'ud sgrog byas pa yul lung gang sar khyab pa'i mthar cadang nas de snga na bka' shag la snyan zhu phul ba yin par rtogs/ gzhan yang / phran nas sman rtsis khang gi dngul dmar bdag nyar stangs 'dzin bya ba'i lo 3ra dngul grangs phon che zhig bed spyod ji song gi rtsis khra gsal nges med pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad par brten sku nyid nas de'i tshe dbyangs 'char sgra sgrub kyi sa ris bskyon gnang ba'i dbras bur ma tsa ra sa zhes pa'i yig 'bru bzhi'i lung bstan byung ba 'bru don brda dkrol zhu skabs ma zhes pa in dang tsa ra sa gsum 'dus pa brtsegs pas rtsis zhes hril gyis bsgril na

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 29yin rtsis zhesa.in ji'i (dbyin ji)rtsis khe ngas su snu nga ba'i mtshan ma byung ba rjes su blo bzang bstan pa rgyud shes lha gas byung gsal/ de snga phran nas lha da rgya tshwa dasngo na la.in lha ra brje tshab tu phul ba gsal stodags thub pa ma zad/ zhib rtsad byed skabs dngul grangs mang nyung dang bcas pa 'phyugs med rtogs pa dang / de bzhin shing lug (ye lo 195 ()lor 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po rgya nag tu phebs skabs sku cad masnu ga nas sku bcar bla sman pa sku mched thub bstan lhun grub la phyag cangagazigs gnang mdzad lha/nga ba rgan thub bstan lhun grub lags rgya nag tu phebs rjes thugs pham chen sngo/sa kho nga sku tshe ring sngo mi sku nga zhes yang yang gsungs gnang gi yod par khong rgya nag nas phyir phebs gnang ba'i so/ mjug tsam la sku tshe the gas pa red/ de ltar dpe mtshon re gnyis bkod pa 'di ni mkhas pa'i dbang po 'di nyid sman rtsis shes byar rang byan chud pa'i sngo mtshar gyi grub rtags mchojan pa zhig go/dam pa 'dis 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen wa'i sku sdi'i thog la thugs 'gan chen po bzhes gnang ste 'khrungs rtsis dang / lo re'i gung keg keg rtsis skyodan rgyu/ bar chad lam sel du gdo/ra ba3)sa gnang rgyus masnu na pa'i mthun rkyen bzang po sbyor thabs sogs gnang la/ khyad par kho nga sku ngo mas 7rgyal ba rin po che dgung grangs drug la phebs skabs kyi tshe rabs las rtsis zhib nan jo ga skyodan gnang ba lnga ti gcig tsam sku da/ 'khrungs rtsis de'i nang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad 'phrin gsal ba bdag cag thodad mi'i bsku da nams kyis 'khyodane na 7rgyal ba sku phreng 'di bzhin ma 'ongs 'dzam gling dbang du bsgyur ba'i chos srid kyi mnga' bdag rin po che zhig gnang thub kyi red ces nged khyodab ma tshor yang yang gsungs kyi sku da/

30 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen sngo mchog nas sman rtsis khang 'di nyid thog mar gsar 'dzugs bskyangs skabs sman rtsis khang 'di ma cadangs par rgyal bstan ji srid nam gnas bar pha las bu rdzig pa dang / bu las tsha bo rdzig pa/ tsha lnga las yang tsha rdzig pa lta bu sku/nga ba zhes thugs bskyed spyodan lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang yod pa 'di nyid rgyun du mcher 'dzin par ma zad/ sman rtsis zhal slob rnams la'ang yang yang de don bka' slob gnang gi yod pa ni phyis su bod kyi dgon pa khag dang rig gzhung mang po rtsabarlag tu btang rung sman rtsis khang 'di nyid mi 'dra tsam gnas thub pa byung ba las kyang the gas nus sku///de yang / chu yos (ye lo 1963)lo nas bod nang dgon pa dang lha khang mcho na pas rig gzhung bsti gnas mang sngo zhig mgalta ra gdodang ba'i skabs rgya'i dasngo/na rigs ༄stan sku na krang zhes pas phrag dog dang ngan sems kyis tshogs 'du mang wa'i chodag sman rtsis khang ni sngo da sa gnas srid gzhung bka' shag gi sder snu/ zhig chags 'dug pa 'di rtsagator gtong dgos zhes yang yang gleng / 'on te de skabs hong bo nga nas rgya mo zhig rgya nag brgyud cadad nang nyin bdun tsam gyi blta bstodar bya rgyu'i go skabs byung bar de skabs sman rtsis khang nang gnas sgyu da kyis sman pa 'ga' la bod kyi gso rig dang / gso rig gi lo rgyus 'dri rtsad byas par ma zad/ tshogs khang nang bzhugs lus thig dpe ris dang rtsis thang khag par du len pa sku gas kyis bdun gcig rjes hong kong la phyir log khong mo hong kong du 'byor ma thag bod kyi lo rgyus skor dang 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku phywa'i thad 'dri rtsad byed mkhan gsar 'thodad pa mang sngo/ byung bas kho nga rnams la ya mtshan ldan pa'i bod kyi gso rig 'o/ rgyus khyab bsgrags dang / bod nang da lta rgya mi'i btsan gachodan gyis rig gzhung de dag

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 31rtsabarlag 'gro khen yod pa sogs dang / 'dzam gling nang tshan rig yar rgyas phyin nas mi lo nyis brgya lnga bcu las 'gro yi med cing / bod nang tshan rig byung nas lo ngo stong phrag lhag phyin 'dug ces lus thig dpe ris bcas pa 'grems ston gyis gsar sna ga nang bsna da sku da pa red/ gsar 'gyur de rgya nag rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi mabo/ 'dzin tsung li kracad an lan gyis shes lha gas byung rjes rgya nag nas ched mngags zhib 'jug tshogs pa zhig bod du btang ste sman rtsis khang rtsad gcod dang de wa na 'dzam gling du khyab zin pas nges/ par srung skyodab kyis mi nyams thodang 'phel byed dathodas zhes gsal bsgrags nan che byas/ phyis su sman rtsis khang 'di nyid bza' rngams can gyi rgya stag mche ba las thar te sman rtsis bstan pas rang yul bod ljongs dang phyi rgyal gyi rgyal khab gang sar 'acad ba'i don chen sgrub phyir gasku na sngo ra gnas thub pa byung ba'ang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs bskyed spyodan lam las ma 'das pa 'di ni chodar du 'phros pa'i gtam mo / /dam pa 'dis snga cir dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkras khang byams pa thub dbang dang /'tsho byed ༄3 rgyal mtshan/ mthod 'o/ga bla ma 'jam dpal rol pa'i blo gros/ mtshan nyid sprul sku 'jam dpal nor bu/ 'bras spungs khang gsar rin po che/ lha btsun rin wa ཿ/ skyabs rje dharma seṅge'i zhal slob bla ma 'jigs med 'phrin las/ dge 'phel sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ cadags chen dpal sprul sogs skyes chen du ma'i sku mdun nas thun min thun ce/nga gi rig gzhung spyir ༄/sa bsam rgya cher gnang bar ma zad/ snga phyir sman dang rtsis kyi bstan bcos legs bshad du ma mdzad pa'ang /rab byung ba3) lnga pa'i lcags khyi (ye lo 1910)so/ra 'bras spungs sman sbyin skabs brtsams gnang ba (dpal ldan rtsaba'i rgyud kyi sdong 'grems gso rig rgya

32 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//mtsho'i snying po )dang (gru sman 'khrungs dpe bsdus pa ngo mtshar gser gyi snye ga) rab tshes lcags bya (ye lo 1921)'o'i dbo zlar phyi rgyud slob 'khrid skabs brtsams pa (gtar rtsa'i sdom tshigs su bcad pa gzhon nu'i ngag rgyan )dang khra zla bar bcoms pa nyabyis pa'i nad rigs ma lus ba3)sa pa'i nyams yig) rab tshes chu phag (ye lo 1923)nag zlar bcoms pa (bshad rgyud kyi sdong 'grems zla shelanor bu'i me long )de bzhin chu phag ston 'bring khrums zlar bcoms pa (grig sman 'khrungs dpe yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang )bdud rtsi sngo'i 'khrungs dpe rgyas pa ('tsho byed gzhon nu'i snying nor/) rab tshes shing byi (ye lo 1924)lo'i ston 'bring dbyug zla'i dkar phyogs su rgyud bzhi rdzogs par khrid sbyor skabs bcoms gnang ba'i (rgyud kyi sa bcad stag mo'i rngams thabs/) 〉wan 'bring khrums lha da zla bar brtsams pa'i nyams yig bsdus 'bring dang man ngag lhan thabs nas bshad pa'i nad mig tshigs su bcad pa (rin chen phreng ba )dang / tha skar zla ba'i yar tshes la brtsams pa (phyi rgyud mchu'i lhan thabs)dang / yang snga 1/ra brtsams pa tha skar zla ba'i yar tshes la par du btab pa (phyi ma rgyud kyi spyi don sdom tshig gzhung don sgo brgya 'byed pa'i sde mig) rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sku/sa (ye so/ 1951)nag zlar brtsams pa sman rjodar ༷7gas bsdus(lag len nyer mkho'i sman gyi sbyor dpe bdud rtsi bum bzang /) sman gyi sdeb sbyor re'u mig sogs phyogs bsgrigs dang gsar rtsom gnang la phyag len thad bod kyi phyi nang gi nyam thag nad pa mang 14ra mi 'jigs srog sbyin bstsal ba sgyu sa ci rjes 'dzin bu slob lha nga phrag lhag tsam la khrid rgyun man ngag lag len dang bcas pa gnang /rtsis rig skar nag dbyangs gsum thad/ rab rgyal me yos (ye lo 1927)lor phyag mdzod gsung rab kyis me phag (ye lo 1827)lor brtsams pa'i (rtses

bla sman mkhyen rab ce ra bu'i rnam thar 33gzhung rig ldan snying thig )dang / sa rta (ye lo 1858)lor mdzad pa'i rgya rtsis (reg ldan mchod pa'i 'od snang )gi rtsis 'go bstungs pa dang / rgya gar rtsis pa de boram/14gas phyi nang mkhas pa mang ྅6) thugs dogs dri ba dang bcas par dri lan gnang ba sogs mdzad/ phyag len thad lo ltar le tho 'don spel dang 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen rwastun dgung keg keg 35sa dang 'khrungs rtsis lha/na rgyus gtsos gzhung sger gyi dbyangs 'char lha na rgyu sku/gas ni lo/nga smos sngo mtshar gyis che ba dag las swā gas nus/ khyad par dam pa 'di nyid dgung grangs drug cu lhag la (ye so/ 1940)lha/na skabs gang gi ma23da zhal rtsi can ma zhig sku/da pa de'i zhabs las phyi'i sgra gcan gyi gzugs brnyan g.yas lha ra 'bur jo na du 'khrungs pa de nas bzung nyi zla gza' 'dzin brtag par dka' gnad kyi mdud pa grol ba lta bu byung gsungs/de bzhin sman rtsis bstan pa'i sri zhu'i ched dang / 'chad nyan dar rgyas sku nga phyir snga dus sde srid rin po ches mdzad pa'i sman thang bdun cu don dgu yod pa nyams ga1/ dang / 'ga' zhig gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i khar sman sdo sa slob grwa'i tshogs khang ldebs bris la rtsabashad kyi sdong 'grems dang / gtar bsreg dpe ris/ byang khog yul thig zho brag bstan 'dzin nor bus phung po dngos la bltas te bris pa'i dpe ris/ gso rig rgyud bzhi'i yongs gtad le'u'i ri mo/ dus 'khor lugs kyi ri rab dang go la'i dpe ris mi 'dra ba/ snyan ngag bya dka' ba'i rgyan gyi kun bzang 'khor lo sogs slob ma tshor blta bde'i ri mo tshar du dngar ba mig gi bdud rtsi lta bu dag gsar bzhengs gnang / lhag par dam pa nyid kyis klu sgug na brtsams pa'i (gasku tshul gyi sdodang 'grems)zhes bya ba byung chub ljon shing gi tshul du bkod nas ljags ce ma gnang ste 10ba ma tshor gso dpyad la spyodangs pa med pa/ byams pa'i

31 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs so///sems ldan 'gro ba nad pa'i mabo na skyabs dpung gnyen du che ba'i sman pa mchodag gi go 'phang don du gnyer dgos pa'i bka' slob dang de'i 'phros cung zad smras pa zhes pa'i zhal gdams tshigs bcad kyang gnang sku/da la de dus bstan pa chab srid yag po byung na dgung so/ gya gcig bzhugs thub pa'i re ba sku/da ces yang du gsungs/ phyis su sa phag (ye lo 1959)lor rgya dmar gyis bod ljongs dbang bsgyur byas pa'i rjes dam pa 'dir sman rtsis yon krang gi mtshan gnas phul bar sngar mus bzhin sman rtsis bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang /dgung grangs brgyad cu'i bar sman rtsis kyi 'gro don mdzad mthar lo shas spyan mi gsal ba'i tshul bstan par cadab ma rnams kyis spyan 'byed dgos tshul nan gyis zhus kyang ma gnang / de tshe phyag dpe klog mkhan rnyedab ma gam bcar gcig ched du nyar gnang gis 7skyabs rje dharma seṅges mdzad pa'i rje btsun mahā gu ṇa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul rnam par bshad pa sku gsum zhing khams bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba lcags ri'i par ma phyag dpe mda' tshad ma shog grangs sku gnyis sku/da pa sngon nas thugs 'dzin gnang grub kyang shar sgom gyi tshul du thugs dam nyams bzhes mdzad mus kyis cha tshang spyodag bcug tu gnang ba dang / lcags glang gnam lo'i cho 'phrul dus chen gyi rjes nas bzung sku nyid zhing du ma gshegs bar them skas ma'i dbu shog nas sna ga grangs bcu bzhi'i rgyab/de ltar sa rnams mthar phyin nas mi chodab pa'i lam masngogan 'gyur te/ gzhi lam gyi codad gsal 1ri gcig tu gyur nas sngags lam gyi khyad par can rnams gzhi 'bras dbyer med ngang du dag nas bsgrub bya lha dang sgrub byed gang zag gnyis dbyer med du lhun gyis grub pa ni tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang mtshungs

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 35so/ /zhes par slebs skabs slob mar klog mtshams 'dir 'chodag dgos gsungs par gzhigs na 'byung 'gyur tho rengs dus dgongs pa rdzogs rgyu'i brda bstan gnang ba zhig yin cing / them skas ma'i 'a'o/sa ro/na las kyang / 'di dag ni khyodan dre na dam pa rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi sa lam lto sbyar nas khog yangs por 'byed pa ltar la/ 'bras bu theg pa rang la dbang bzhi'i 'bo sa kyis mthar 'tshang rgya bar bshad pa las/ sa bcu lam lnga'i tshul mawa nas bshad pa bzhin med mod de/ khyad par 'di'i lugs la rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa dang sbyar na lus skye 'chi la rang dbang ma thob pa sems lha sku'i rnam par smin pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs sbyor gnyis su rim gnyis thodams pas phyag rgya chen wa'i dngos grub thob pa dang / skye 'chi rang dbang can tshe dbang rig 'dzin sogs rim bzhin thob pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/rgyun du thugs dam nyams sna gas phul du phyin par brten nas mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig yin stabs de'i phyi lor gsham du gsal ba bzhin tho rengs dus nyid la gzhi'i sku gsum lam khyer masngaran du gyur te dgongs pa gzhan don la gshegs tshul bstan par mdzad pa de ni cadan la gnas par ma zad/ da dung 'gro ba nad pa rnams kyi mgon skyabs sman rgyal bshes gnyen chen sngo/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhal snga nas/ khyod tshos phyag lugs le tho them mi 'da' zhig rgyag thub na byang phyogs sham+bha lar skye'am snyam/ nga rang byang phyogs sham+bha lar 'gro rtsis byed kyi yod ces gsungs/ rab rgyal chu stag ye so/ 1962 lor zla 10 tshes 25 nyin dga' ldan snga mchod kyi tshogs 'khor ma 'bul gong de ring mchod pa bzang po bshams dgos pa dang / bkra shis yag po gyis/ de ring lnga mchod 'di rjes ma yin zhes gsungs nas snyun gzhi gang yang med pa'i ngang nas zla de'i tshes 28 res gza'

36 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs so//zla ba'i nyin gyi tho rengs su seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis zhal shar phyogs be+eḍūr+ya'i zhing khams su gzigs te gzugs sku bsdus sku / /slar smras pa/ gang gi phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad pa ni/ /bdag so/gas rtog ge'i blo yi khyodad yul min/ /cadan te khyad 'phags bla ma'i mdzad pa dag /dad pas rjes su dran la su mi dga'/ /de tshe 'dir 'bad dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /'phral phugs phan bde kun 'byung sngo mtshar gnas/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchod gyur te/ /'dzam gling skye dgu'i re slong gyur cig gu/༈ོ gasku rig rgyud bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag khra tshang ba blo mchog the rje yan gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun ltar la/ de las rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po/ thugs sras ngag dbang gzhon nu/ stod lung chos kyi rje/ ngag dbang chos ldan/ bla dga' ro/na grub/ khyab bdag rdo rje/ rin chen dbang rgyal/ lung rigs rgya mcho / mkhas btsun rdo rje grags/ ngag dbang bce na 'grus/ blo bzang chos 'phel/ phun tshogs sku na tan/ mkhas grub dharma seṅge/ kun spangs 'jigs med 'phrin las/ de las bla sman mkhyen rab cadar bus gsan te dar rgyas mdzad sngo / /༈ོ g.yu cadag snying thig dbang lung gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas sman gyi rgyal po/ slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng / mkha' 'gro dpal ldan phreng ba/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon sngo / sum stodan ye shes gzungs/ dpal ldan gzhon nu ye shes/ gtsang ston sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhas btsun rin chen sngo rje/ brang ti snga na grub rgyal mtshan/brang rki dkon mchog skyabs/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/ zul phu sman mo che ba 'tsho byed rin chen/ rnal 'byor bsod nams dbang po/ rnal 'byor chen po/ ri khrod zhig sngo / rje dbo na mchodag mtshan can/ rje zur mkhar mnyam nyid theb rngo/ phrag dbon

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 37dkon mchog dpal bzang / kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin legs ldan do je/ byang pa bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur chen co sa dbyings rang lo/la/ 7rgyal ba lnga pa chen sngo/ ngag dbang sdud bzang rgya mtsho/ mkhas mchog chod bzang tshe dbang / kun bzang cadal mchodag 'asnu byed 6)sa 'acadar rgya mtsho/rnal 'byor rig 'dzin dbang po/ pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ gsang 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ lnga rig pa mthu rdo bas rnam rgyal/ chodas rje bstan 'dzin mthu stobs/ gsang bdag byams pa bstan 'phel/ mkhas grub dharma seṅge/ de sras 'jigs med 'phrin las/ de las sman rtsis mkhan chen mkhyen rab nor bus gsan pa'o//༈ yang g.yu thog snying thig brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ zur chen nas rgyal ba lnga pa chen po/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa/ smin gling rin chen rnam rgyal/ chos nyid rang grol/ pad+ma bshes gnyen/ ngag dbang kun bzang / pad+ma bdud 'dul/ ye shes mchog grub/ zha lu chod gsal bstan skyodang / zha lu legs pa don grub/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang sngo / grub macodag 'jigs med 'phrin las/ de las mkhan chen mkhyen rab cesar bus gsan pa'o//zhes pa 'di'ang 'phags yul sman rtsis 'gro phan gling gi 'gan 'dzin tshe ring bkra shis mchog nas dgos pa du mar dgongs te sman rtsis khang 'di'i rtsab chu mabo gangs la thug pa bzhin sman rtsis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab cadar bu masnu ga gi mdzad rjes rnam thar gang gsal zhig dbo sa nges bka' phebs ltar de snga dngos chodab lha rje byams pa 'phrin las mchog nas rnam thar gnad bsdus tshang ba zhig bris gnang 'dug pa gzhir bzhag lnga ga sman rtsis bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan mkhyen rab nor bu'i nye gnas dngos slob 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i

38 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//sku bcar bla sman chod bzang dbang rgyal lags kyis cadan mi lo bajo lnga lhag zhabs dodag sgrub pa'i ring dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhal las gsan pa dang / dalnga sa brgyud zhal 'dris gnang ba'i cad mtshar mdzad pa dag ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin gsungs gnang mdzad pa dag kho bo yang slob e pa'i ming 'dzin gyis bod rab gnas me glang lo'i gnam lo'i rang zhal gsar du bzhad pa dang lhan 'phags yul bzhugs sgar bod gzhung sman rtsis malnga slob khang du grub par bgyis pa gang yang slar rab gnas me phag sku ra gasku rig kun btus kyi brgyud pa'i 'o/ rgyus las kho la du phyung ba rnam thar (thar 'dod mthong bas yid 'phrog )ces pa las kha ston bgyis te cha tshang ba'i tshul du bsdu bsgrigs byas sdud/ /sarbamar+shalo/

bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i rnam thar 39dpyad gzhi'i dpe tshan dang mchan 'grel/(gangs ljongs gso rig bstan pa'i nyin byed rim byon gyi rnam thar phyogs bsgrigs/)byams pa 'phrin las kyis bce mas/ shog 65nga / 421 — 431(1) ye 'o / ye shu'i ston pa 'khrungs te ji tsam 'thod bzhin pa'i 'o/ deng sku ngas grags phyi lo dang spyi lor 'bod pa de'o/ /(2) 9dpal ldan g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyud dze na rab tu gsal ba'i ngag gis bska/da pa kun gzigs dbyangs 'char chen sngo shel gyi me so/nga /) mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mcho sa mdzad/ bod gzhung sman rtsis khang nas rab byung bcu bdun lcags rta lor par skrun byas pa'i dpe gzugs/ shog ang 45 dbyin ang / 89(3) 〈lha ldan sman rtsis khang gi chos spyod/)las (gso ba rig pa'i rgyud las bshad pa'i lus thig zla ba nor bu'i me long /) bla sman mkhyen rab nor bus mdzad/ bod gzhung sman rtsis khang nas ye lo 1984 'o/ra par skrun byas pa'i dpe gzugs/shog 65nga / 18 brgyab/ 6)na 65nga / 284(4) (tshe yi rig byed gling gi g.yu thog snying thig bla sgrub kyi dam can gyi mngon 'o/gas gsal ba'i me long /) nga shog ang 3 dpe gzugs/(5) 〈dbyangs 'char dus sbyor rmaku ra ) sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me yos ye 'o/ 1699 lor mdzad/ bod gzhung sman rtsis khang nas rab gnas thing khyi so/ra par skrun byas pa'i deb gzugs lag bris ma/ shogaskugang / 26

༄༅༅/ /7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i sku bcar bla sman bstan 'dzin chos grags kyi mdzad rnam snying bsdus dad blo'i 'od dkar rgyas pa'i zla gzhon bzhugs lha///༄༅/ /oswastiḥ 'pho med g.ya' bral be+eḍūr+ya yi mkhar/ /'gyur med rdo rje nyi ma sman gyi bla'i/ /dmigs med brtse chen phrin las 'od stong gis/ /'bral med bdag blo'i pad dkar bskyang du gasnu la/ /rgya chen ga1/ ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang / /zab mo gso thabs lag len man ngag gnad/ /zung 'jug 'du snyoms sbyor bar mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /'tsho byed gang gi mdzad 'phrin gnad bsdus gleng //zhes tshigs su bcad pa snga phyi gnyis pos mchodad par brjod pa dang / brtsams par khas blangs pa'i dam bca'i rim pa sngon du btang ste skabs su bab pa'i gleng bya la/ rang cag kha ba ri pa'i thun min thun mong gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' yas pa zhig mchis pa las/ 'bo ba'i nad gdung sel ba'i bdud rtsi dpal ldan gso ba rig pa zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa'i drang srong rim cadan gza' skar gyi phreng ba lta bu spyi dang / khyad par bsil ldan zhing 'dir chos rgyal mes dbon gong ma nas da lta'i bar du 7sku'i bla sman rim byon gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu'i dbus nas 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen wa'i bla sman sman rtsis smra ba'i khyu macodag mkhas dbang mkhyen rab cadar bu zhes mtshan snyan nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid kyi dngos slob 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen wa'i sku bcar bla sman/ gangs ljongs

khu e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyo gas bsdus bzhugs so///gasku rig 'dzin pa sku ngas kyi gtsug rgyan 'tsho mdzad slob dasngo na chen sngo lha rje bstan 'dzin snu sa grags lags kyi mdzad rnam snying sngo bsdus pa dad blo'i codad dkar rgyas pa'i zla gachodan zhes pa 'di nyid 'bri ba la/de yang / 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen wa'i sku bcar bla sman bstan 'dzin chodas grags mchodag ni/ cadad yul dbus gtsang gi char gshedags pa ste mo (deng rin spungs rdzong )g.yag sde zhes par yab bkra shis tshe ring bza' 'tsho zung gi sras su/ rab byung bco lnga'i shing byi (ye lo 1924)nag zla'i tshes bco lnga gza' skar rten 'brel dge ba'i nyin lpo ra 'khrungs/ 'khrungs nas zhag bathod lnga'i rjes nag zla'i stodang la yum tshe las 'das pa dang / gang gi zhal las gsungs pa ltar na sku nyid ma'i mngal du khyon zla drug las ma bzhugs par nges/ skyes ma 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rjes ho/ mo skal bzang dbang mo lags kyis yum gyi dod du gces khyodang gnang ba dang dgung lo bcu la son skabs sna du lags kyi dgongs bzhed bzhin yul dgon snye snu thodas sder (bo dong sa lugs dgon)grwa pa gnang ste yi ge 'bri klog bslabs/ dalha na par phebs pa'i thog mar byis pa'i gdon grib lta bus ngag mi bde ba dang / shes pa mi gsal ba sku/gas lus khams kyi 'byung bzhi 'khrug pa'i gzhan dbang gis rkyen yi ge 'bri klog dang dpe cha thugs 'dzin gnang bar sku ngal ston ma zhig byung / 'on te zla shes rjes snye mo spyil gro'i mkhan rin po che las dbe tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te rab byung sgrub par rim pas rig pa dwangs pa dang shes pa gsal du song bar ma zad/ de'i byin gyis yi ge 'bri chodag dka' ba med par brda bstan pa ca ma gyis mkhyen thub par dbang 'drodar bas/ dgon pa'i 'don cha sogs nang chos kyi dpe cha shog bu mda' tshad ma sum brgya lhag la nye ba dus yun thung ngu'i

bla sman bstan 'dzin chos grags kyi rnam thar 13nang thugs 'dzin thub pa byung ngo / /chos sder bzhugs ring gzhan phan byang sems kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i zhi dul bag yod kyi spyod pa bzang sngo sa dbo na pa'i dge 'dun bslab pa rgan gzhon su yang spyi wa'i gtsug tu bkur zhing / rgyun du g.yeng ba dor nas sems rtse gcig pa'i bzlas brjod kyis rang gcig pur bsam gtan rjes zhugs la mnyes pa/ lhag par dbo/na pa'i las ro/na che phra gang yin yang bsku da nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i dze na du dmigs te hur thag gnang ba sdu/gas dam pa'i gshis rgyud kyi lhan skyes dri bzang mngar mos kun gyis bsngags 'os su gyur/dgung grangs bcu bdun/ lcags 'brug (ye lo 1940)lor bod dbus gzhung gi bka' 'brel bzhin sman pa sbyang rgyur dbo na pa'i srung ma'i mdun zan brtag lung bstan dbabs pa ltar yul gyi lha rje tshul khrims lags kyi drung du sman dpe thugs 'dzin gnangs mgo brtsams/ rgan lags khyim du bzhugs ring snga dgong gnyis su sman dpe blo 'dzin dang / zhal 'don gyi dus tshod phud rgyun gtan rgan lags khyim gyi phyag las/ rta'i g.yog bya rgyu dang / rta sbang gad gtsang gis chodag khar 'asnga na pa/ rta lud zhing la 'dren pa/ gzhan yang khyim tshang phyi nang kun tu gtsang sbra bya rgyu sogs rgan lags kyis ci gsungs bka' bzhin grub pa las sngo lta ga rgyab mdun gyi snang ba ye nas med pa'i lus sems kyi mchod pas bshes gnyen mchog spyi phud du bkur/lcags sprul (ye lo 1941)lor bod gzhung dbus lha sa sman rtsis 'gro phan gling du slob gnyer gnang bar phebs/ de skabs mnal lam du rten 'brel bzang ngan ji sku nga bi mtshan ma brtags par dge ba'i mtshan ma mngon du byung bas/yid can 'di nyid la phan dang bde ba'i ched gso rig gzhung lugs slob pa'i lam
