41 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs so//la 'jug na ma cardongs par rang gzhan gnyis phan kyi dge mtshan mi dman pa sku/nga ba 'dug snyam pa'i gdeng slobs kyi spro ba mngon du phyogs/de yang / gang gis sku skye du mar bsags pa'i bsku da nams dang bathodas su med pa'i las smon gyi 'brel ba bzang sngo sa mtshams sbyar bar brten/ sman rtsis smra ba'i dbang sngo/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen snu mkhyen rab ྅nir bu mcho)ga zhal mjal gyi skal bzang thob pa smos ci/ dam pa de'i thugs rjes lhag tu 'dzin pa'i gnang bas sman rtsis khang du slob zhugs thub pa byung bas gnas der sman rtsis gzhung lugs gtso gyur jo ga thun snu/nga brda cadad dang thun min nang cho)sa la chodas bsam gnang / lho ba grwar bzhugs ring slob ma gzhan dang mi 'dra bar dka' thub kyis 'tsho ba lhag tu bzod pa'i blos sman gzhung slob gnyer gnang rgyu gal cher bzung la/ tha na rang gi gsol chas (ja 'thung snod kyi shing phor/)kyang btsong ste de'i rin gyis sman dpe blu yon zhus shing / rang nyid la gad snyigs las rnyed pa'i stod kha chag pa zhig bed spyad de chodag par 'dzin pa'i bsam pas thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad pa'ang / klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ cadar rnams kun gyi nang na 〉〉ga shes pa/ /rab mace)ga lags par lha mi'i rdo na pas gsungs/ /kun tu chog shes mjo da cig chog mkhyen na/ /nor mi bdog kyang yang dag 'byor ba lags// gsungs pa bzhin no/ /sman rtsis smra ba'i khyu mchodag mkhas dbang mkhyen rab cadar bu mchodag gi zhabs la 'bral med gtugs te/ gso rig rgyud bzhi'i dgongs 'grel be+e sngon rtsagazhir thog mes wa'i zhal lung dang / shel bo/nga shel phreng / lhan thabs sogs ga1/ rig gi gzhung lugs yangs pa'i rgya mtsho yi klong du dga' bzhin spro bzhin 'jug par ma zad rtsis dkar nag sga gzhung / 'byung rtsis man ngag zla ba'i 'od zer dang / rigs ldan snying

bla sman bstan 'dzin snu sa grags kyi rnam thar 15thig lnga pa 'phrod spyor/ de bzhin dbyangs 'char dus sbyor gyi lag len lha/gas la gsan sbyong gnang / gzhan nang dodan rig pa dang 'brel ba'i sgo ra la/ bshes springs dang / lam gtso rnam gsum/ spyod 'jug slob springs/ ston pa'i mdzad bcu/ byang chub lam rim sku gas dang / thun snu nga brda khyodad rig gnas/ snyan ngag dang / sum rtags gnyis mgazhir thog khyodab dpon dpal ldan rgyal mtshan zhal snga nas sgra'i gzhung lugs la'ang lnga/sa bsam gang legs gnang /de yang / sman rtsis khang du bzhugs ring lo ltar dbyar dus slob ma spyi ltar ri rtser sngo sman ngos 'dzin dang / 'thu sgrub gnang rgyu phud rgyun du khrog sman dang rin chen sman sna khag gi sngo sa 'dzin rjodar bakhro'i lag len gal cher gzigs te thugs zhib nan po gnang / chu rta (ye lo 1942)lor sman gzhung rgyud gsum (rtsargyud/ bshad rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud )dang sman rtsis chodas spu+od bcas pa sgra dag gsal gsum gyi thog sman rtsis slob dpon mkhyen rab nor bus gtso gyur dge ba'i bshes gasnyen dang / blo ba mang tshogs sar rgyugs 'bul zhus par lho ba da༄/na gyis bsngags bcadad thob/de rjes lo gsum ring sman sbyor khang du sman rigs sbyor bakhro'i lag len gtso yodar gnang chodag snga dbo nga gnyis su rgan lags drung nas sman dpe'i khrid rgyun ma chad par gsan rgyu mtha' 'aX ngas gnang / de skabs sman rjodar gyi rig pa dang 'brel ba'i sman gyi phan nus khyad ce)sa dang / rjodar ba zin dang ma zin sngon gyi nus par gyur ba ji song sogs dka' gnad kyi dogs 'dri mang po slob dpon sku drung du dogs gcod nan 1/ zhus par dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchodag nas dgyes lnga ra dang / gang thi sman ྅/ra bajo'i thugs rig la mgu ba dang thugs smon yang yang gnang ba yin/

46 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig chu gas bsdus bzhugs so//sa byi (ye 'o/ 1948)'o/ra khyodab dpon gyi bka' bzhin rgyal yum chen mo'i bla sman ched 'bras jongs dang ka sgug tu phebs/ de skabs rgyal yum chen mo'i zhal la cangagrib kyi snyun gzhi bzhes par phyi lugs sman pa dang / rgya gar sman pa sku/gas gdan zhus kyis sman ba3)sa gang thub gnang rung thugs phan de tsam ma sku sa/bla sman pa mchog nas bod pa'i sman gzhung gi blta reg dri sogs brtag thabs rig pa'i lam nas snyun gzhi brtag dpyad dang / sman bathe sa gnang bar thugs phan dmigs su 1/na pa byung bas nga snub dud pa'i sman pa phyi lugs sman pa las brtag dpyad thig ga 'dug ces rgyal yum chen snu/ thugs mnyes pa'i bkur stis bsku da nams kyi dzargags bla lhag tu 'phel ba byung /chu 'brug (ye lo 1952)lor lha ldan sman rtsis 'gro phan gling gi dka' bcu sman pa'i sbyangs 'bras rgyugs 'bul gnang / de skabs nyin bcu lhag gi ring lho ba dasngo na drung du nad pa'i mchur brtag dpyad kyis nad gzhi ngos 'dzin thub min rgyugs 'bul dang / slob ma rnams kyis phul ba'i rgyud don dogs 'dri sna mang la dgag bzhag spongs gsum dang / lung rigs yang dag gi sgrub byed tshad 'dzin gyis lan 'debs/ phru gu chung chung gi gzugs sngo ra yul thig dasngoras 'debs kyis lus thig rgyugs 'bul/ de bzhin sngo sman dang / rtsi sman/ rdo sman/ rin po che'i sman sku gas sngo sa 'dzin dang / de dag gi phan nus khyad cesas la bshad pa gnang ba sku/gas khrodab ༄/na yig tshad rgyugs 'bul zhus par grub 'bras yang rtser sku na/ slob thon phyi lo chu sprul (ye lo 1953)lor phag ri ri chung sgo tog gi mkhan po rdo shar sprul sku thub bstan lam bzang maspyodag gis sman rtsis sku sngo mkhyen rab cadar bu mchog la dngul chu rin chen btso bkru chen mo sbyor bzo gnang dgos pa'i

bla sman bstan 'dzin chodas grags kyi rnam thar 17thugs re snyan gsol zhus pa slob dasngo na gyi dgongs pa ltar phag rir thengs dang po'i dngul chu sbyor bzo'i sku tshab tu phebs/de yang dam pa de'i zhal slob snye mo ba bstan 'dzin chos grags lags de skabs sman rjodar khang du sman khyodar bakhro'i phyag las gnang bzhin yod la rgyun du khong gis gnang ba'i sman sbyor phyag len dang / gser dngul bsregs stangs thad gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan pa gzigs kyi sku da stabs/ las don de nyid gal cher dgongs te khong sku ngo mas ched gnyer gyis dngul chu rin chen btso bkru'i lag len/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dngul chu btso thal gyi yig cha dang / gzhan yang / smin gling 'bras spungs mo gas kyi phyag len man ngag khrid lung bka' khrid bstsal bar ma zad/ bya sla dang 'jug pa bde bar dgongs te kong sprul rin po ches mdzad pa'i dngul chu btso bkru'i lag len/ bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal po zhes pa'i khrid lung man ngag dang bcas pa thugs zhib tshags pos bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bstsal/ slob dpon gyi bka' bzhin phag rir phebs te dngul chu bathe thal rjodar baX gnang bar bsam yul las 'das pa'i grub 'bras bzang sngo cadab pa smos ci/ khyad 'phags kyi nyams the gas sku na tan du ma gang gi thugs rgyud la gsar du 'khrungs/ lhag par sku nyid kyis gzhung lugs dang 'gal med ched du spyad pa'i dngul chu sbyor bakhro'i rnam rig la dge ba'i bshes gnyen ma6)ga nas bsngags bswā da tshad med gnang bar ma zad ma lha/ngas sman rtsis khang gi slob ma spyi la lag len dmar khrid cig gnang thub pa'i thugs re nan po bcol gnang bzhin lo da/ 'on te phyis su zang zing dus ngan gyi rgol bas rkyen pas re zhig dam pa de'i dgongs bzhed grub pa'i thod skabs ma byung /

48 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyo gas bsdus bzhugs so///shing rta (ye lo 1954)'o/ra rdzo kha khul du rdzo spyi'i sman pa gnang bar phebs/de gar ༷ na dus yun zla gnyis lhag bzhugs ring lho spyi gatho cadar gyur pa'i lha khul nad pa mang sngo ra sman bcadas kyis mi 'jigs srog gi sbyin pa bstsal/ lhag par de skabs lto kha zhol khang gangs gi'u rin po che'i sku mdun nas rlung sgom dang ma rgyud kyi khrid rgyun gsan la rim gnyis rnal 'aX ra gyi las rung yang 'jog gnang mdzad/shing lug (ye 'o/ 1955)'o/ mjug tu bla sman sku gachodan thub bstan lhun grub lags dbonangs pa mya ngan las 'das rkyen 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i bla sman bsko bzhag gnang dgos pa'i bka' phebs ltar lo der slob cadan grub 'bras yang rtser son pa'i slob phrug drug tsam yod pa jo bo rin po che'i rten drung du zan brtag bsgril/ de yang zan brtag lung las sman pa bstan 'dzin snu sa grags mchog 7rgyal ba'i bla sman gnang dgos rgyu'i lung bstan bka' bab gser gyi cadad pan spyi bor yang yang dbab par mdzad pas/ deng nas bzung gang nyid 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i bla sman du dbang bskur ba smos ci/ ma 'ongs gangs can sman pa'i dpung gi khyu mchog chen wa'i mi 'jigs rdo rje'i seng khrir yang mnga' gsol bar snang ngo //me sprel (ye lo 1956)lor 7rgyal dbang rin po che rgya gar du gnas mjal phebs skabs rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin rgyal yum chen mo6) chibs zhabs ched du bla sman mchog kyang rgya gar du phebs/ de skabs zla gcig ring ka sbug tu phyi lugs sman pa dang babo/ gling gis phyi lugs sman gzhung thad cadas bsam phran bu gnang la/lugs gnyis wa'i sman gzhung gi rtsaba'i khyad cesas rang bzhin ji sku/da rags bsdus mkhyen rtogs byung bas/ rang rigs thun min gso rig gzhung lugs snadi nyid

bla sman bstan 'dzin chodas grags kyi rnam thar 19kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin la dad pa dang yid ches lhag tu 'phel/ skabs der 7sku'i gcen sngo rgyal 'o/ thodan grub lags kyi thugs re ltar sngo da sman las phyi lugs sman rjodang thub na dge mtshan che ba sku da pas de rjodangs gsungs pa'i thugs kyi 'thodad tshul las khyodags te slar yang kha ba'i ljongs kyi 'acad ba nad pa'i snga na chen sgrub ched gangs ljongs sa la'i nor 'dzin yangs pa'i dbus su zhabs skyong bar mdzad do/ /sa phag (ye 'o/ 1959)lor rgya nas drag wa'i dpung gis rang yul chos ldan gyi zhing khams 'dir btsan gcadan gyis mi dmangs khri chos du ma dmar gsod dang rdung rdeg tshad med byed pa'i skabs 7sku'i bla sman pa bstan 'dzin chos grags mchog kyang dgra bo'i 'dzin bzung 'og tshud pas/ sku lus la brjod mi thub pa'i rdung rdeg drag po myong bar ma zad/ sku nyid 7rgyal dbang rin po ches ched du bzhag pa'i gsang myul zhig la ngos 'dzin gyis lo de'i zla ba bcu pa'i nang btson grogs bdun cu skor dang lhan du rgya nag khran tu'u nye 'gram gyi gci'u cin (a rag )btson khang zhes par btson 'jug la khrid/ rgya nag bathongan khang du khyodan dus yun mi lo gsum lhag bzhugs ring thog mar btson sbub tu btson 'jug byas/ der zas su khyod tshal snyigs ro zhig las 'bru'i rigs bza' rgyu dasna na stabs gzugs sngo ra 'tsho bcud ma 'dang ba'i rkyen gyis bathe na pa mang po 'das grongs su gyur/ shul du lus pa'i btson pa rnams 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las khyodab thabs su rta bong gi rus pa dang / 'bu srin 'dra min lha/gas la longs spyad de rang gi lus khams galha/ thabs byed/ de skabs bla sman pa mchog gis sngo tshal dang zas rigs snyigs blo de dag kho nar bsten te sku 'tsho thabs gnang la zas rigs de dag 'ju thabs su mtshan snu/ gtum mo'i rjodar ba cadam pa'i nyams len la brten nas pho ba'i me drod gasku thabs

50 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs so//mdzad/ phyis su ba༄/na khang phyi rol du las /ra phebs skabs las zhor du ba༄ḍan pa rnams la khur mang sogs sngo tshod bza' rung ba'i rigs ngo sprod dang / de'i phan nus gsal bshad kyis bathergan pa mang sngo bkres pa'i 'jigs pa las lha ba thabs mdzad/de yang / dam pa srog la babs na yang / /rang bzhin bzang sngo/ ga la dor//sa le sbram ni bsregs bcad kyang / /de yi kha dodag nyams mi gyur/ /gsungs pa bzhin de lta bu'i bzod dka'i mnar gcod 'og lus sems gnyis ka sdug bsngal gyi gcong rong du lhang rung / rgyun du gzhan phan snying rje'i bsam pa dang las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad blo 'dor du med pa'i thugs rjes 'bo ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag rang gi lus steng du smin pa'i smon lam 'ba' zhig gis mtshams sbyar/ rtag tu bla mar gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab ste yig drug la 'bungs pa so/gas kyis sems zhum pa dang dog pa'i snang ba ye med pa lta bus ༷/sa khams la'ang dge mtshan mi dman pa byung /chu stag(ye lo 1962)lor rgya nag btson khang nas phyir slog gis slar bod du grwa phyi btson khang lta srung khang ang dang po dang sanyis par btson 'jug byas/nyin par lus kyi ngal ce la dang mtshan mor nag nyes sngo sa len dgos pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi mdung rtse rnon po'i 'og ji mi snyam pa'i snying stobs lcags kyi gong bu dang 'dra bas gzhan phyogs ngang gis zil gachodan par byed cing / rang lus la baX da par dka' ba'i sdug sbyong ji ltar myong yang 7rgyal dbang rin po che'i bka' drin rjes dran dang / gang la mchog tu dad pa'i blos dgra wa'i g.yo thabs bzang ngan dang 'jigs skul ngan slong ji 'dra byas rung snying rje 'ba' zhig sgom rgyu gtso bor gnang ba'ang sa paṇa gyis/ skyes macesag rnams la dman pa rnams/ /khro yang lan du ga

bla sman bstan 'dzin chodas grags kyi rnam thar 51la khro/ /ce spyang dregs pas skad 'byin yang / /ri dwags rgyal sngo snying rje skye/ /zhes gsungs bzhin can/ /bathe na khang du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig bathergan khang mabo/ khrid pa re 'gas nyams tshod dang sbrags bla sman par rtsabartag dathodas pa'i re skul zhus par bla sman pa mchog nas chags zhen nye ring kho ba gang yang med pa'i bsam pas cangagazigs nan 14 gnang ste/ nad 'di red dang slong rkyen na lugs 'di 'dra/ ma 'ongs 'di 'dra bar 'gyur/zhes pa'i kha dmar gsal sngo/ra smras par khong rnams ha las ༄)na chodar dang yid ches ngang gis 'phel ba byung bas sngo da pa'i sman par cha 'jog gis cad mtshar rtsabadun gyi brtag thabs la brten nas 'tsho 'chi dang / las lhunan grub min la sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mkhyen rab canar bu macesag gi rnam thar bskyangs gnang bar las byed mang pos tā la'i em rjer mngon shes 'dug ces pa'i ya mtshan gyi gtam rnying dri ma can (rgya nag pos sngar khas len med pa'i chos lugs kyi ming tshig mngon shes la go dgos/)de yang bskyar zhal 'asnga na bya dgos pa byung yod/ de nyid las/ dam pa re zhig gud gyur kyang / /zla ba bzhin du yar ngo 'byung / /gsungs pa bzhin gang rgi mdzad 'phrin yar zla bzhin 'phel bas ba༄yan khang du las byed med pa dang khong cho'i nye 'kho ra ba mang po bung ba ke sa rar tshogs pa bzhin ma 'bod ngang du 'dus/ der btson pa nad pa rnams dang las byed pa'i dgos 'dun ltar sman khang gsar 'dzugs kyis bla sman pa mchog la sman pa'i phyag las gnang dbo sa pa'i re skul zhus/me 'brug(ye lo 1976)lor spo bo spra rmo mas 'phrod bsten mgo khrid pa tshe rgyal lags kyis gdan zhus ltar re zhig ba༄ḍan khang nas dgongs 'kho la gyis khyon zla ba bzhi lhag ring dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzo gnang bar ched du phebs/

52 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs 1///de yang / sman pa tshul khrims dang / thub bstan shākya/ sde dge tshe rnam rin po che/ khong gsum sngo sa rin chen ril bu bzo rjodar bya ched batho thal phyag len gnang myong mkhan gyi sman pa 'tshol bar bod dbus gtsang khyon kun dang / khams sde dge khul sogs la phebs rung thodad kyi thun min gasku rig gzhung lugs kyi bang mdzod rin po che 'di nyid rgya dmar gyis stongs nyer thug pa lung rigs myong gsum dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa phal che mnar gcod 'og 'das bo/ngas dang / la la sbas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pas skabs su dngul chu btso thal chen mo'i phyag len tshad ldan gnang myong mkhan gyi lha rje zhig ma rnyed/ lha sa sman rtsis khang du bcar 'dri zhu skabs mkhyen rab nor bu'i dngos slob bla sman bstan 'dzin chos grags la khrid lung man ngag dang / lag len myong goms kyi rgyun mnga'/ 'on te khong da lta grwa phyi btson khang blta srung khang ang dang po'i nang btson 'jug byas yod skor sogs gsan/der tshe rgyal lags sku ngo ma grwa phyir phebs te bla sman pa mchog rtsad gcod dang /btson khang 'gan 'dzin la bka' bsdur gros mol gnang ste bla sman pa mchog dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzor gdan zhu gnang / bla sman macesag nas kyang tshe rgyal lags kyis gsungs pa'i bka' slob/ da lta'i dus 'dir bod kyi gso rig gzhung lugs 'aci/ nyid nyag phrar thug 'dug pas da res phyag len 'di gnang ba brgyud nyams pa slar gso dang mi nyams gong 'phel gyis ma 'ongs shul 'dzin rnams la rgyud sprod gang legs thub pa'i re ba yod/ ces pa'i thugs kyi bka' mol dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab nor bu macodag gi dbo ngas bzhed sgrub rgyu'i dus la babs pa sku gas dgos pa du ma'i slad du mkhyen nas dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzo gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes lhug por gnang / spra rmor khyon btson pa slob ma bco brgyad skor la dngul

bla sman bstan 'dzin chos grags kyi rnam thar 53chu dang btso thal gyi sbyor bakhro'i man ngag lag len dmar khrid du bstsal gnang bar dge mtshan rmad du byung ba'ang / deng gi dus 'dir bla sman pa gang gi zhal slob dang brgyud pa'i sli ba ma ngo da rdzongs sa mtho'i sa khul gang sar khyab sku da pa las stodags thub pa smos ci/ bod kyi gasku/ rig sman gyi cha lag gatherga thod dngul chu btso thal gyi sbyor bzo de nyid nyams pa slar gso byung ba/ bzo rig 'dis kyang 'dzam gling tshan tshan gyi rig par 'gran bzhin kha ljongs gso rig sa 'dzin dkar po'i rnam pa mngon du byas sdud/ /dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzo legs grub byung rjes gra phyi sman khang du sman rigs sbyor bzo'i ched bla sman pa sku nyid dang las rogs bzod pa lags/ de bzhin las byed phun tshogs bcas pa dog sde phug dang / zi mal la/ rgya ma/o dkar mcho sogs su sngo sman 'thu sgrub gnang bar phebs/ de skabs bla sman pa mchog dang las rogs phun tshogs gnyis po tre/ dkar mtshor sngo sman 'thu sgrub dang sbrags mtsho mjal zhu bar phebs par bla sman pa mchog la mtsho nang las pho brang po tā la dang / yar lung she bo brag de bzhin 7rgyal dbang rin po che'i bzhugs gnas dha ram sa la sku/gas ma codangs ji sku/nga gi lung bstan ya mtshan mang sngo gzigs par gang gi thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' sgrub rgyur sngar las lhag pa'i snying stobs 'phel la gzhan dbang gis bcings pa las grol te/ ma 'ongs rang gzhan gnyis kyi las don legs 'grub sku nga rgyu'i yid ches dang gdung sems kyi re ba'i me tog gsar pa zhig gang gi blo yul gyi rdzing bur gsal ler 'khrungs/me 'brug (ye 'o/ 1976)lor de yang bla sman pa mchog rtsachu brtag thabs la mkhas pas btson khang 'go khrid pa dang / 'phrod bsten mgo khrid pa tshos cangachu

5 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs sku //brtag thabs kyi sman dpe ce ma sgrig bya dathodas pa'i bka' phebs/ bla sman pa mchog nas las ro/na de kho nga gcig pus thag gcadad sku nga thabs med pa ha cang gi gal 'gangs che bar gzigs te de wo na tshags tshud dang gang mkhyodags legs 'grub sku nga ched bathoḍan khang du bzhugs pa'i sman pa drag gras kyi mtshan jo dang lo rgyus rang ljongs su mtshams sbyor snyan zhu gnang / me sprul (ye lo 1977)lor rang skyong ljongs nas bla sman pa gathe sa khyon sman pa nyi shu rtsalnga lhag 'bras spungs su gangs ljongs thodad kyi gasku rig kun btus brtsams pa'i phyag las nang zhugs dgos pa'i re 'ango da zhus pa ltar 'bras spungs su phebs te sman dpe ce ma sgrig gi phyag las nang zhugs/lo 3'i bod zla 10 pa'i nang 7sku'i gcen po sku ngo blo bzang bsam gtan lags rgya gar nas thodad du gzigs skor du phebs skabs bla sman pa ma6)ga dang mjal 'phrad byung / de skabs chod bzang bsam gtan lags nas rgyal yum chen mo/sa bla sman pa thug 'phrad gnang 'dod yod skor dang / yum gyi dgongs don bzhin rgya gar du gung gseng lta bur 'khyug tsam phebs thub pa'i re ba yod ces gsungs lan snyan du phul ba des 'phral rkyen dang / de snga bathergan khang du bzhugs skabs nas 7rgyal ba rin po che dang / btsan byol bod gzhung 'di nyid mjal 'dod kyi thugs re skom pa chu 'asnga da ltar gnang bzhin sku/da pa'i rkyen/ de bzhin ma 'ongs bod mi dmangs kyi rang dbang bskyar gso sogs las don gyi sgo du mar dgongs te sku nyid gang myur rgya gar du zla shas gung gseng lta bur phebs chog pa'i snyan seng zhus/lcags sprel (ye lo 1980)'o/ra krung dbyangs nas rgya gar du phebs bskyod chog pa'i chodag mchan jo ba pa ltar lo de'i zla dgu pa'i nang rgya'4 ba'i sru mo lags dang lhan du bod bal gnyis kyi sa mtshams 'gram brgyud rgya gar du chibs zhal bsgyur/

bla sman bstan 'dzin chodas grags kyi rnam thar 55lcags sprel (ye lo 1980)zla ba bcu par bla sman pa mchog rgya gar hi ma cal dha ram sa lar zhabs sku ra 'kho da cing / slar yang 7rgyal mchodag sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchodag gi gser zhal mjal ba'i skal bzang mngon du gyur/sku nyid kyis thog mar dha sa'i yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang / nyams mtshar ba'i theg chen ho/ brang gi bkod pa dag gzigs skabs thugs dgongs su de snga mjal myong yod pa'i snang ba zhig shar ba dang sbrags de snga bod du mtsho las lung bstan pa'i gnas ma〉〉ga de nyid yin pa 'khrul med gsal bar mkhyen pas yid yul du dad pa'i 'dun pa brtan po zhig lhag tu shar/ de yang 7rgyal dbang rin po ches bla sman pa gang nyid 'di ga rang du bzhugs te rgyal ba'i bla sman gnang rgyu rgyun mthud dang /bod gzhung sman rtsis khang 'di nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel ched sman pa'i 'gan bzhes kyis phyag las gnang dbo sa nga/'i bka' slob gnang ba snying dbus su bcangs te ma 'ongs dka' ngal ji tsam 'phrad rung 'dod don ji bzhin grub pa'i thugs bskyed dam bca' sho je'i ri mo mi 'jigs tsisma 'i mkha' dbus su brtan por bkod par mdzad/bla sman pa mchog gso rig lag len la mkhas par ma zad dngul chu btso bkru'i phyag len thad snu/nga bonams zab snu/ yod pa 7rgyal ba rin po ches mkhyen gyi yod stabs de skabs bla sman par dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzo gnang dgos pa'i dmigs bsal bka' slob phebs/ bla sman pa'i dgongs par gang mgyogs dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzo gnang ste rin chen sman sna khag sbyor bzo thub na 'gro ba nad par phan pa smos ci re zhig sman rtsis khang gi dpal 'byor dka' ngal yang sel thub par nges te 'phral mar dngul chu batherga thal bzo thabs gnang rung / mthun rkyen mi 'dzoms pa'i stabs kyis re zhig phyir 'gyangs chog pa'i re ba ma zhu thabs med byung /

5 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyo gas bsdus bzhugs sku //dngul chu btso thal dang rin chen ril bu'i sbyor bakhro'i sman sna khag thabs shes sku nga thabs dang sman rgyu ngos 'dzin 'cho la sgrub la dmigs te snga rjes su sman pa rgan pa res 'ga' rgya gar sa mtshams su mngags galta nga gnang bar ma zad/ kho nga sku sngo ma sman khyodar las mo gas sman pa lhan du rgya gar lho lhu gas dang / la dgas/ khu nu/ 'bum sde la/ 'bras ljongs sogs hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud dang 'brel ba'i sa gnas khag mang sngo/ra sman rdzas thabs shes dang lnga sman 'thu sgrub la phebs par brten/sgyu sman gyi dka' ngal yang gang 'tshams sel thub pa byung / rgya gar nas thabs shes ma thub pa'i sman rigs rnams ྅ped nas thabs shes gang thub kyis dus yun so/ gcig nang dngul chu btso thal baX ba'i gra sgrig gang legs grub par gnang /chu khyi (ye lo 1982)'o/ra rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas sgyu brang chen mor thengs dang po'i dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzo gnang / de skabs 7rgyal dbang rin sngo che sku sngo ma zhabs bcags gnang bar bla sman pa mchodag nas dngul chu btso thal sbyor bzo'i phyag len skor ngo sprod zhu gnang mdzad par ma zad/ sman pa gzhon skyes dag gce ngo ra dmigs te khyon sman pa rgan gzhon bcu lha ra la lag len dmar khrid dang rgyud don ngo sprod kyis bod kyi gso rig sman gyi cha lag dngul chu btso thal chen mo'i sbyor bakhro'i lag len phyi dar 'di nyid 'phags yul du dbu brnyes par mdzad/dngul chu bathong thal legs grub byung rjes 7rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin rin chen sman sna khag khyodar bzo gnang / 'on te de skabs sman rtsis khang du nad par brtag dpyad gnang mkhan gyi sman pa drag gras re 'ga' las med stabs sku nyid kyi dgongs par sman rtsis khang 'di nyid yar rgyas gtong bar mi re gnyis shig la brten pa ma

bla sman bstan 'dzin chodas grags kyi rnam thar 57yin par tshang mas phyar gru mnyam 'degs kyis hur thag gnang na dge mtshan che bar ma zad 7rgyal ba rin 10 che'i dathodangs bzhed lhan gyis 'grub thub par sku nga bar dgongs te bla sman zur pa ye shes don ldan dang / sman ramasapa blo bzang sgrol ma gnyis sngo/ gdan zhu'i gasku/la 'debs gnang rung gzhan dbang stabs bstun rkyen thugs 'asngo da ji bzhin ma grub/shing byi (ye lo 1984)'o/ra bod sman sbyor bzo'i dka' ngal sel thabs ched bla sman pa mchodag dang sman pa bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal lags gnyis nas gatherga 'gan bzhes cadag glog chas sman rje/ra 'phrul 'khe ra khag gsar 'dzugs gnang bar smano spyo+or gyi dka' ngal sel thub pa sgyu sa ci nad pa mang por bod sman dus thog tu mkha sprad thub pa byung /shing glang (ye so/ 1985)so/ra 14da sman khyab bsgrags ched rgya gar rgyal sa zhe'u rdi lir thodad sman 'grems ston gyis sman khang gsar 'dzugs gnang / de skabs bla sman pa mcho)ga nas rgya gar nad pa mang sngo/ra brtag dpyad kyis sman ba3)sa gnang bar rgya gar mi dmangs kyis gus bkur dang bsngags bcadad cadab/de rjes phyi rgyal du wa da sman dang thodad mi'i chab srid kyi gnas stangs brgyud bsgrags ched a ri dang / dbyin lan/ dbyi kra li/ jar man sku gas su phebs te nad pa mang sngo ra mi 'jigs sku ga sbyin bstsal/ lhag par de skabs skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che'i slob ma kran ril gyi thugs rje'i phro gas ram la brten nas bla sman pa nyid a rir oshese(sa5)5)nad gzhi'i tshogs 'dur zhugs thub pa byung bas/ tshogs 'du'i thog ngo da kyi gso rig las gsungs pa'i yeshese nad gzhi dang cha 'dra ba'i nad rigs yong 'gyur ma 'ongs lung bstan gsal ston yod skor dang

58 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sku///nad gzhi de nyid kyi 'bo/ga thabs bcas pa gsal bshad gnang bar ma zad/ nad gzhi de'i slong rkyen na lugs la sku nyid kyi rnam dpyod dang rgyud kyi dgongs par gzhigs te zhib 'jug dang bcos thabs gnang rgyur gdeng the bas gang 'tshams thob pas/ rgya gar du phyir phebs gnang rjes gso rig rgyud gzhung gi dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i bod sman dga' ba bcu drug 'di nyid gsar du sbyor bzo gnang /rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa sbrul (ye lo 1989)lor bla sman pa mchog snga rjes su rā shi yar rdul phran kha shor ba'i rkyen ngan gyi zug rngus zin pa'i nad pa nyi shu skor la ྅/da sman gyis bathodas thabs gnang bar phan 'bras chen sngo/ byung / de yang rā shi yar rdul phran kha shor bas de'i nad 'bus skye thod du ma'i gzugs khams la gnod pa byung bar ma zad/ rdul phran las mi nyi shu lhag la ches lci ba'i nad kyis zin par rā shi ya'i mnga' sde'i sman khang nas bcos thabs ji 'dra byas rung dge mtshan ma byung / der bla sman pa mchog rā shi yar phebs pa dang skabs 'khel bas sman khang de'i nad pa nyi shu skor la brtag dpyad kyis ba3)sa thabs gnang bar dus yun zla ba gnyis lhag nang nad pa phal che drag bskyed byung bas rā shi ya'i sman pa rnams bod sman la yid ches lhag 'phel byung bar ma zad/ nad de rigs la phan ched rā shi yar bod kyi sman khang zhig 'dzugs dgos pa'i re skul yang zhus/ 'on te phyogs gnyis ya'i dpal 'byor dang sman rgyu'i dka' ngal dang khyad par rā shi ya'i srid dbang 'a'o/ gyur gyi sku langs rkyen pas sman khang 'dzugs thabs ma byung /de rjes slar yang phyi rgyal rgyal khab tu tshan rig tshogs 'du dang / de bzhin 'phrod bsten tshogs 'du khag la zhugs te snga rjes su bcos dka'i gnyan nad epese (4235)dang / gnyan 'bras kun sar (bulas 22)sogs bcos dka'i nad

bla sman bstan 'dzin chodas grags kyi rnam thar 59gzhi'i skor la babo gleng dang / cadad kyi sman gzhung las gsungs pa'i zas ྅ da slob ston/ gzhan yang kho ra yug srung skyodab sogs phyi nang rten 'brel gyi gnad du ma go sla don dodags kyis stsodab stodan gnang bar ma zad/ gzhan tso gas phyo gas re ba'i lta ba zhan par dgag lan tshar bcad kyis rang lugs gasku rig gi ba dan 'di nyid 'dzam gling gi yangs pa'i ba gam gyi steng masngo na par gasku bar mdzad/lhag par phyi nang rgyal khab khag gi nad pa'i nad rigs mi 'dra bar lho sa te snga rjes su bod sman dga' ba16 dang / g.yu dkar/ gcin snyi a ru 18/gcin snyi skyu ru 6/ sug spel 19/ khyung lnga ni la/ khrag rlung ri bo chu 'bebs/'bras nad tsha grang gi sman/ spyi 'joms sman sku gas sman rigs nyi shu lhag sbyor bzo gnang / gzhan yang / ma codangs gamo rig blo gsar rnams la dasku ngas te sman rtsis slob ma rnams la rang cag gso rig rgyud kyi ljags lung dang /'dzam gling bcos dka'i nad gzhi khag gi skor slob stodan gnang ba sogs rang rigs mes po'i gzhung bzang 'di nyid ma 'ongs shul 'dzin rnams la pha chodar bu lag 'alnga ga tshul gyis mdzad pa bskyangs/chu sprel (spyi lo 1992)lo nas bzung bla sman pa ma6)ga gis phyi rgyal rgyal khab khag pha ran si/ 'jar man ni/ nyo hong sogs su phebs te 13da kyi gso rig dang bod don chab srid rgyud bsgrags kyis bstan srid gnyis yar sman pa'i mdzad pa mchog tu bsgrubs/ deng gi char 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen sngo mchog gi bla sman mtshan gnas thog sngo da gzhung sman rtsis 'bo phan gling 'di'i 'gan 'dzin lhan tshogs kyi tshogs zhugs pa/ bod sman sbyor sde khang dang / nyams zhib sde tshan/sman rdzas nyams zhib sde tshan bcas 'gan 'dzin rgon pa/ de bzhin ches ma18re

60 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tso gas bsdus bzhugs sku //sman rtsis cho gas chung gi cho gas gatho'i 'gan bzhes kyis gangs can bstan 'alo/ spyi dang bye brag gling gzhan 'bo/ ba du ma'i 1/na chen sgrub bzhin mchis sku///de ltar gang gi mdzad pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab kyang 'dir rab byung ri zla'i me glang lo yan gyi mdzad rnam cung zad snying po bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bkod pa ni gso rig pad+ma dkar po'i rtsi bcud 'thung ba'i blo gsar rnams dang / dam pa'i mdzad spyod kyi zungs khrag la gces pa'i dad ldan skye bo'i yid dbang mgu ba'i rgyur 'gyur bar sgyu na pa lan brgyar zhu bcad// //

༄༅/ /kun khyab bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod snying bsdus su brjod pa gtsug lag snang brnyan gsal ba'i me 'o/nga bzhugs so///༄༅༅/ /na mo shrīkalatsakraya/dri bral srid gsum kun gsal me 'o/nga ngo ra//sgrib bral rten 'byung gzugs brnyan 'bum brdal te//'khrul bral blang ro/ra nyams 'gyu'i gar bsgyur pa'i//mtha' bral kun khyab bod rtsis rig pa 'phags/ /de la 'dir yul gangs can ljongs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsis rig kyi ngo sprod gsal bsdus shig gleng bar bya ba la/spyir 'dzam gling chen po'i gnas su dar ba'i rtsis rig pa ji snyed cig yod pa 'di kun rang rang sa steng du 'tsho ba'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis rang byung khor yug dang lhan du rtsol sgrub byas pa'i rgyud rim nang myong ba gsog 'jog gis dar zhing 'phel rgyas su song ba zhig yin mod/ bye brag bod kyi rtsis rig pa ni phyi stod 'jig rten gyi go la 'di'i steng lus rten 'tsho ba'i snga mo'i bod mi'i rigs kyis gnam sa gnyis wa'i rten 'brel brtag tshul rig pa'i snu nga ba rmang gzhir byas pa'i steng /'phags yul dang tsi na gathe ra gyur phyi nang rgyal khab khag gi rtsis rig pa'i snying bcud gcig tu bsgril ba'i thun ce/nga ma yin pa'i rtsis rig pa khyad 'phags can zhig yin/ bod kyi rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye dang de dag so so'i don gnad gsal rtogs

62 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdo/sa bzhugs so//gsal rtogs thub pa'i thog rtsis rig pa'i 'byung tshul rgyud rim ji yin mdor bsdus mkhyen thub na gzhi nas thun cesang ma yin pa'i cadad rtsis rig pa'i skor sngo sprod gsal tsam thub nges/ des na 'dir rnam dbye dang byung tshul bcas 'chad don gnyis gzhi rtsar byas pa'i thog bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod gsal bsdus shig bya rgyu yin/ bod rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye zhes pa rtsis rig pa'i rnam grangs kyi dbye ba tsam la go na chog cing / de yang gong du brjod pa ltar bod kyi rtsis rig pa 'di ni rtsis rig pa phal snu/ che'i bcud bsdus pa'i snying sngo gcig yin stabs de'i nang rtsis rig mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig blangs yod pa smos ci dgos/ rgyun du nga tshos bod rtsis rig pa'i rtsaba'i dbye gzhi 'chad pa'i skabs snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa dang / nag rtsis rig pa/ dkar rtsis rig pa zhes pa'i dbye ba gsum du phye ba yin/ da lta'i bod rtsis rig pa ni rig pa 'di gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i rtsis rig pa khyad par can zhig yin stabs rig pa 'di dag so so'i dbye ba la bod rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye zhes gleng 'os/gcig snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye/snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa zhes pa ni snyan brgyud dang brda brgyud (brda sprod yig rigs)gnyis las 10sa pa'i snga mo'i cadad mi rigs kyi (snatsho ba dngos chang nyams khyodang gsog sgrub byas pa'i grangs rtsis rig pa dang brtag thabs rig pa gnyis la bcadad pa yin/dang po/ grangs rtsis rig pa/ grangs rtsis rig pa zhes pa ni 'askra/ ba mi rnams kyis nyin re'i 'cho ba dasngo sa nang nyin grangs dang / so/ grangs/ dus bzhi/ nyi

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 63zla'i bgrod pa/ dasngo sa wa'i kha grangs brtsi ba sogs grangs rkyang kho na brtsi ba'i rig pa la zer bas/ rig pa 'di ni gza' skar gyi 'khor bgrod dang dpal 'byor gyi 'du 'god brtsi ba sogs rtsis rig pa kun gyi rtsab lta bur gyur yod/ da lta'i rtsis grangs rig pa'i nang grangs rtsis rig pa'i mtshon byasang ki'i gzugs 'bri ba'i sku la 'di bod du yig rigs ma dar ba'i bar/ sa dang rdo ba rtsig ngos bcas la thig dang ri snu/ 'bri ba dang / shing rkang phra dum re res grangs masnu na pa'am yang na shing la 'phel kha bdodan pa/ the shing gi phreng ba bajo ba sku gas kyi rig pa 'dra min la ltos nas mtshon byar bed khyodad pa dang stabs bde'i mtshon bya de rigs gzhi rtsar byas pa'i steng 'bri bsnan bsgyur bgos kyi grangs rtsis rig pa'i rmang gzhi bslangs yod/gzhan yang mi'i lus gnas/ spyi gtsug dang / dpral lha / rna ba/ sna/ kha/ ma le bcas kyi dbyibs la lto sa te bdun grangs brtsi ba dang / de la ltos nas zla ba dang 'o/ brtsi ba'i grangs rtsis dar bar ma zad yan lag gyi tshigs chen bcu gnyis la dpe ltos te zla ba bcu gnyis dang / nyi ma'i lho byang bgrod pa gnyis dpyid ston nyin mtshan mnyam gnyis kyi grangs cadas 'dzin pa'i sku la dar/grangs rtsis rig pa dar 'phel bed spyod byung ba des mi rnams kyi nyin re'i 'tsho ba dacadas nang mthun rkyen bzang sngo zhig bskrun sku da la/ rang byung khor yug dang skye dasngo sa 1/gas la brtag dpyad 'cho la zhib byed par rig gsar gal che zhig rnyed yod/ lhag par bod du yig rigs dar rjes dbu med kyi ye ge'i gzugs las grangs gzugs rnyed yod pa ste/ bsnye dang na pa //glu na drug dang ba yig bcas pa'i dbu med kyi yig gzugs mi 'dra ba drug las grangs gzugs byung ba/ dper na/ 'a tshur gyu gcig ces chodag ma'i grangs gzugs ( 1)dang / 'a

5 e pa'i sman rtsis ngapyad yig chu gas bsdus bzhugs sku///ra btags gnyis/(yar) nya ra btags gsum/ (8) 'a phar gyu bzhi/(5)sa rnga ma lnga/(5 ) ra zhabs kyu drug(5) 'a ya btags bdun/(༅mo) ra rang bzhag brgyad/(8 ) la rnga ma dgu/ (9) ba rang gnas thig (0) lha nga pa nyid de/ 1/2/ /ji/5/phyi/7/8/9/༷ bcas rtsa ba'i grangs dgu dang grangs bgrang du med pa gnas mtshon pa'i thig ste deng yongs grags klad kor zhes su 'bod pa'i grangs kyi yi ge bcu'i gzugs dod/ grangs gzugs gsar rnyed byung ba 'dis grangs rtsis rig pa ste/ dpal 'byor rtsis rig pa dang gza' skar gyi bgrod pa brtsi ba'i rig pa gnyis /ra ches stabs bde dang myur lam gsal the gas kyi cha rkyen bskrun spo da/ 'dis phyi gza' skar gyi so/ngas spyod dang nang dbugs kyi rgyu grangs las 'tshar ba'i phyi nang bi dus phra rags sku da do cog yi be (ang thi)bcu wa'i gzugs kyis masnu na par byed pa'i lam nas dus kyi 'a'o/ 'gyur dang phyi nang gi dasngo sa sngo rnam pa sna snurags pa brtsis thub pa byung bar ma zad/ rgyun gtan spyi cho gas khrom ru'i chodag dpal 'byor nyo tshong sogs kyi rtsis rig ji snyed las sla po'i thog brtsi thub pa byung sku/da/ de la kha cig (khyodan gyi lo chen zhwa lu chos skyong bzang po yab sras dang phyis kyi mkhas pa tshe tan zhabs drung sku gas 'awa da de/ tshe tan zhabs drung gis mdzad pa'i rgya rtsis bo wa na las/da lta rgya nag gi grangs rtsis rig par 'bri bzhin pa'iskug rabs kyiphagang ki zhes grags pa 'di'i khungs kyang rgya gar la thug par bshad de/ rgya nag tu gna' dus grangs rtsis rig par 'bri ba'i grangs yig ni ha cang stabs mi bde la/ phyis su a rabs kyi ang yig gcig nas dgu'i bar dang /thig gi mtshon don gor thig 'bri srol 'di dar ba nas bzung shin tu stabs bder gyur bar bshad do/ /'o na da lta dar sku che ba'i ang ki 'di la.a rabs kyisang ki zer don gang yin zhe na/ gna' dus a rabs kyi mis rgya gar gyi ang yig bslabs nas rang yul du 'o/ga pa na rgya gar gyi ang

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 65ki zhes zer la/ a rabs nas rim gyis sku gro ba kyi mis a rabs kyi ang ki zhes bcadad par byed ro// /zhes rgya'i yi ge las byung ba shin tu yid ches pa'i gtam mo / /de bzhin du cadad kyi ang zhi'i 'bri srol 'di yang rgya gar las 'ongs pa nyid de/ rang re'i sngon gyi lo chen zhwa lu chos skyong bzang po yab sras kyisang ki'i phyag bris dngos su mjal ba na/ da lta'i a rabs kyi ang tshugs dang dbyibs so mthun pa'i phyir rang re'i bod kyi bris rgyun gyi ang yig 'di rim gyis cung zad tshugs 'gyur bar snang ba yang rjes su dpog go/ /a rabs ni dus 'khor las bstan pa'i ma kha'i yul khor yug dang bcas pa ste kha che'i ston pa ma hā ma ti'i skye yul rgya nag gi skad dus la po zer ba de'o/ /zhes gsungs so//)gis yodad kyi ang ki'i gzugs rnams rgya gar gyi ang ki'i gzugs las tshur dpe byas pa'i 'thodad tshul smra ba sku gas lugs 'ga' yod mod/ 'di dag gi 'byung tshul dang brgyud rim thad rgyu mtshan 'thad da dung dpyad dgos par snang la/ 'dir snga ma ltar bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs las grub pa'i 'chad tshul gzhir byas pa'ang / snga mo'i dpe rnying bris ma 10gas la gzigs na grangs gzugs de dag yi ge'i gzugs las ji ltar grub pa'i nges pa gsal bar shodags thub/gnyis pa/ brtag thabs rtsis rig pa/ brtag thabs rtsis rig pa zhes pa ni gnam gshis kyi 'gyur ba sku gas nang mi'i lus khams dang nye bar 'brel ba'i phyi stod kyi bya dngos ji snyed cig la brtag dpyad kyis 'byung 'gyur gyi gnad don sngon dpags tshod rtsis thub pa'i rig pa la zer/ 'di la dmang ba sa steng bya rigs skye dngos la brtag pa dang / bar snang char rlung sprin la brtag pa/ mtho ba mkha' yi nyi zla gza' skar la brtag pa sogs kyi rtsis rig pa'i rnam grangs kyi dbye ba ldan la/'di ni snga mo'i bod mi rigs kyis bod yul gyi gnam gshis tsha grang gi 'gyur ba

68 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs sku///rnams sa de'i mkha' la 'khe ra ba'i nyi zla gza' skar gyi babo/da pa la lta sa nas brtag pa byed pa dang / rang byung khams su 'tsho ba'i bya rigs sna tshogs dang skye dngos rtsi shing sogs la ltos te dus dang 'jig rten brtse ba'i rtsis rig pa zhig yin/ rig pa 'di ni bod kyi skar rtsis rig pa'i rmang gzhi lta bu dang rten 'brel gyi gnad ston pa'i thog ma'i sa bon gyi rig pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin comagabartag thabs rig pa'i brgyud rim nang / grangs rtsis rig pa bed spyod kyis nyi ma'i bgrod pa rtogs ched/ nyi rtags rgyabs te cadas 'dzin pa dang dus dus su sgrog pa'i bya rigs kyi skad dang bya rigs de dag gis skyas 'debs pa lha/gas kyi snang tshul la dpyad de zhing las 'debs 'dzugs dang zhing chu 'dren pa/ dper na/ byi'u co gas skad 'byin pa dang thing kyur slebs pa'i dus la brtag ste snga 'debs snga ma zin zhes zhing snga ma rnams 'debs ran par brtsi ba dang / pu shud skad 'don dus la dpyad de bar 'debs snga ma byed pa/ khu byug slebs dus la brtag ste dbyar mabo tshugs pa dang / des skad cher 'byin par brtag ste char che 'bab pa'i dus su brtse bcad/ /gzhan yang mkha' yi rgyu skar la brtag dpyad kyis rgyu skar nyer bdun po re re'i skar dbyibs ngos 'dzin byas yod par ma zad/ de steng nyi zla ji ltar 'khor tshul rags rtsis kyis zla ba'i 'phel 'grib dang nyi ma'i lho byang gi bgrod pa rtsis yod/ dper na/ sros dus skar ma mgo yis nam skyel dus la brtag ste ri dwags ngon pa dang / smin drug sa 'og 'gro zhes nub ri'i sgrib dus la brtag rtse 1/na sa codag la 'debs zin pa sku gas kyi las byed/ skabs 'dir mi rnams kyis phyi skar khyim go lar dpyad zhib byed pa'i rgyud rim thog ma lta bu yin kyang rags rtsis kyi lam nas 'phyugs med cig byung ba ni dngos 'brel ngo mtshar skye 'os su

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 67mchis/ rig pa 'di'i rgyud rim la cadad du yig rigs ma dar ba'i bar brtag thabs rtsis rig pa dang grangs rtsis rig pa gang yang snyan brgyud kyi lam kho nar brten te brgyud sku da pas/ 'di la phyi rabs rnams kyis dmangs khe da god wa'i snu/nga rtsis zhes bswā da pa yin/ yig rigs gsar gtod byung rjes yi ge'i gzugs las grangs gzugs rnyed pa lta ci 'di kun rig pa'i gzhung lu gas su phyogs bsgrigs kyis rnam bshad 'chad nyan kyi rgyun spel thub pa byung ba sogs ni cadad du sngar dar ba'i rtsis rig pa zhig yin no//gnyis/ nag rtsis rig pa/nag rtsis rig pa ni/ snga rabs rgya nas wa'i yul las dar ba'i yongs grags 'byung lnga'i rtsis rig pa zhes pa de dang phyis su nub gling rtsis gsar rgya yul du dar ba nyid bod bsgyur byas pa'i rtsis rig pa la brjod/ de yang 'byung lnga'i rtsis rig la 'gyur snga phyi'i dus dbang gis gsar rnying gnyis su dbye zhing / 'byung tshul thad gdul bya'i gang zag gi mos pa dang / ston pa tha dad pa'i dbang gis thun mong thun min gnyis su 'gyur ba zhib pa lugs 'di'i rtsis rig gi 'byung tshul las shes dgos/spyir 'di'i nang brjod gzhi'i rtsis kun 'byung ba'i bshad pa kho na lī sa ma 'das rung /bye brag 'byung ba rnam lnga'i dbye ba rtsagazhir byas pa'i thog phyi nyi zla gza' skar sogs dang de la ltos pa'i dus kyi rigs/ nang skyes bu'i lus khams bcas pa 'byung lngas ji ltar bsdu tshul gsal bar ston pa'i chodag de dag gi mtshan nyid gtan 'bebs kyis dgra grogs brtsi ba'i rig pa la brten nas gang zag gi che'i bde sdug sna co gas brtsi ba ni 'byung lnga'i rtsis ris pa 'dir ldan pa'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos shig

68 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//yin/ rtsis rig 'di'i nang lo brnyan bcu gnyis dang / spar kha brgyad/ spe ba dgu/ gza' dgu/ dar gud bcu gnyis/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad sogs phyi nang don gyi mtshon bya ji snyed bstan pa de dag gi 'byung khams phyi nang 'gal med du sgrub pa'i tshul gyis dus la 'khor tshul dang dgra cadags brtsi thabs rnam par bzhag ste/mtshon byed gang zag bye brag pa'i 'khrungs rtsis te tshe rabs dang / pho mo 'jig rten mthun sdeb gnyen rjodar/ lo re'i bgegs sel keg bsdudag rtsis/ gtsug lag khang dang / khang pa'i rmang 'ding ba/ zhing sa 'debs pa sogs sa dpyad brtag pa'i rtsis/ gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di nas pha mo la 'das pa gasku na gshin dbye ba 'byed pa'i rtsis/ de bzhin bye brag gi skor 'go dang gab rtse ji snyed pa'i rnam dbye bstan yod do//gsum/ dkar rtsis rig pa/dkar rtsis rig pa ni/ 'byung sa'i yul rgya dkar ba nyid la ltos te btags pa'i rtsis rig pa'i tha snyad cig yin/ 'di la dbye na/ dus 'khor rtsis rig dang /dbyangs 'char ba'i rtsis rig rnam pa gnyis yod/dang po/ dus 'khor rtsis rig ni da lta'i bod rtsis rig pa'i ma lag cig yin par ma zad/ phyi nang rtsis rig pa yod do cog gis khungs bcol tshad thub tu ngos 'dzin chog pa'i rtsis rig cig kyang yin/ rgyu mtshan ni mtha' can gyi rig pa dang /nyi tshe ba'i rig pa/ rtog ge'i rig pa sogs sgrib bcas gyi rig pa kun las 'das shing sgrib bral mtha' kun spangs ba'i rten cing 'brel 'byung gi chos rnams thams cad kyi ji lta'i gnas lugs ji bzhin du gzigs pa'i lam nas bstan pa'i rig

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 69rig gzhung kun gyi dwangs bcud yin pas sku / /'di ni ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bu bathe5ma ldan shākya thub pa macadan par snyu gas pa nas theg pa gsum bstan zin pa'i rjes nag pa'i nya la rtsaba'i rgyud ces pa 'bras bu'i codas gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyud le'u lnga'i bdag nyid can gsungs pa de las phyungs pa phyi 'jig rten khams le las gatho ra ston pa'i nam mkha'i gza' skar gyi bgrod pa rtsis pa'i rig pa yin/ rig pa 'di'i nang phyi nang sdod bcud kun 'byung bzhis ji ltar bskyed bsdu'i tshul gsal ston byas sku da par ma zad/ phyi'i nyi zla gza' skar gyi bcadad pa rags zhib sa ris kyi lam nas brtsi thabs rnam par gzhag ste phra ba de dag gi phan gcadad dang 'byung rim bstan yod/ dus 'khor rtsis rig bod du dar rjes sngar gyi bod rtsis rig pas gza' skar gyi bgrod pa brtsoba'i rig par rgyab rten dang lung rigs tshad thub cig grub pas bod rtsis rig pa 'di bzhin lag len cha tshang rang rkya 'pher ba zhig tu gyur yod/dpal ldan dus 'khor las byung ba'i rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye mdor bsdus gleng na/ khyodan 'alo/ grangs dang grangs kyi gnas dang gza' skar so/ zla dus kyi tha snyad ngos 'dzin pa'i rig pa dang / gza' skar gyi 'khor bgrod bci ba'i rig pa gnyes las/ phyi ma lnga bsdus zhes/ res gza' dang / tshes/ zla skar/ sbyor skar/byed pa bcas dang / gza' lnga'i zhag gsum gyi babo da pa brtsi ba'i rig pa/ sgra gcan dang nyi zla 'dzin tshul/ du mjug gi babo da pa/ dus sbyor/ gnam sa'i go la/ zhag gsum gyi rtsis sku gas sa bcad che chung mi 'dra ba'i dbye tshul ldan pa de dag bod kyi rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang po dag gis lung rigs myong gsum gyi dpyad pas gtan pa phab pa'i rtsis rig pa'i gzhung na gsal/

70 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyobs bsdus bzhugs so//gnyis pa/ dbyangs 'char rtsis rig pa/ dbyangs 'char rtsis rig pa 'di bzhin dus 'kho ra rtsis rig pa'i bye brag cig yin par ma zad/ spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun cadal ma'i rnam sprul dbang phyug dngaskusdu ma gnyis sngo/sa dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du gsungs pa'i 'thod ba'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las brtsi ba'i 'bras bu'i rtsis rig pa zhig yin/ 'di la dbyangs 'char zhes tha snyad gtsor brjod pa'ang / ye ge'i sa cadan dbyangs bcu drug sngo de rnams re re bzhin 'byung bzhi'i ngo bor bsdus te tshes la 'char ba'i snga na gyis smras pa dang / de nyid sngar gyi gza' skar brtsi ba'i rig pa rmang gzhir byas pa'i thog de dag gi byed las las nang bcud 'gro ba'i gzugs phung dang / bya ba sna tshogs pa'i bzang ngan rkyen du ji ltar 'gyur tshul rtsis ba'i rig pa zhig lags/ 'dil/ rus sbal 'khor lo dang / seng gdan 'khor lo/ gdugs 'khor sku/gas rgyun gtan le 1)re nang gsal ba'i 'khor lo6) rigs ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag so sos lo re'i gza' skar gyi bgrod par brten pa'i yul gyi char chodad sogs 'byung bzhi'i phan gcadad dang / rgyal sngo dang yul lung sku gas kyi bde sdug ma cadangs sngon dpag brtsi ba yin no//gsum/ dkar nag dbyangs gsum gyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsgril ba'i bod rtsis rig pa/gong gsal rtsis rig so so'i 'byung tshul gsham du 'chad rgyu dang / 'dir rtsis rig de kun bod du dar rjes dkar nag dbyangs gsum gyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsgril ba'i bod rtsis rig pa'i skor mdo tsam gling na/ dkar nas dbyangs gsum gyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsgril ba'i bod rtsis ri ga pa ni 'dir ngo sprad bya'i bod rtsis

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo spyod / shīrig pa nyid yin cing / 'di'i nang phyi nyi zla gza' skar gyi bgrod pa dang / de la ltos pa'i dus bzhi'i mngon tshul dang gnam gshis tsha grang gi 'gyur ba brtse gzhir byas thog de 'brel nang bcud 'gro ba'i bde sdug blang dor gang yang gsal bar ston pa'i phyi nang rtsis rig pa zhig yin la/ bod kyi gso ba rig pas kha bral du med pa'i gasku thabs rig pa'i ya gyal zhig kyang yin/ rig pa 'di'i nang 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'kho ra dang / mkha' yi nyi zla gza' skar bcas pa'i phyi spyodad kyi 'jig rten dang nang skyes bu'i gzugs phung gnyis 'byung bzhi 'byung lngas ji ltar grub tshul 'gal med gsal bar bstan pa'i 1zug phyi nang gnyis rten cing 'brel ba'i lam nas phra ba dbugs kyi cha shas dang phra mo'i rdul gyis dus dang yul gyi longs spyod brtsi gzhir byas pa'i nyi zla'i bgrod pa dang de las 'byung ba'i dus kyi 'pho gyur dang / phyi dus la lta sa pa'i nang gi rtsarlung thig le'i khams phra rags kyi 'phel 'grib kyang zhib rtsis lam nas bstan sku da ro///rig pa 'di dag gi bsdu tshul la/ 'di kun phyi nang dag pa mnyam du sbyor ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis rig pa'i nang 'du la/ lhag par bod kyi gso rig gtsor gyur phyi nang rig gnas kun dang 'brel ba'i rtsis rig kun gyi rgyu mtshan dang / dka' brgya'i mdud grol ni dus kyi 'khor le'i skar rtsis rig pa kho nar ldan pa'i khyad chod su masngo na zhing / lus nad gnyen sngo bdag nyid gcig par 'brel tshul dang / phyi nang gzhan gsum dag pa mnyam rjodar gyi gnad dag sna gas par med du mi rung ba'i rig pa rtse phud cig yin no/ /

72 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig khyodags bsdus bzhugs so//gsum pa/ bod rtsis rig pa'i byung ba/17da rtsis rig pa'i byung ba zhes pa/ dkar nag dbyangs gsum gyi dbo ngas pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i thun snu nga ma yin pa'i thodad rtsis rig pa 'di thodad mi'i spyi snu gas nang ji ltar dar khyab 'phel rgyas byung ba'i rtsis rig pa'i lo rgyus kyi spyi don zhig la brjod pa yin/ song du bod rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye ji ltar ngo sprod zhus pa ltar ris pa 'di'i byung tshul la'ang / snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa'i byung ba dang nag rtsis rig pa'i byung ba/ dkar rtsis rig pa dang dbyangs 'char rtsis rig bi byung ba bcas rim par gleng ba la/gcig snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa'i byung ba/de yang da lta'i bod rtsis rig pa'i rmang gzhi dang lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim la rtogs zhib byas pa brgyud snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa ni/ bod du 'gro ba mi'i spyi tshogs thog mar chags pa nas bzung de dag so sos rang rang gi 'tsho thabs ched phyi stod rang byung gi kho ra yug dang mnyam gshib ce la sgrub byas pa'i rten dang rten 'byung gi dus rim nang dar ba zhig yin pas/ rig pa 'di nyid thog mar dar ba'i dus mgo'ang bod du mi'i tsho khag nam chags pa de nas bzung na chog 14da kyi srid pa chags pa'i sku/ rgyus kyi yig cha phal mo che'i nang mi sku stong phrag gsum bzhi lhag gi khyodan nas 'gro ba mi dang mi'i chor khag chags sku da par gsungs la/ rang lugs phyag pa'i bzhed pa ltar gyi bod kyi lnga ga ma'i rgyal sngo gnya' khri btsan po (ye sngon 127 la khrir phebs/)drodan dus la dpags na'ang nyung mthar mi 'o/ ste nga phrag gsum lhag gi lo rgyus ldan sku da par sna gas thub/ smra shes don go ba'i mi'i chod khag byung ba dang mi

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 73rnams kyis rang nyid gtan sgyu da bya sa'i sa dang sa 'dir 'khor ba'i nam mkha'i gza' skar dus kyi 'gyur ba gnyis rang rang gi 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel ba ji ltar yod pa'i shes lha gas chodag mar byung bar ma zad/ phan tshun rten tos kyi 'brel ba de'i nang rim pas sa'i dus kyi 'pho gyur dang mkha'i gza' skar gyi 'khor bgrod bar 'brel ba nges gtan zheg sku da pa ngos 'dzin thub/ de yang nyin re'i 'cho ba dngos kyi myong ba'i nang / snang ba da nga mun pa ste nyin dang mtshan ces) masngaran tshul dang 'khor grangs/ dngos polikha grangs/ rang gi lo grangs rtsi ba sogs 'tsho gnas dang thad /ra 'brel ba yod pa'i stabs bde'i grangs rtsis kyi rig pa ste grangs rtsis rig pa zhes pa chodag mar dar 'phel byung bar rtogs nus/gnam sa'i 'pho 'gyur ni 'byung bas grub pa'i phyi cadad kyi nyi zla gza' skar/ rtsi shing skye dngos sogs dang / sa steng bya rigs gcan gzan/ 'bu srin ri dwags sogs nang bcud kyi dngos po'i snang tshul yod do cog gi 'pho 'gyur gyi chos nyid la brjod pa yin pas/ mi'i rigs kyis gnam sa'i bya dngos de rigs dang rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i bar gyi rten 'byung gyi 'brel bar goms 'dris dang shes rtogs byung ba'i rgyud rim nang thog ma'i brtag thabs rig pa zhes pa de nyid dar 'phel byung yod pa'ang / steng nam mkha'i rgyu skar ngos 'dzin gyis de dang de'i 'char nub kyi dus la brtag ste ri dgas rjon pa dang / nya 'dzin pa/ 'og sa steng gi bya gcan ri dwags sku gas kyi 'tsho ba'i spyod tshul la brtag stse phyi'i dus kyi 'gyur ba ngos 'dzin dang de lta'i gnam sa'i khyad chos la brtag ste gangs char rlung 'tshub dang / dro grang sku gas sa 'dir 'kho ra ba'i dus kyi khyad chos la brtag dpyad bya bci rig pa thog ma de dar sku da pa'ang rtogs nus/

71 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig dre gas bsdus bzhugs sku //de yang / ye sngo na 127 'o/ra yul yar klung khul du bod kyi rgyal po thog ma gnya' khri btsan po byon pa dang / de skabs bod mi rigs kyi rang byung khor yug dang dgung mkha'i nyi zla gza' skar la brtag dpyad bya ba'i rig pa sngar las dar rgyas byung bar ma zad/ grangs rtsis rig pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog dngos rigs brje len nyo tshong bya ba'i dpal 'byor rtsis rig kyang dar 'phel ci che byung yod/ lhag par 'di nas brtsis pa'i khri rabs brgyad pa gri gum btsan 1tsware skabs phyi'i gza' skar gyi 'gyur bar ched gnyer brtag dpyad mkhan gyi rigs gcig skar dpyad mkhan yang sku/da par grags/ dus 'di tsam na rgyu skar nyi shu cangabadun las gang 'tshams shig gi skar dbyibs ngos 'dzin rags rtsis zhig byung zin par snang / ye sngon 190 tsam la/ bod rje pu de gung rgyal byon pa dang / khri rabs 'di'i ring blon ru las skyes bya bas zhing 'asngo ga las rigs dang / bzo rigs 'dzugs bskrun gyi las rgya spel bas dpal 'byor rtsis rig thad yar rgyas byung ba smos med khar/ de'i tshe lho kha yar klung khul du ngag rgyun la sku/ngas su grags pa'i rtsis mkhan rgan snu bal me 3sa pa byung bar grags/ rtsis mkhan bal mos gsar rnyed byung ba'i (zu rtsis )zhes pa'i nang zla ba'i dkar nag gi cha shas 'phel grib dang / nyi zla'i lho byang gi bgrod pa brtsi tshul gsal yod par ma zad/ de la ltos te sa la dus kyi 'pho ba dang rang byung khor yug gi 'gyur ba ji ltar byung tshul gyi brtag thabs rig pa'ang gsal yod/grangs rtsis dang brtag thabs rig pas rmang gzhi byas pa'i bod kyi rtsis rig gi 'phel rim 'di bzhin mi'i rigs kyis rang byung khor yug dang bya dngos la shes rtogs zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i rnam rig dang 'brel ba gting zab yod stabs/ ji ltar phyi mo la yul gyi snang ba snang tshul la rgyus mnga' dang dpyad pa bya ba'i mi'i rigs kyi

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 75kyi rnam dpyod je cher song ba de tsam gyis rtsis rig pa'i dpyad pa gting je zab tu 'gyur bzhin sku/da/ de yang lnga ga mar nyin grangs dang / dasngo sa 1/ sku/ so'i kha grangs brtse ba nas rim par zla ba dang 'o/ dus brtsi ba'i rig pa bar 'phel rgyas shes sna gas byung la/ zla ba'i dkar nag gi 'phel grib dang / nyi ma'i lho byang gi bcadad pa/ nam mkha'i rgyu skar gyi 'char nub brtse ba nas rim par de 'brel dus kyi 'aho/ ba dang dus khams kyi khyad snu sa brtsi ba'i bar dar rgyas byung zhing / bo nga gsal rtsis rig gi rmang gzhi 'di kun 1ped du yig rigs ma byung bar pha tsha bu brgyud du snyan nas snyan du brgyud bzhin rgyas spros su song ba zhig yin pas/ dus rim 'di nyid la snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa byung ba'i dus rim zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos pa'ang bod rtsis rig pa'i so/ rgyus 'phel rim gyi dum mtshams shig yin/gnyis/ nag rtsis rig pa'i byung ba/de yang sngar rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye'i skabs brjod zin pa ltar nag rtsis rig pa ni rgya nag yul du dar ba'i 'byung lnga'i rtsis rig gi snying po bod du bsgyur pa'i bod rtsis rig pa'i yan lag cig yin pas/ skabs su rtsis rig 'di nyid thog mar rgya nag yul du ji ltar byung ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus gleng na/ nag rtsis rig par snga mo'i rgya nag nas dar ba'i 'byung lnga'i rtsis rig dang phyis bod dar rgya rtsis gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir yongs khyab 'byung lnga'i rtsis rig 'jig rten du ji ltar 'byung tshul la 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis sku/da de thun sna/nga lugs dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs gnyis so/ /de la dang po thun mongs lugs ltar na/ sku la gtod/ dar rgyas/ shin tu dar rgyas bcas ྅/da 'dir yongs su grags pa'i rgya nag gi chodag

76 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sdud//ma'i rgyal rabs rnams las/ phying gsum/ dhi lnga/ wang gsum zhes bshad pa'i nang tshan phying gsum gyi chodag ma klung dang sngo tha pā ṣi rlung ngam shing gi sku na tan can zhes pas cadag mar 'khe ra rig pa can gyi mdun na 'don rnams la zhi ang du 'byung lnga'i rtsis rig pa'i gzhi ma spar kha brgyad kyi rnam gzhag gsungs par 'dod pa 'di'i dus ni ye sngon 3477 rang nyid khri lo zhe dgu pa'i shing byi lor yin/de yang 'bangs dbe zhang zhi zhes pa zhig gis lho phyogs kyi rgya mchod nas gser mdangs can gyi rus/ sbal spar brgyad sku gas 'byung ba rtsis kyi sko ra 'go'i mtshan nyid/ brda mtshon ri mo yongs su tshang ba zhig rnyed pa rgyal po thā pā ṣi la phul bas des de'i nang tshan spar kha brgyad kyi bde mtshone gyi mtshan nyid cangagand rnams bkral te bshad pa dang / de rjes ye sngon 2817 lor phung gsum pa wang dhi yi'u khyung zhi sa yi sku na tan gyis rang so/ bdun bcu khri lo nga dgu par sngar klung dang pos 'byung ba'i srol btod pa de dar rgyas su btang ste spar brgyad brda rgya bkral ste sme dgu lo 'bo sa bcu gnyis dang / 'byung ba 'o/ mo dbye ba'i lo zla zhag dus sogs kyi brda mtshon mtshan nyid kyi gnad bkral mdzad/ de rjes ye sngon 2177 loraṅgi bzhi pa dhi yo'u tho'u thang zhi yis rang lo so lnga khri lo dang wa'i shing 'brug lor phying dang pos srol btod cing de rjes krung gsum pas dar rgyas mdzad pa de rtsis 'go shing byi nas 'dzin pa'i sku la de shing 'brug nas 'dzin pa'i lha/la btsugs shing shin tu dar rgyas gdodang mdzad par grags pa 'di nas rim gyis brgyud par bzhed/ thun min lugs ltar na/ shes rab kyi lha ma6)ga 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas ye sngon 837 lo'i shing byi sme phreng dang po mgo zla'i nya la rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar lha tshangs pa dang / klu rgyal 'jog po/ lha mo rnam rgyal ma/ bram ze ser skya sogs

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 7lha mi klu yi 'khor rnams la 'byung ba'i rtsis kyi skor 'go brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs par grags pa de las rim gyis brgyud par 'asnga da pa yin te/de yang dus rtsis lnga mtshar nyi ma las/ lha rgyal tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa// klu rgyal dga' bo 'jog po dang / /lha mo rnam rgyal bram ze'i rigs/ /ser skya zhu ba bzhi zhes dang / phyag na ye shes mda' the che/ /bsnams pa'i bo nga tse 'phrul rgyal dang / /ji kong ji nong wang the sogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thog mar 'khor gyi gtso bo tshangs pa gdong bzhi par rgyud lung 'grel pa man ngag dang / ṭi ka snang gsal ma bu lnga / /dmag dang ru mtshon 'dab pa// nyi zla gza' skar ji ltar brtsi ba'i tshul bcas gsungs pa dang / lha mo rnam rgyal mar rus sbal rang 'dra'i rgyud dang gi gong bag ma'i rtsis gsungs/ klu rgyal 'jog sngo la rus sbal gyi gtan tshigs rang dran skye gnas kyi rgyud dang / rten cing 'brel ba'i rgyud dang de'i phyi ma ljon shing lo tog 'tshol dang / khrus byang gi rgyud/ byis pa btsas klungs la sogs pa gsungs/ bram ze ser skyar 'byung ba mtshan don bstan pa'i mdo dang phyi ma yi ge'i mdo 'grel pa/ de'i phyi ma mtshan gyi don bstan pa'i mdo/ kha bskang bye brag 'byed pa'i rgyud 14gas gtsug lag rtsis kyi skor 'bo mtha' yas pa zhu ba 14 sku sku ra legs par bstan/ de las mi'i 'alta ra gyi thog ma kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po ni lcags khyi ye sngon 551 lor 'khrungs/ 'dis rtsis kyi ston pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur 'gyur pa mjal ba tsam gyis dpyad brgyad khri bzhi lha nga sum brgya drug cu rang bzhin babs kyis thugs su chud par grags la/ 'jam dpal thugs kyi rgyud lha/gas calaba'i rgyud lnga'ang kong rtse 'phrul rgyal nyid la bstan pa de yang rim par ji kong dang /ji nong / wang the bcas 'phrul mi gsum dang / bde bar len/ nye bar len/

78 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tshulags bsdus bzhugs mo //kun tu len/ yang dag len te len pa po bzhi/ de'i rjes drang srong phur bu dang /drang srong lce mur/ drang srong mur ti/ drang srong thor cog bzhi ste 'chang ba po bzhi las rim par brgyud de phyis cadab dasngo na du ha ra nag sngo dang / paṇa chen rā hu dmar sngo / zla ba nag 1/ sku gas las rim par brgyud/de yang / gtsug lag 'byung ba'i rtsis rgyud 'di bzhin rang cag bod du chos rgyal gnam ri srong btsan dus su dar bar grags kyang / de'i tshe bod byings kyis bathodal thub pa'i yi ge med pas bstan bcadas 'di zhes gleng du med/ de na chos rgyal sku nga btsan skabs dngos su dar ba sku ngas grags la chodas rgyal 'di'i sku ring la thodad kyi 'o/ tsā ba'i jo ga ma jo na mi saṃ lho ṭas sngo da yig gsar gtod kyis rgya dkar yul nas nang chodas chodag mar bod du bsgyur bar ma zad 'di tshe rgya nag yul du dar ba'i dkar po'i chos dang rgyal ba'i rten gtso rnams bod du 'dren par dmigs te thang rgyal wa'i sras mo rgya bza' kong jo khab tu bzhes pa dang lhan 'byung ba'i rtsis rig ji snyed bod du bsgyur par grags pa 'di ni rtsis rig pa snga 'gyur thog mar 'dod/ye so/ bdun brgya tsam gyi nang 14da rgyal khri rabs sku/ bdun pa chos rgyal mes ag tshom gyi btsun mo la rgya bza' ang chung bzhes pa'i dus/ 'byung ba lnga 'gyur dang / spar kha'i ser lnga ga spe ba dmar nag sogs rgyud bdun le lag bcas pa bod du bsgyur/ ye lo 790 brgyad cu skor dgu pa'i phreng gsum pa'i lcags rta lor chos rgyal khri sku nga lde btsan byon/ khri rabs 'di'i sku ring la gsang thub ras skyes gtsug na dang / li khri mabo na skya zhes pa'i ༷/da kyi 'o/ nya gnyis rgya nag tu mngags te rgya'i stsodab dasngo/na mkhas pa sems brtse gdan drangs/ cadab dpon 'dis bod kyi sa bkra brtag pa'i don du sa dpyad kyi rtsis ji snyed gsungs/ de rjes lang

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo spyod / 79snu dong yag dang g.yu sgra bzher lha/gas cha/da kyi mkhas pa mi bzhi rgya nag tu rgya paṇa dar chen thig le 'am ting tsho gdan drangs phyir mngags/ de'i tshe slob dpon dar chen dang paṇa chen du ha ra nag 1/sa gatho sa/ mahwa yā na su tra/ mahā rā dza de ba/lo tsa in+d+ra bha bho/ bi rje btsan po shi la ha rnams dang / bod mkhas khams khra dang po/ lang tsho ldong yag g.yu sgra bzher/ khu shog mkhan/ rgya g.yu bza' dang bcas pa byon te 'jam dbyangs kyi gtsug lag phal mo che sngo da du bsgyur/ khyad par slob dasngo na du har nag sngo sa 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs la drang srong gi bka' lung zab mo ma lus pa thob/ 'dis rtsis gzhung thun mong ba rnams bsgyur/ lha da kyi yul gyi sa bdag gdug pa can btul/ (rin chen gsal ba'i sgron me )zhes bya ba'i rtsis gzhung chen mo mdzad de bram ze ma mu tig zur phud lnga ma dang / g.yu shar/ stag tshang sogs mngon par shes pa bzhi la gdams pa dang de dag gis rgya paṇa rā hu dmar po dang / paṇa chen zla ba nag po gnyis la gdams/de rjes bod kyi lo tsā ba kham khra gnyis pas bod skad du bsgyur/ kham khra 'dis (yang 'gyur gsal ba'i sgron me )zhes pa mdzad la de las spros pa (gsal sgron man ngag bsdus pa )dang (rtsab skabs don lnga pa gsal sgron sbas bcad lugs )sogs mdzad de 'phan yul ral bhe ra babla dang / ya tsa ba/ bho brag pa mar pa sprul mgo/ mal ze glan dang / se ston khri pa/ smyos ston rgya yod/ rgya ston chos kyi rin chen/ zhang bcas la gdams/ (gsal sgron man ngag bsdus pa )ni 'phan yul ral ste ra bams ru mtshams mo ngas pa smon lam la gnang ba kun la khyab par spel bar grags pa dang / (gsal sgron sbas bcad med pa'i yang dag lugs )ni zhang nas slob ma mkhas pa'i khyu mchog khyung nag shāka dar la gsungs pa dang de nas

80 i pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig khyodags bsdus bzhugs so//rim par mi nyag rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / sngags pa lhun grub dpa' lnga dang de yi bla ma mkhas grub pa/ mkhas ma6)ga ar+ya de wa/ mtshungs med chod gros/ phug pa dpal mabo na 'phrin las/ bde legs gar dbang phun tshogs/ rigs 'dzin gachodan nu gawa nga drug zur chen chodas dbyings rang cadal/ thams cad mkhyen pa chod bzang rgya masnur bcas dang / yang dpal mgon 'phrin las nas/ phug pa dpal gyi seṅge dang / g.yu lo/ gnyags ban na ra ba/ de nas zur chen chos dbyings rang grol dang / yang ar+ya de wa nas dus rams pa don grub kun dga'/ dge bsnyen bsku da nams tshe 'dzin/ slob dpon bsku da nams grags pa/ 6)sa rje phun tshogs dge dbang / mkhas grub dpal gyi seng ge/ ldum sngo don grub dbang rgyal/'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho so gas rtsis rig bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams la rim par brgyud pa 'di dag ni nag rtsis rig pa bod du ji ltar byon pa'i 'byung rims gnad bsdus yin/nag rtsis rig pa bod du dar rjes bod kyi snga mo'i rtsis rig de bzhin 'byung lnga'i rtsis rig gi dpyad pa'i lam nas dus dang 'jig rten rtsi ba'i rig pa bsdon ma zhig chodab/ ye lo 964 lor sngar chos rgyal khri sku/nga skabs rgya nag yul du slob dpon dar chen thig le gdan 'dren du byon pa'i lang tsho ldong yag ces pa'i thodad kyi mkhas pa de nyid kyi rigs tsho mdo khams su chags pa las mi rgyud bzhi pa mi nyag rgyal mtshan dpal zhes pa mdo khams nas dbus phyogs su byon pa gasku/ra po gra nang gi phyag pa (tse/ dkar brag phug)zhig la brten nas bzhugs pas phug pa zhes pa'i ming yang der brten nas byung bas de ni rang lugs phug pa'i brgyud pa thog ma yin/ mi shig rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis khyung nag shāka dar las gsal

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sgrod / 81sgron la sogs 'byung ba'i rtsis kyi bstan bathegs la mkhas par bslabs par ma zad/sngo da kyi rang byung khe ra yug dang 'tshams pa'i dus kyi khyad ce)sa gnam g.yis bcas la brtag dpyad kyis bod kyi snga mo'i rtsis rig 'di bzhin 'byung ba'i rtsis rig dang zung rjodar gyis brtse thabs dus gzer man ngag gis brgyan te phyi rgyud 'dzin pa sngags pa lhan grub dpa' thod sogs la gnang /gsum pa/ dkar rtsis rig pa'i byung ba/dkar rtsis rig pa/ zhes pa rgya dkar nas dar ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor 'o'i rtsis rig dang dbyangs 'char rtsis rig gnyis yin te/ de las dang po dus 'khor rtsis rig ji ltar dar ba'i byung rim gnad bsdus gleng ba la/ de yang sa paṇa sogs rig gnas che chung gi rnam gzhag 'chad pa 1(re ༷/da mkhas snga ma 'ga' zhig gis phyi rol rig byed lugs kyi rig nga 'i gnas bco brgyad la dpe mdzad de/ skar rtsis rig pa 'di bzhin rig gnas chung ba'i khongs bgrang mdzad pa der gzhi bcol nas/ phyi rabs pa phal gyis rtsis rig pa 'di nyid rig pa'i gnas chung ba'i rnam gzhag skar rtsis khongs bgrang rkyang mdzad bzhin 'dug pa des bod rtsis rig pa spyi la ma khyab ste/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa ni phyi rol pa'i skar dbya/da brtag pa 'i rtsis dang grangs tsam brtsi ba'i rig pa tsam las/ dpal dus kyi 'khongari 'o'i gzhung las gsungs pa 'i rtsis rig dang lhag par thun min bod kyi kun khyab rten 'byung rtsis rig la de bas khyab tu med/ dang la dus kyi 'khor lo ni nang don rig pa gnad che zhig ste sangs rgyas dacadas kyis gsungs pa'i chos rnams masnga sngags gnyis su dbye ba las/ sngags la'ang rgyud sde bzhi ste/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor

81 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tre gas bsdus bzhugs so//rgyud/ rnal 'aX ra bla med rgyud ces yongs su grags pa las bla med rgyud der/ thabs kyi rgyud ngang / shes rab rgyud/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum las gnyis su med pa'i rgyud nyid yin/ rgyud 'di las phyungs pa'i rtsis rig pa ni rgyud kyi le'u kun dang 'brel bas na/ rtsis rig pa 'di bzhin nang snga na rig pa'i khongs su 'du ba bston med yin/ de la dus 'khor rtsis rig gi gzhung dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ji ltar dar ba dang brgyud pa'i rim pa las/ dang po/ chos 'di nyid kyi ston pa ni thub pa'i dbang sngo/ shākya thub pa yin te/ so/ rgyus sku/ngas grags su ston pa mya ngan las 'dang kha (ye spyodan 881)lcags 'brug nag pa'i nyar rgya gar lho ༷ gas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su 'khor gyi gtso bo sham bha la'i rgyal po zla ba bzang pos ga3 sa rgyal phran dgu bcu cangadrug gi rgyal sngo rnams kyis zhus te gsungs/ rgyud gsungs pa'i phyi so/ra snu sa rgyal zla ba bzang sngo sa rtsaba'i rgyud stodang phrag bcu gnyis mdzad de/ sham bha la'i rgyal brgyud phyi ma sras lha dbang la gdams pa dang de nas rim par chodas rgyal bdun dang / rigs ldan thog ma 'jam dpal grags pa bar brgyud la rigs ldan 'dis rtsaba'i rgyud las bsdus pa'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis/da lta nga tsho'i mig lam du mjal rgyu yod pa'i bka' bstan gral du bzhugs pa 'di mdzad de rim par rigs ldan nyer gcig pa ma 'gag pa'i bar brgyud/de lta'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud 'di nyid lto gling 'dir thog mar ji ltar dar zhe na/ yongs su grags pa rab byung dang wa'i me yos (ye lo 1027)lor dus 'kho ra 'phags thodad du dus mnyam par dar ba'i bzhed pa ltar na/ sham bha la'i khri rabs 'dzin pa rigs ldan rgyal dka'i khri lo rtsodags pa rigs ldan nyi ma gser khrir ma phebs pa'i dus tsam na/ rgya gar gyi paṇa ṭi ta byang sems tsi lu pa dang dus

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 83zhabs pa sku gas kyis sham lha la'i rigs ldan las gsan pa 14da kyi so/ tsā ba gyi chog zla ba'i cordod zer dang / rwa cesas rab/ kha che paṇa chen sku/gas kyis bsgyur te 'chad nyan sgrub pa'i sgo nas dus 'kho ra gyi bstan pa rin po che 'u cag kha ba'i ljo ngas su spel ba las rim par dar/ dpal dus kyi 'kho ra 'o'i 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa cadad du dar ba nas bzung / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis rig 'dis snga mo'i bod rtsis rig pa dang nag rtsis rig pa zung du 'jug pa'i bod rtsis rig pa la rgyab rten lung rigs tshad thub cig grub par brten/ cadad rtsis rig pa 'di bzhin lag len cha tshang rang rkya 'pher ba zhig tu gyur sku da thod/ /bzhi pa/ dbyangs 'char rtsis rig pa/de yang rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye ltar dbyangs 'char rtsis rig 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung nas bstan pa'i dbyangs 'char rtsis rig pa dang / phyi rol rjes mthun gyi dbyangs 'char rtsis rig gnyis yod pa las snga ma'i byung tshul ni dus 'khor rtsis rig gi byung rim dang gcig yin pas/ 'dir phyi ma thun mong rig byed lugs dang cha mthun spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun lha la ma'i rnam sprul lha chen yab yum gnyis kyis dri ba dris lan tshul du gsungs pa'i dbyangs 'char gyi 'byung tshul gnad bsdus 'chad pa la gsum/ lha'i yul du dar tshul dang / mi'i yul du byon tshul/ khyad par gangs ljongs kha ba'i yul du brgyud tshul lo/ /dang po/ lha'i yul du dar tshul ni/ de yang dbyangs 'char bstan bcos kun gyi ma phyi dpal g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud ces phyi ltar lha chen sngo dbang

81 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig khyodags bsdus bzhugs so//phyug dang lha mo u ma gnyis dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du gsungs pa'i gzhung lugs che gras zhig yin cing / de nang dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud 'di thog mar lha yi yul du dar tshul gyi gnas lugs gsal bar gsungs sku/da pa'ang / de nyid las/ sngon tshe lha dang lha min das /ba spu ldang ba'i g.yul 'gyed tshe// lha yi dbang pos bdag la dris/ /'di bshad lha min pham par byas/ /bstan bcos gsang ba chen 1rware rgyud/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon gyi tshe brgya byin la sku gas pa'i sum cu rtsagasum pa'i lha gnas kyi lha rnams dang lha ma yin phan tshun g.yul 'gyed pa'i tshe/ lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis lha dang 'byung po'i tshogs kun drag po'i g.yul las skyob pa'i phyir/ drang srong chen po me lha ri bo gangs can na bzhugs lha chen po /thab yum gyi drung du 'o/ nyar mngags te lha ma yin gyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i thabs zhus pa de tshe dbang phyug chen pos kyang lha dang 'byung ༷/ g.yul las skyob phyir dpal g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud ces pa'i dbyangs 'char ba'i rgyud 'di bstan pa lda rnams kyis lag tu blangs pri sa/ lha min gyi dmag dpung bzlog par gyur pa de nas bzung bstan bcos 'di nyid lha'i yul du dar b.ragrags sa/ /gnyis pa/ mi'i yul du dar tshul ni/ de yang / dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud 'di nyid mi yul du byon pa'i dus ni mi rnams tshe lo brgya dang nyi shu thub pa'i dus su nges ste bstan bcos 'di nyid bklags pas gsal zhing / de rjes rim par phyi nang thun mong gi gnas mchog ri bo gangs can nam gangs kyi ri la phyi ltar na lha'i gtso bo dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo u ma gnyis/ gsang ba lta ra na spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma yab yum zung gis lha dang / mi dang drang srong sogs phyi nang

bod rtsis rig pa'i ngo sprod / 85thun mong gi gdul bya'i ngor sngar lha'i yul du bstan pa'i bstan bcos chen po g.yul rgyal gyi gzhi drangs te yum chen snu/sa thabs mkhas pa'i tshul gyis zhus pa dang / lha na pa nyid kyis kyang 'jig rten blang sngo ra gyi gnas gsal ba'i phyir rgyud rgyas pa las btus pa'i tshul gyis gdul bya'i chod sngo dang 'tshams pa'i bstan bcos dbyangs 'char rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid gsungs/ khyad par mi'i 'khor gyi gathorwa ba grub thob lugriṇ+ḍal yid gus zhes nga sa spyan drangs te 'dzam gling 'phags pa'i yul du thog mar dar bar byas shing / 'phags pa'i yul 'dir man ngag lag len nyams bzhes mdzad mkhas brgyud pa'i drang srong ji snyed cig byon pa rnams kyis dgongs 'grel bstan bcos man ngag kyang lu gu brgyud du mdzad par grags so/ /gsum pa/ khyad par gangs ljongs kha ba'i yul du brgyud tshul ni/ de la bod kha ba'i yul du brgyud tshul ni dus rabs bcu gnyis tsam gyi nang 'dzum lang gi mkhan po paṇa ṭi ta dza ya ā nan ta dang / bod kyi glo bo lo tsā ba gnyis kyis thog mar bsgyur cing de las rim par bla ma chos rje dang slob dpon rin chen rgyal po/ slob dpon rin chen dbang phyug bla ma gzhon nu rin chen/ sngags 'chang lhun grub dpal sku/gas brgyud pa'i bla ma bcu las dus zhabs dpal mabonan 'phrin las bar dang / de las mkhas pa dpal gyi seṅge/ bla mkhyen g.yu 'o/ ba/ gnyags ban ngag dbang 'jam dpal lho gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ma63ga dang / de las brgyud tshul rim pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis cig car du brgyud cing /khyad par dbyangs 'char kun gzigs chen mo lta bu zab mo dag snang gi tshul du byung ba'ang yod de/ kun gzigs dbyangs 'char chen mo shel gyi me long mdzad pa po 'jam masku na mi pham pa nyid kyis/ dpa la g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud don

86 na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs so//rab tu gsal ba'i ngag gi babo da pa kun gzigs dbyangs 'char chen sngo shel gyi me long zhes bya ba skabs lnga pa'i bdag nyid can 'di ni rang nyid chung ngu'i dus nas gzhung 'di la shin tu dga' bas cung zad sbyangs shing / rang lo bcu dgu par dbus gtsang cadags su gnas lha ra la phyin tshe rmi lam du kun gzigs dbyangs 'char chen mo shel gyi me 'o/nga zhes bya ba'i po ti rnyed nas glo ga par rmis pa sku gas rten 'byung dge bar bsam zhing / zhes sku gas gsungs pa lta bu rang re gang zag phal pa'i blo yul 'das pa'i tshul yang gzhung 'dir gzigs na mkhyen par nges sku// /mjug bsdu/ de ltar gangs ljongs kha ba'i yul gyi rtsis rig pa'i rnam dbye dang 'byung tshul lo rgyus gnad bsdus su brjod pa 'di bzhin rtsis rig par don gnyer mkhan gyi blo gsar rnams nas gtsug lag rtsis kyi byung rim 'o/ rgyus khungs dag rtogs slad/ cung zad go sla'i ngag gis brjod pa'ang bod rtsis rig pa spyi dang khyad par zab mo dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis rig pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig gu/ zhes pa 'di'ang rtsis rig smra ba'i gral 'dzin e pas rab gnas chu lug lo'i nag zlar sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //

༄thorgya/ /nyes pa gsum gyi ldang dus skor la cung zad dpyad pa blo gsar rig sgo 'byed pa'i lde'u mig bzhugs so//8rdzosustiḥ dpal ldan dang 1rware sangs rgyas dang //bla ma sman pa'i lhar btud de//gso rig rgyud chen las gsungs pa'i//nyes pa'i ldang dus cung zhig gleng //de la 'dir gso ba rig pa'i man ngag dpal ldan rtsaba'i rgyud kyi le'u gsum pa gnas lugs nad gzhi'i le'u las/ nyes pa rlung mkhris bad gan gsum wa'i ldang dus gsungs pa 'di'i dus kyi sgo ra la rang mnyam grogs dag 'jug pa bde bar yong ched cung zad brjod par bya ste/ rgyud las/ rlung med dbyar dus dgong dang tho rengs ldang / /mkhris pa ston dus nyin dgung mtshan dgung ldang / /bad yin dpyid dus srod dang snga dro ldang / /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid gsal bar rtogs par bya ba la/ chodag mar dbyar la sku gas pa'i dus bzhi dang / dgong la sku gas pa'i dus bcu gnyis po lnga'is 'dzin tshul dang / brtsi tshul/ 'khor tshul/ gzhan yang dus so so'i phyi nang gi khyad chos gang yin nges par du mkhyen dgos pa ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin no/ /de yang nang shen pa mi'i lus ༄6) nad gso bar 'alhund pa'i gang zag gis nges par phyi rten gyi dus ngos 'dzin dang de'i mtshan nyid la bslab dgos te/ rgyu mtshan ni phyi nang gnyis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnad du nges pa'i

80 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig dre gas bsdus bzhugs so///phyir te/ nang yul can phra ba'i 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi rnam par shes pa'i 'dus phung du grub pa'i 'byung ba dag dang phyi yul snang rags pa'i 'byung ba dang 'brel zhing / des nang gi las/ skye ba/ dar ba/ gud pa sku gas la dgra grogs su 'gyur ba yin pa'ang / nang las snang dang 'grogs pa'i 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi rnam par shes pa'i 'byung ba sna tshogs la brten nas phyi yul du rags pa 'byung ba'i 'gyur ba sna tshogs masngo na pa dang / phyi yul gyi 'byung ba'i 'gyur ba sna cho gas la brten nas nang yul can yid lus phung por bde sdug gi 'bras bu mi 'dra bar mngon zhing sbyin par byed pas so/ /co/ na/ phyi'i 'byung ba'i 'gyur ba rnams gang la te+os nas sngags bzung dgos sam snyam na/ de ni dus la brten pas dus brtsi thabs khe/ nar brten nas de'i mtshan nyid shes dgos shing / brtsi thabs de la brten nas phyi 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid the gas pa yin/ mdor na/ phyi phro la dus kyi brtsi thabs shes pas phyi 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi 'gyur ba rtogs/ phyi 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi 'gyur ba rtogs pas des gi nga mi'i lus rten gyi 'byung bar dgra grogs kyi las bya tshul rtogs/ de rtogs pas nyes pa rlung mkhris bad gan gsum wa'i 'phel zad 'khrug gsum gyi gnad shes pa smos ci/ rang rang gi mtshan nyid dang 'brel ba'i ldang dus kyang shes thub pa yin no/ /gnad de dag la ltos nas nges par phyi dus kyi ngos 'dzin/ brtsi thabs/ 'khor tshul sogs skabs 'dir gleng gzhir gyur pa yin te/ da ni gleng bya dngos bshad pa la gsum las/ dang po/ dus kyi mtshan nyid dang gzhal tshul/ dbye bsdu bstan pa/ gnyis pa/ dus kyi 'bor tshul bshad pa/ gsum pa/ nad kyi ldang dus brjad pas mjug bsdu ba'/ /

nyes pa gsum ldang dus skor / 89dang po/ dus zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid bstan pa la/ rgyud ro/na snying bsdus zla zer las/ dus ni skad cig phung pos grub/ /bzhi drug bcu gnyis drug cu bcas/ /skad cig nyid dang dbugs la sogs/ /bsags pa'i grangs kyi chu tshod de/ /nam langs yos nas stag rdzogs par/ /rim par dbye bas cha bcas mthong //zhes gsungs par/ dus zhes bya ba ni thung mtha' skad cig ma la sogs pa'i cha dang / chu srang / chu tshod/ nyin zhag zla ba/ so// bskal ba sogs dang / de yang zla zer las/ gang phyir rgyu rkyen tshogs pa yi/ /gnas skabs dag la de dang de'i//du+os su brjod pa ma gtogs pa/ /dus zhes bya ba gzhan na med/ /ces gsungs sa/ /gnyis pa/ dus kyi phung wa'i tshad gzhal tshul 'di la mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel so so cung zad mi 'dra tsam yod kyang / 'dir skad cig ma'i tshad brtsi tshul mdor bstan dang / dbugs las byung ba'i dus kyi cha gzhan rnams kyi tshad brtsi tshul rgyas par bshad par bya'/ /dang po/ skad cig ma'i tshad dang de las dus kyi phung po gzhan gyi char tshad ji ltar 'gyur tshul ni/ kun mkhyen chos rje yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod 'grel du/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma ste se gol gyi/ /drug cu rtsabazhi'i cha gcig brgya nyi shu /de yi skad cig drug cu thang gcig ste/ /sum cu yud tsam sum cu nyin zhag gcig /ces gsungs te dus kyi thung mthar nges pa skad cig ma zhes pa gang zhe na/ de ni skyes bu dar ma khams snyoms pa'i mthe bong dang / gung mo'i tshigs mgo gnyis brdar ba las thon pa'i sgra'i yun la brjod de/ de lta bu'i sgra'i yun de brgya nyi shur byas pa'i drug cu rtsabazhi'i cha gcig gi yun skad cig ma gcig gi yun yin/

90 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs sku //de 'dra'i skad cig ma drug cu la thang gcig dang thang sum cur yud tsam gcig de sum cur nyin zhag gcig gi tshad du gsungs sku / /gnyis pa/ dbugs las byung ba'i dus kyi cha rnams kyi brtsi tshul rgyas par bshad pa la/ dbugs zhes pa ni/ skyes bu nad med dar ma khams snyoms pa'i dbugs btang 'jug gnas gsum gyi yun la brjod de/ de la dbugs 'jug ces pa dbugs phyi nas nang du 'then pa'i yun dang / dbugs gnas zhes pa dbugs 'then pa de nyid lus nang du gnas pa'i yun/ btang zhes pa gnas pa de nyid phyi rol tu byung ba'i yun no/ /de lta bu'i dbugs gcig ni dus mtha'i skad cig ma sum brgya'i grangs dang ldan la dus mtha'i skad cig ma sum brgya tshan pa drug gam dbugs drug gi tshad la chu srang gcig chu srang drug cu la chu tshod gcig gi tshad du nges shing / chu tshod kyi ring thung cha las nyin dang mtshan mo / dus bzhi/ dus drug dus bcu gnyis sogs kyi tshad du 'gyur ba yin/ de las nyin dang mtshan mo'i rnam dbye dang yun tshad kyi brtsi tshul gang zhe na/ nyin mo zhes pa nyin mo'i 'od kyis gling so sor bya ba byed tshul la ltos te gling de dang de'i nyin mo zhes dang / mun pas bya ba byed tshul la ltos te gling de dang de'i mtshan mo zhes brjod do/ /de yang nyin sna re 1/ga ma ni nam langs lag ris nges gsal tsam nas dgong dro nyi ma nub pa'i bar la nyin mo'i tshad du 'dzin pa yin/ dper na/ 'dzam gling chung ngu lho gling dbus mar nyi ma'i 'od kyi kha lo skya rings 'char bar brtsams pas de la ltos te lag pa'i lag ris gsal bar nges tshe nam langs kyi dus nyid dang / nyi nub ni nyi 'od bho gling dbus ma nas bzhud pa dang lhan lho gling dbus 'dir mun pa'i mgo rtsom pa'i rnam par bzhag ste/ gling phyi ma byang gling du nam langs pa ste nyi 'od

nyes pa gsum ldang dus skor / 91kyi bya ba rtsom pa'i mgo tshugs grabs byed do/ /('di la nyi ma'i lto byang gi bgrod pa'i dbang gis ring thung cha sna tshogs su 'gyur ro/) mtshan mo zhes bya ba ni nyi nub (nyi ma nub pa la nyi nub ces bsgyurd/)nas ྅rtegs pa nam langs la nye ba'i dus te tho rengs kyi yun rdzogs pa'i bar du nges/ de yang nyi 'od kyis gling gang du bya ba byed pa'i gling der nyin mo dang / de'i ldog phyogs gling gzhan du mun pas bya ba byed pas mtshan mo zhes bcadad do//de la nyin mtshan gnyis 'byung tshul la (rnam 'grel gser shing /)las nyin mtshan gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyu la/ kha cig na re/ ri rab kyis bsgribs pa dang ma bsgribs pa'i khyad par zhes zer/ de ltar na gling 'di'i byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i nam phyed kyi lto gling gsum tsam ma gtogs gling lhag ma dgu por nyi mas khyab par thal/ ri rab kyis bsgribs pa las mtshan mo 'byung ba gang zhig de'i tshe gling dgu wa3 dag lhun pos sgrib mi nus pa'i phyir te/ de'i tshe nyi ma sgra mi snyan gyi thad ma'i me ri la shin tu nye bas ri rab kyi grib ma rgya chung dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /mabar 'dod mi nus te/ lam phyed 'khor thag ring por song bas ma mngon pa nub la/ 'char ba na nye bar gyur zer ro/ /de lta na nub pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor je chung du song ba sogs dgos na/ de ltar ma mthong ba'i phyir mi rigs so/ /des na sngar thig gi skabs su bshad pa'i mthong gang gi nam mkha' zlum wa'i snang ba 'di'i nang du nam tshud pa'i tshe rang rang gi yul du 'char zhing / 'thon pa'i tshe nub par 'gyur ro/ /'on te/ dbang ler/ tho rengs nas ni grib ma'i mtha'/ /zhes gsungs pas nam langs nas nyi ma shar gyi bar dang / nyi ma nub nas sa sku/da kyi bar mthong gang nam mkha'i khongs su bsdu ste/ nyi ma'i byed las snang ba'i phyogs
