nyes pa gsum ldang dus skor / 93ste chu tshod bcu gnyis dang / skar ma nyer brgyad yun la nyi ma'i 'od kyis gling 'dir bya ba byed pas gling 'di'i nyin mo'i tshad du 'gyur la/ de rjes nyi 'od nub pa dang chu tshod bcu gcig dang skar ma sku/ gnyis 'das mtshams nam langs pas de bar mun gyi bya ba byed pas mtshan ces) tshad du 'gyur ba yin/(rig pa 'dis zhag ma sum brgya drug cu la rig 'gre ste zhag re re'i nyin mtshan gyi tshad rags pa rtogs dgos/)'o na nyi ma lho byang bgrod pa'i dbang gis nyin mtshan ring thung gi snang ba 'di ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu gang zhe na/ de yang (rnam 'grel gser shing )las/ kha cig na re/ nyi ma'i zlum sngo mjo dman can du 'alta ra zhing / de yang phyogs dang sdudags su 'a'o/ ba las gyen du 'dzegs pa'i tshe bul ba ring ba dang / thur du babs pa'i tshe myur bas thung zer mo / /de ltar na dus rtag tu nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'ba' zhig 'byung bar thal/ snga dro lta bu gyen du 'dzegs pas bul gyi khyad par yang mi rigs pa'i phyir dang / rlung stobs kyis bgrod pa la gyen thur la myur bul gyi khyad par yang mi rigs pa'i phyir ro// /'o na gang zhe na/ phyir sdudags gang nas gzhal kyang rung khyim gyi 'khor lo'i rlung rnams lhun po la je nyer 'khor ba rnams dal la/ rta gdong gi me la je nyer 'kho ra ba rnams myur zhing / mnyam lam gyi tshe dal myur bar mar 'gyur te/ dper na/ gdugs skor ba na/ phyi mtha' rgya che ba myur du 'kho ra zhing / de las nang du so/nga ba rnams rim gyis dal bar 'kho ra la phyi nang thams cad kyang rdzogs par 'khor ba'i dus dang grangs mnyam pa bzhin chod/ /der ma zad lta ba sngo rang nyid gang na gnas pa de dbus su byas pa'i macadang gang nam mkha' zlum por snang ba de'i khyon che ba dang chung ba'i yul la spyod pa'i dbang gis nyi ma ring thung du 'gyur ba yin te/ sngar mthong gang zlum po'i ri mo'i gnad kyis so/ /zhes

91 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sku //gsungs/ 'di dag ni 'chad 'gyur gyi rtsab lta bu yin pas/ cung zad rgyas par bshad la/ da ni de las 'phros te dus bzhi brtsi tshul dang / dus drug dus bcu gnyis wa'i brtsi tshul gling bar bya ste/ dus bzhi ni/ nyin mor rang gi tshad dum bu gnyis su byas pas/ snga dro/ phyi dro gnyis dang / mtshan mor rang gi tshad dum bu gnyis su byas pas snga cha nam stod dang / phyi cha nam smad du nges dgos/ dper na/ bod zla dang po'i tshes gang rung zhig gi dus bzhi'i tshad dbye na/ de'i nyin mo'i tshad 'khor lo'i chu tshod 11 dang skar ma 24 nyid cha gnyis su phyes pa'i chu tshod 5 re dang skar ma 42 re ni nyin mo'i snga phyi so so'i dus kyi tshad yin la/ mtshan mo'i tshad de sngar bzhin cha gnyis su phyes pa'i chu tshod ca dang skar ma 18 ni nam lha da dang / chu cerd ca dang skar ma 18 ni nam smad kyi tshad yin no//dus drug gi brtse tshul ni/ snga dro dang / nyin dgung / phyi dro/ nam stod/ nam dgung / nam smad ces snga ma gsum nyin dang / phyi ma gsum mtshan la 'khe ra bas so so'i tshad kyang sngar bzhin nyin tshad cha gsum du byas pa cha re nyin mo'i dus gsum re'i tshad dang / mtshan mo'i tshad dag cha gsum du byas pa'i cha re mtshan la 'khor ba'i dus gsum re re ba'i tshad du 'gyur ro/ /dus bcu gnyis po ngos 'dzin tshul dang /brtsi tshul/ 'khor tshul bcas ni/ dus bcu gnyis 'dir skar rtsis lugs la 'pho chen bcu gnyis dang / 'byung rtsis lugs su lo brnyan bcu gnyis su sbyar te brtse tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa las 'dir phyi ma nyid la sbyar te bshad par bya'o//dang sngo / dus 'go 'dzin tshul/ dus bye brag pa zhig gi 'khor tshul shes par bya ba la/ 10ga mar dus kyi 'go gang las 'dzin dgos min gsal swā gas bya rgyu ni sngon 'tho'i cha rkyen gal che zhig yin/ de yang zla zer las/ dus ni nam langs

nyes pa gsum ldang dus skor / 95yos nas bzung / /nyi shar 'brug la nyi drod sprul/ /nyi phyed rta la phyed yol lug/nyi myur sprel la nyi nub bya/ /sa sku da khyi la sku da 'kho ra phag/ phyed yol glang la tho rengs/ stag /ces gsungs pa ltar spyir 'byung rtsis pa'i lugs kyi dus stod bcu gnyis 1tshere 'bo/ ni nam langs sku sa nas 'dzin dgos shing / de'i rgyu mtshan yang rags pa rgong du brjod zin pa ltar 'di nyid nyin gyi thog ma yin pa dang zhib pa ni nang rlung bi 'pho ba la sbyar tshul gsungs yod pa 'dir gleng bar mi bya la/gzhan nyin mtshan gnyis las nyin ce/ nam langs dang / mtshan mo nyi nub nas 'go 'dzin dasos tshul/ nyi 'od dang mtshan mo sa bya ba brtsams tshul las rtogs dgos pa sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /dus bcu gnyis po sku so'i sgra bshad dam nges tshig sna/ nam langs spo sa zhes pa'i dus gong du brjod zin pa dang / nyi shar 'brug ni/ nyi ma'i 'od gling so sor phog pa nas bcoms te dus yun nyin tshad dag cha drug tu byas pa'i cha re'i tshad yin pa/ de'i ring nyi ma'i 'od gling lha/ sor 'phro ba'i bya ba tsam las 'od kyi nus pa de tsam brin ma nus so/ /nyi dros sbrul zhes nyi ma shar rjes nyi 'od kyi nus pas sa steng gi rde'u (rdo chung chung )dros tsam la brjod de yun tshad gong bzhin no/ /nyi phyed rta zhes pa nyi ma ldel drod kyi dus yun rjogs mtshams nas nyi ma dgung dkyil du slebs pa ste/nyin dgung rang bi grib ma rkang par thim ste mi mngon pa'i dus der ngos 'dzin dgos/ phyed yol lug ces pa dgung 'das nas nyi ma ma nub pa'i mtshams su dang /nyi myur sprel ni nyi ma myur la nye ba'i mtshams kyi dus su brjod de/ ring thung gi tshad ni sngar ltar nyin mo'i tshad dag cha drug tu bgos pas cha re'i tshad yin no/ /'di rnams ni nyin la 'khor ba'i dus drug yin te nyi ma'i 'od kyis gling 'di'i sa la bya ba byed pas so/ /

96 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tso gas bsdus bzhugs so//mtshan gyi dus drug ni/ nyi ma nub pa zhes nyi ma'i cordod gling dbus ma las sku/la ba nas sngo sa 'dzin cing / sa lhagad khyi zhes pa'ang nyi nub nas mtshan snu'i tshad de cha drug tu babo/sa pa'i cha gcig gi yun the gas mtshams yin pas/ lha/da 'khor phag la sku/gas pa mtshan mo'i dus gzhan rnams kyang 'dis rigs bsgre bar bya'o/ /de ltar nyin mtshan dus drug so so'i sgra bshad dang tshad ngos bzung ba'i rjes/ rgyun gtan lag len thog 'khor lo'i chu tshod dang sbyar te dus so sor ngos 'dzin ji ltar bya tshul ni/thog mar nam langs dus kyi 'khe ra 'o'i chu tshod gsal por nges dgos/ nam langs kyi dus de sa tshigs dang nyin mtshan ring thung mi 'dra bar ltos nas cung mi 'dra yang / spyir btang gling phran so so'i nam langs kyi dus ni gcig mtshungs lta bu yin/nga tshos rang gling la cha bzhag ste rgyun gtan nam langs kyi dus cho da rags pa ni zhogs pa 'khor lo'i chu tshod lnga pa drug par ngos 'dzin pa yin/ ('di ni rags rtsisayin cing / zhib pa sa tshigs sku sor zla re'i nam langs dus yun la snga phyi yod pa de rtogs dgos/) rags rtsis der gzhi bcol te/ bod zla dang po'i tshes gang rung zhig bi nyin mtshan dus drug so so'i tshad gzhal na 'di lta ste/ bod zla dang po'i nyin mtshan gyi tshad ni nyin la chu tshod 11 dang skar 24 mtshan la chu tshod 12 dang skar ma 36 yod pas/ nyin mtshan gnyis ngo'i tshad dag dus drug so sor bgos pas chu tshod 1 dang skar ma 24 ni nyin gyi dus re'i tshad dang chu tshod 2 dang skar ma 6 ni mtshan gyi dus re'i tshad yin no/ /nyin mtshan gnyis kyi dus re re ba'i tshad shes rjes nam langs dang nyi nub gnyis kyi dus thog mar byas te de'i steng nyin mtshan dus re'i yun tshad bsnan pas phyi ma ṇ+ḍi ma'i yun tshad 'char ba'ang gsham gyi re'u mig las rtogs par bya'o/ /
༈wad zlo dang tre dpere zloso~X lda ༷/ ༷༷ dī+o re re ba'i yun tshad 'khor gro'

98 na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs sku///bzhi dang / dus drug de bzhin nyi ma'i lho byang gi bgrod pa rnams gsal bas/ de dag ni nang yul can 'byung ba'i 'pho bas phyi yul snang 'byung ba'i 'gyur ba mngon par byed do/ /gnyis pa/ zhag gis phung sngo sa grub pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis so 16re ngos 'dzin dang / dus bzhi/ babo da gnyis 'kho ra tshul bshad pa la/phyi rol dus kyi khyad chos mcho na pa'i gzer rnams rtogs slad/ 'dir skar rtsis lugs kyi zla ba bcu gnyis po'i ngos 'dzin dang / dus bzhi 'khor tshul/ nyi ma'i lto byang gi bgrod pa'i khyad chos mdor bsdus gleng bar bya ste/ dpyid zla ra ba bod zla dang po nas bzung / zla ba gsum re dang dus re sbyar nas dus bzhi ngos 'dzin dgos shing / dus bzhi po so so'i khyad chos sam 'gyur ba yang gtso che lto byang gi bgrod pa la ltos nas byung ba yin/ de yang nyi ma'i bgrod pa gnyis rtogs par nyi zla gnyis wa'i rkang pa'i 'phel 'grib dang rtag pa'i longs spyod shes dgos shing / nyi zla'i rkang pa'i 'phel 'grib ni phyi ru nyi zla babo da pa'i tshad dang / nang du ma'akhor gyi 'dab ma so sor 'byung lnga'i yon tan gyis 'phel 'grib byed pa'i cha dang sbyar nas gsungs pas/ phyi'i nyi zla'i bgrod pa dang rkang pa'i 'phel 'grib kyi tshad las/ nang lus khams kyi 'byung ba'i dar gud dang khams dkar dmar gyi 'phel 'grib byed pa lhan du 'byung ba'ang gnad de yin pas/ zhib par mkhyen 'dod na gtsug lag rtsis kyi rig pa dang / zab mo dus 'khor phyi nang gi le'u sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /phyi ru zla rer nyi ma rdzo byang du bgrod pa'i tshad las nyi ma'i dkyil 'kho ra dang 'od kyis khyab tshad/ ring thung / nus pa byin che chung sku gas la ltos nas nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib dang / gling sku so'i dus bzhi'i 'a'o/ ba gnam

nyes pa gsum ldang dus skor / 99gshis kyi 'gyur ba 1/gas sku/nga gi sku/da la/ de la lta sa nas nang du mi'i lus khams kyi 'byung bar dar gud dang / lus rten gyi nyes pa gsum por 'phel zad dang ldang ba lha/gas kyi rkyen byed pa yin/de yang / nyi ma'i bgrod pa rtogs par rgyu lam dang lho byang steng 'og bgrod pa'i tshad dag shes dbo sa pas lnga ga mar babo da lam go la'i lho byang gi rgya la ci tsam yod pa'ang / rgyud las/ me nas bsil ba'i ri wa'i mtshams su dpag tshad stodang phrag mkha' dang nam mkha' mkha' dang mda' ricod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lho rta gdong gi me nas byang bsil ri'i bar gyi 'gyangs tshad la dpag tshad bdun khri lnga rdo nga mo da de/ de las las sa'i lho phyogs dang byang phyogs bsil ri'i phyogs gnyis ka nas dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang bcu gsum re gdungs byed (nyi ma'i 'od)kyi sa yin pas de snga ra bas dpag tshad lnga khri ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'gro ba'i lam dang /der ltos pas mtha' skor ni dpag tshad sum 'bum bdun khri lnga stong yin no/ /nyi mas lho byang du bgrod pa'i mtho dman gyi tshad ni/ rang gling gi nyi ma phyed kyi byang babo/da mthar thug pa'i nam mkha' la 'bo ba'i tshe las sa'i dkyil 'khe ra nas dpag tshad brgyad khri drug stong 'phags pa na 'khor ba dang / lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshe sa dkyil las dpag tshad bdun khri lnga stong 'phags pa'i thad du 'khor ba yin/ lto byang gi bgrod mtha' gnyis wa de las dpag tshad lnga stong lnga brgya steng 'og tu gzhal ba'i dbus nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi ri mo'i lam du 'bo/ ba'i tshe sa dkyil las dpag tshad brgyad khri lnga brgyas 'phags pa'i nam mkha' la bgrod cing / dpag tshad stong phrag bcu gcig ni nyi ma steng 'og bgrod pa'i bar khyad yin pas/ gnad ka 'di dag gis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang gdungs byed

100 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs sku///kyi nye ring lha gas la/ 'di la tos nas sa la tsha grang bsil snga da kyi 'gyur ba dum bu rang rang gi lto byang gi sa tshigs la bsnyun nas shes dgos so//dper na/ lho gling dbus ma'i phyed byang mar gnas pa'i yul chen po drug (byang nas rim bzhin gangs ldan/ sham lha la/ rgya nag 'i/ ྅/da/ rgya gar/)po rang rang gi sa tshigs mi 'dra bar brten nyi ma'i rdzo byang gi bgrod par ltos pa'i sa la gnam gshis tsha grang gi 'gyur ba mi 'dra ba ma1rin gyi sku da/ 'di la nyi ma'i lto byang gi mtho dman la gzhigs na dbyar bsil ba dang dgun dro dbo/sa pa las thodad yul 'dir de ltar mi 'byung ba'ang / sa tshigs dang gdung byed kyi khyab tshad la ltos te dbyar mtho yang gling phyed phyi ma tshun nyi ma'i dkyil 'khe ra 'ong bas g.yas g.yon gyi gdungs byed stong phrag nyer lngas gling stong phrag nyer lnga'i steng nas khebs pas sngo ba yin la/ dgun ji tsam dma' bar gyur kyang gdungs byed rgya mtsho'i phyi mtha'i bar 'gro bas lto bgrod mthar thug gi tshe gdungs byed kyi nang mtha' dang gling gi phyi mtha'i bar du dpag tshad sum khri bdun rdo nga lnga brgya tsam gyis 'gyangs zhugs pa'i phyir bod yul 'dir grang ba yin no/ /zhib par nyin zhag re re bzhin steng 'og dang lho byang gi bgrod pas nyin re dang / zla re/ dus re'i phyi rol gyi gnam gshis tsha grang bar 'gyur ba sna 〉rgags cardongs ba sna gas dbo sa sku / /lho gling dbus ma 'di nyid dpe mcho na gyis gling 'di dang gzhan gyi sa la dus bzhi 'khor tshul dang de bstun nyi ma'i mtho dman gyi babo/da pa bshad pa la/ nyi ma lug gi khyim du zhugs pa'i khyim zla gcig po de nyid la dus bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ lto gling dbus ma 'dir dpyid zla 'bring po dang / byang gling dbus mar ston zla 'bring po ston byed kyi skar khyim gnas pa/ shar gling dbus mar dbyar zla 'bring bo ston byed kyi skar
༵༵ /snan)

102 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig khyedags bsdus bzhugs so//de ltar nyi ma'i bgrod pa la ltos nas dus kyi rags pa'i 'pho tshul tsam dang tsha grang bsil the da kyi khyad chodas swā gas la/ zhib pa dbyar sku gas dus so sorware char cadad dang kha char 'bab tshad/ rlung bu 'kho ra phyogs sdudags zhib cha rnams nyi ma bzhin babo/da pa'i gza' brgyad sngo/ dang / sa tshigs bye brag pa'i gnas stangs la ltos nas phyi rol yul gyi 'byung bzhi'i 'gyur ba rtogs par bya dgos pas/phyi phro la gyi 'pho gyur de dag gasku dpyad mkhan rnams kyis mkhyen lha gas 'ong ba gnang ste phyi nang dang 'brel ba'i nad kyi ldang dus dag shes dgos/ de yang /spyir bod zla bcu gcig par dgun gyi nyi ma ltos ste byang du bgrod par brtsams pa'i tshe nyi codad dang gdungs byed dpag tshad brgyad khri drug stong sar 'phags par babo da pas sngar bshad grub pa ltar/ gling phyed ma phyi ma tshun nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'ong bas g.yas gasku na gyi gdung byed stong phrag nyer lngas gling stong phrag nyer lnga'i steng nas khebs pas snga ba yin pas/ phyi gro la gyi yul dang dus kyi cha las skye dngos rnams kyang rno tsha rtsub pa'i ngo bor 'gyur pas/ spyir rlung dang nyi ma dag gi nus stobs kyis ldog phyogs su gyur pa'i zla ba sa yi yon tan zad par byed pa sog/sa bshad pa sku'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu bzhi dus spyod dang / klu sgrub zhabs kyi bstan ba3)sa zla rgyal sdu/gas las gsungs pa bzhin nang lus khams dang 'brel ba'i phyi phro la gyi 'gyur ba dag rtogs par bya la/ skabs su gleng bya nyes gsum gyi ldang dus skor yin pas rgyas bshad mi spro'o/gsum pa/ nad tsha grang gnyis su 'dus pa'i ldang dus brjod pa dang / bye brag nyes gsum so so'i ldang dus brjod pa/ gzhan yang gling 'dir lngos pa'i gling ga(nan gyi ldang dus brjod pas mjug bsdu'o/ /

nyes pa gsum ldang dus stodar / 103dang po/ nad tsha grang gnyis su 'dus pa'i ldang dus la gso rig rgyud las gzhung tshig dmigs su gsungs med kyang / nyi zla'i bathodad pa dang / dus kyi 'khor tshul gyi cha las rtogs par nges te/ 'o/ gcig nang nyi ma'i lhe byang gi bgrod pa dang / gdung byed kyi khyab tshad sogs la stodas nas/ byang bsil ri'i mtshams su bgrod pa'i skabs kha ba'i yul gyi tsha ba ldang dus dang lho me ri'i mtshams su bgrod pa'i skabs grang ba ldang dus nges shing / gzhan yang nyi zla'i khyad chos dang / thabs shes/ gdags srib 11gas kyi cha gang la ltos kyang /nyin mo tsha ba dang mtshan mo/ grang bar ldang dus su nges mo / /gnyis pa/ bye brag nyes pa gsum wa'i ldang dus skor bshad pa la/ rgyud las/ rlung nad dbyar dus dgong dang tho rengs ldang / /mkhris pa ston dus nyin dgung mtshan dgung ldang / /bad gan dpyid dus srod dang snga dro ldang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rlung gi nad gzhi ni rang gi mtshan nyid dang chos mthun pa'i phyi'i dus dbyar kha char rlung grang ba bskyed pa'i dus su ldang zhing / de yang dus ni dgong dang tho rengs gnyis bsil la grang ba'i rlung nad ldang dus su nges pa bzhin bad mkhris gnyis la'ang rigs 'gres sna gas par bya la/ khyar par gyi chodas ni/ rgyud du/ dus ni so ga sogs gsum rlung gi ste/ /mkhris pa dbyar dang bad kun dgun smad do//so ga'i dus su yang la rtsub pa yis/ /yul dang lus dang zas spyodad kun mtshungs pas/ /rlung gsog byed kyi dro bas ldang mi 'gyur// dbyar dus char rlung grang ba skyes pas ldang / /ston dus snum la dro bas zhi bar 'gyur/ /dbyar dus snum bsil mkhris gsog ldang mi 'gyur/ /snum dros rdo na ldang dgun stod bsil bas zhi/ /dgun smad bsil snum lci bas bad gan gasku/ga /basbongs pas ldang min dpyid
༈ོ 'khor // ṭ+wāṃtshanaṅge byes6 dru/ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ rdo waX /lte/༵ rdoX snyeXrmedu ༷ skre+oṅge rte ༄lnge po'

nyes pa gsum ldang dus stodar / 105de las nyin la 'khor ba'i dus gsum ni snga dro/ nyin dgung / dgong gsum dang / mtshan la 'khor ba'i dus gsum ni srod dang / mtshan dgung / tho rengs gsum du nges shing / spyir nad tsha grang gnyis su bsdus pa'i skabs nyi 'od dang mun pas gling 'dir bya ba byed tshul la ltos te sku sku ra tsha grang ldang dus su 'gyur la/ zhib pa/ nyin la'ang tsha grang gi dbye bas masnga ra bstan bad gan dang rlung grang ba gnyis/ snga dro dang dgong dus ldang ba dang / mkhris pa tsha ba nyid nyin dgung dus ldang ba yin/ de mtshungs mtshan la'ang tsha grang gi dbye bas bad rlung srod dang tho rengs su ldang zhing / mkhris pa tsha ba mtshan dgung du ldang bar 'gyur ba ni rten 'brel gyi chos tshul las rtogs shing /bzhan yang / phyi dus dang 'brel ba'i nang lus khams kyi 'phel rim dang /rgyun gtan gyi zas spyod bsten tshul sku gas cad du ma nas dpyad bya'i gnad ka mthong bas 'dir dus nyid gtso cher brjod pa'i skabs yin pas mdor bsdus su smras pa'o/gsum pa/ gling 'dir ltos pa'i gling bzhan gyi ldang dus brjod pas mjug bsdu ba la/ dang po/ gling 'dir ltos pa'i gling gzhan gyi ldang dus dang gling gzhan la ltos pa'i gling 'di'i ldang dus brjod tshul rtogs par bya ba la/ lus kyi gnas lugs bstan pa'i skabs su/ 'dzam gling rang lus 'dom gang khru bzhi la zhes pa'i rngo rjo'i tshig rkang las/ 'dzam gling che chung dang gling bzhi gling phran bcu gnyis po so so'i tshad/ gzhan yang / mkha' la nyi zla'i bgrod pa sogs rtogs par byas te/ khyad par gling 'dir dus bzhi dus drug dus bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i 'bor tshul ṅge+ogs na/ 'dir ngal ba cher ma mthong ste snga ma las phyi ma 'phro ba'i tshul gyis lto sa mtshungs su grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang lho gling gi sa 'dir dus gang dang

106 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷rmegs bsdus bzhugs sku///gang zhig gi skabs su nad gang dang gang ldang ba'i dus der gling gzhan kun tu dus gang dang gang zhig dang nad gang dang gang zhig ldang ba'i skabs dang 'khel snyam na/de la 'dir thog mar dus ni/ sngar dus kyi sgra bshad dang nges tshig bshad pa'i skabs dus bcu gnyis sku so'i nyin mtshan gnyis la ji ltar 'khe ra tshul sku/ so'i yun tshad brjod zin pa ltar/ gling dbus ma (gling 'di'i nang yul chen po drug gtso bor gyur pa'i yul phran rnams gnas sku///) 'dir nam langs sku/sa kyi skabs lho gling shar mar nyi shar 'brug dang / nub mar tho rengs stag de bzhin nub gling shar mar nam phyed sku la ba glang dus/ de'i dbus mar mtshan dgung byi ba/(dbyin ji'i rgyal sa lon to/na gtsor gyur) nub mar sku sa 'kho ra phag byang gling shar mar sa srod khyi/ dbus mar nyi nub bya/(a ri gtsor gyur gyi yul) nub mar nyi myur sprel/ shar gling shar mar phyed sku la lug dbus mar nyi nub bya/ nub mar nyi myur sprel/ shar gling shar mar phyed yol lug dbus mar nyin phyed rta/ nub mar nyi dros sgrul bcas rim pa ltar dus rnams g.yon du 'pho ba mkhyen dgos la/gang du gnyan pa de'i bdun zur la'ang gnyan pa ni mcho na byed snang brnyan las rtogs par byas na slacod/ /gnyis pa/ gling 'dir ltos pa'i gling gzhan gyi ldang dus ni/ dper na/ lto gling dbus ma 'dir mtshan dgung byi dus 'khel ba'i skabs/ byang gling dbus mar nyin dgung 'khe ra bas/ nyi ma'i tsha sngo sa kyi nus pa dang rten 'brel gyi nus pas gling de dang de'i mi rnams kyi mkhris pa ldang dus yin pa'ang / rgyud las/ mkhris pa ston dus nyin dgung mtshan dgung ldang / /zhes dang / gling 'dir tho rangs 'khel ba'i skabs byang gling du dgong dro'i dus 'khor bas/ de skabs grang ba'i

nyes pa gsum ldang dus sgor / 107dbang gis rlung nad dbo nga dang tho rangs ldang / zhes dang / gzhan yang / gling 'dir snga dro 'kho ra ba'i skabs byang gling du sku da dus 'khor ba/ bad kun dpyid dus srod dang snga dro ldang / /zhes gsungs bas rig pa 'dis phan tshun ldang dus su 'gyur ba rtogs so/ /mdor na/ mtshon byed lo brnyan dang sbyar ba'i snang brnyan bcu gnyis po 'dis ldang dus rtogs slar nges pa'ang stag dus su ldang ba ni de'i bdun zur sprel dus la/ rta dus la ldang ba bdun zur byi ba la/ khyi dus la ldang ba 'brug dus la/ bya dus la ldang ba sku/sa dus la/ phag dus la ldang ba sprul dus la/ glang dus ldang ba lug dus ldang /dper na/ lto gling dbus ma 'dir tho rengs stag dus 'khor ba'i skabs thad ltos kyi gling byang mar (a ri dbus gyur )de'i bdun zur dgong sprel dus 'khel bas/ gnyid ka dus mnyam pa rlung ldang dus su 'gyur ba lta bu/ gling gzhan la'ang rig 'gres kyis gling bcu gnyis sngo/ 14 sdu'i nyes gsum gyi ldang dus rtogs pa ni phyi nang rten 'brel gyi gnad du song bas/ ldang dus ngos 'dzin gsal lha gas kyi gnyen ho bsten thabs bya gal du rigs pa/ 'dir dpyad pa'i tshul du rags tsam gling ba'ang / sman rtsis rig par mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i gzur gnas kun gyis byi dor yong slad dang /yang sgos gasku rtsis rig pa gnyis phan tshun gcig rgyab gcig rten gyis zung du 'jug pa'i gal gnad sngar sdudan mes wa'i phyag rgyun bzang por snying dbus nas dran gso zhu bzhen dus rabs 'dir ched du mkho ba'i 'gro ba'i babo/ skal du lus pa'i ga1do nas gnyis sngo/ nam yang mi nub par rtag brtan sku/nga ba'i smon pa dang bcas/ sngo/da rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa stag khrums kyi dkar phyogs su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //

༄༅༅/ /mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan dus 'khor rgyud kyi 'grel chen dri med 'od las bstan pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi mtshon tshul gnad bsdus gling ba/༈ tshogs gnyis sku na tan rdul mang las bzhengs pa'i//rab brjid g.yo med lhun po rnam lnga'i sku//sgrib bral mkha' la mtshan dpe'i zla gzugs bzhin//gsang gsum rdo rje'i nyams brgyar rol de mchodad//mtha' bral stong pa'i dus las phyi nang dalnga sa//mi 'gal 'byung bzhi'i byed pos gzhi gcig tu//bskrun pa'i rig lam kun khyab sman dang rtsis//ston mdzad yongs 'du'i bshes gnyen tsi tar rol/ /ces mchod par brjod pa'i tshig phreng thung ngus rdzun bsus te skabs su 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos phyag btab srol 'byed bskyangs shing phreng 'dzin phyi ma thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin rgya mchorta mchog gis thugs 'dzin gces nyar dar rgyas mdzad pa'i 'phags yul bod gzhung dbus sman rtsis khang gi phyi nang snga na rnams ma lus mchortan par nus pa'i phyag rgya'i (las dam mam dam phrug)mtshon don spyi bshad pa dang / de las 'aho/sa pa mchog gi dang wa'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan dus 'khor rgyud kyi 'grel chen dri med 'od las bstan pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi mtshon tshul bye brag gnad bsdus gling bcad/ /

110 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//sngon gleng /de yang lte bar sman mchodag rgyal sngo a ru ra rnam par rgyal bas gtams pa'i lhang bzed kyis mtshan pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan/ g.yas gasku na seṅge dkar mo zung gis masngoran par 'degs bzhin mchis pa'i snang brnyan/ mjal ba tsam gyis yid la spro ba sim par byed pa 'di zhi gangs can sman rtsis rig pa'i bsti gnas bod gzhung sman rtsis khang gi phyi nang don mtshon nus pa'i phyag rgyar rtsis rig dge che brag mthon byams pa rgyal mtshan ma6)ga nas bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug (ye 'o/ 1976)lor 'char 'god gsar bsgrigs gnang ba zhig lags/dang dze / mtshon don spyi bshad pa/masnu/na snga na phyag rgya'i gzhi ma dpal dus kyi 'khe ra 'o'i sku gsung thugs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang / phyi nang sdod bcud kyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs shing / gzhan bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la sogs pa'i zab don ji snyed mtshon par nus pa'i sngags kyi yi ge rnam pa bcu wa'i gzugs brnyan lagrada'i ris su byas pa 'di nyid skabs su phyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs don kun khyab bod rtsis rig pa'i don gtso bor mtshon pa'i phyir bkod pa dang / de yang / a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba ro drug dang / nus pa brgyad/ zhu rjes gsum/ yon tan bcu bdun kyi cha yongs su rdzogs pa/ de dang de'i byed nus kyis 'gro ba'i lus la 'tshe ba'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad sel ba na bla na med pa sman rnams kun gyi rgyal sngo/ yin pa sa/tshe ring nad med/ bde ba'i dpal ster gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs zab mo 'di nyid kyi rdo na dang bstan par bcas nga 'i don mtshon du babo da la/ g.yas gamo na du g.yu ral rgyan gyis mtshan pa'i gangs seng zung gis masngo na par btegs pa'i tshul

rnam bcu dbang ldan mchortan tshul / 111yang chos srid gnyis ldan gyi zhing sa sngo da rgyal khab chen pos bdag gnyer 'dzin skyong gnang bar mtshon pa yin no/ /gnyis pa/ mchodag gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan dus 'khor rgyud kyi 'grel chen dri med cadad las bstan pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi mtshon ṭa/la/de yang / bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal sngo phyi 'jig rten khams le'i rdo rje'i tshig gi phreng 'dzin lnga par/ lus dang ye shes nam mkha' dang ni rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang brtan dang g.yo ba dang / /lha ni malnga nga ba skyed min dag dang srid pa rnam bcur gsungs pa rdo rje yi ni lus dag las/ /sngags kyi skye gnas dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur zhing mi yi bdag po slar yang 'di nyid du grol te/ /de ltar gang gis yang dag rig pa de ni phyugs min sems kyi kun tu the ga pa dag las grol/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis dpal dus kyi 'khor zho'i snying wa'i sngags rnam bcu dbang ldan bstan pa'ang / 'grel chen las/ lus zhes pas thig le zlum wa'i rnam pa dang /ye shes zhes pas rnam bcad zla phyed kyi rnam pa dang / nam mkha' zhes pas thig le nas ya'i bar gyi yi be dgu'i rang bzhin du zhugs pa'i a yig gi ngo bo nā da sum 'asdudags kyi rnam pa dang / rlung zhes pas ya yig dang / mes ra yig chus wa/ sas la yig brtan pa zhes pas ma dang / gasku/ bas k+ṣa yig lha ni malnga nga ba bskyed min gyis ha yig bstan pa yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs 'dir rnam bcu dbang ldan zhes grags pa'i yi ge bcu wa'i mtshon thodan gsal bsdus shig 'bo da pa la/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge bcu wa'i mtshon don spyir gleng ba dang / e waṃ pad 'dab khri gdan sku gas kyi mchodan don bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang

112 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sku //1/ la'ang gnyis/ sngags 'bru'i sgrub tshul macadar bstan dang bsgrubs pa'i sngags kyi mtshon don dngos so//dang po/ sngags kyi yi ge rnam pa bcu wa'i sgrub tshul mdze ra bstan pa la/ skabs su gle nga bya'i rnam bcu dbang ldan kyi yi ge bcu po 'di ni thog ma'i hak+ṣam uranam nyid sgra yang dag sbyor ba la brten nas rang rang gi khams las skye bar gsungs pa'ang / dus 'khor 'grel pa rdo rje nyi snang las/ zla ba las thig le dang nyi ma las rnam bcad/ mkha' las a/ rlung las yi me las 'i chu khams las ༷// sa las mṛ/ brtan pa'i khams las ma/ gasku/ khams las k+ṣa/gzugs med pa'i khams las ha ste 'di rnams gasku na skor gyis te mjug nas yar/hak+ṣam urayi.aḥ 'di ltar bkod la/ gsal byed snga ma rnams phyi ma'i steng du 'asngo 'o/ /mṛ yig la sogs pa rnams ni brda sprod pa'i gzhung las/ekani.atsālayaṇa'o/ /zhes pas yaṇar bsgyur bar bya ste/ lti la u wa ro ra.i ya bsgyur par byas nas pha phro la gyi a ya'i sku/ga tu gzhug cing yi ge thams cad brtsegs pa'i steng du thig le zlum po la ye shes rtse mo'i rnam pa dang / thig le'i rnam bcad zla phyed kyi rnam par byas pas brtsegs ma'i yi ge 'di ltar grub pa 'dir ni phyi rol du/ 'jig rten khams brtan g.yo mtha' dag kyang 'du la nang du rdo rje lus kyi tshul kyang 'dir bsdu'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa/ bsgrubs pa'i sngags kyi mcho na don bshad pa la/ gzugs (rnam pa)dang skye gnas/ khams bshad pa dang 'phros don 'di lusas bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan dang lugs gzhan mi mthun pa'i cha cung zad dgag pa'o/ /

rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul / 113dang thod/ gzugs dang kha snga ga skye gnas/ khams bcas bshad pa la/gcig gzugs dang kha snga ga bshad pa/rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge bcu sngo lagranga'i ris dbu zhabs gcig tu byas pa'i bris tshul la rkang pa bcu pa dang / bdun pa/ gsum pa sku gas kyi bzhed pa mi 'dra ba sku da mod skabs su rnam bcad dang thig le nā da gsum phud pas lhag ma'i yi ge rnams rkang pa so lha/ra byas pa'i rkang pa bdun 11re 'bri tshul yongs su grags pa sgro nyid gzhir byas te 'chad pa la/ de lha'i snang brnyan ris bcu'i gzugs kyang brtsegs ma ltar na 'og nas steng dang / lagranga'i ris dbu gdan sanas gcig tu bsdus pa'i 'bri srol ltar na g.yas nas gasku na dang 'og nas steng du rim pas/ya na ra bo na la ma zu lnga ha bcas dang / steng du rnam bcad zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pa can dang / theg le kuzlum po dang /nā da rte / ye shes rdo rje rtse gcig pa'am rtse mo'i rnam pa gang rung du dod cing /de dag gi mtshon dog kyang rim par srog tu zhugs pa'i a yig ljang khu sna tshogs masnga ga can dang /ma ngo nag po/ sna ra dmar po/ ) bo dkar ngo// se la ser po/ zujim li khri/ r+sā shā ljang gu/ sna ha sngon po/ba tornam bcad dmar po/ ()thig le dkar sngo / nā da nag por rang rang khams kyi dbang gis bsgrubs mo / /gnyis/ skye gnas dang khams bshad pa la/yi ge gang yang ngag nas brjod pa'i tshe rang rang gi skye gnas dang / skye gnas de mthun gyi khams las 'byung bar 'asnga da dgos pa bzhin skabs su rnam bcu dbang

111 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sku //ldan gyi yi ge bcu wa'i 'byung khams dang skye gnas kyang / ya yig rlung khams rkan las skyes pa dang / ra yig me khams spyi cad las skyes pa/ lha yig dang /ma yig chu khams mchu las skyes pa/ la yig sa khams lha/ las skyes shing / hayig dang lnga yig rnam bcad/ 19ga tu bzhugs pa'i ma yig bcas bzhi ni nam mkha'i khams mgrin pa las skyes par dus 'khor rgyud dang rgyud 'grel (1)las gsungs te/'grel chen las/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga bsgrub pa'i lnga na du skye ba'i gnas rig par bya ste gzhan ni bsgom pa'i gnas kyi don du lus kyi 'khor lo'i dbye bas brjod pa zhes bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi phreng 'dzin dgu par/ dbyangs ni ka tsa ṭa pa tar ldan ka la sogs pa yang dag sbyar ba rnams kyi skye ba 'i gnas// mgrin rkan steng gi cha ni mkha' rlung bsreg bya las skyes mchu dang so ni chu dang so dag go /a sogs rnams ni gtsug tor 'khor lo snying mgrin mgo bo lte ba'i 'khor lo dag la rim pa ste/ /sna tshogs gnag dmar ri bong can dang gser 'dra phung po khams kyi lhag pa'i lha dang ldan pa la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig las rtogs par bya zhing /de dag gi bklags tshul ni/ yi zhes sna ldan du klog pa thig le klog pa dang / sgra 'thug por klog pa ni rnam bcad klog tshul dang / ha k+ṣa la sogs yi ge dgu po a yig sgra gdangs su klog pa/ ni nā da'i klog tshul yin pas 'di gsum ha sogs kyi yi ge'i rang bzhin du 'dres par byas te klog pa yin no/ /

—rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul glu / 115gnyis pa/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge bcu sngo phyi nang gzhan gsum dang sbyor ba'i mtshon don/gcig phyi srid bcu mcho na tshul/de yang / rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge bcu pos phyi nang gnyis las phyi snod srid pa bcu dang / nang sho je'i lus kyi rnam gzhag rtsa'akhor sogs mtshon pa'ang / gong ltar g.yas nas gasku/na nam mas nas rim pas sku/ga tu zhugs pa'i ma yig gis phyi spyodad 'byung bzhi'i rten nam mkha' chen sngo mtshon pa dang / ya yig gis 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lang/ rlung dkyil mtshon/ ra yig gis me dkyil/ wayig gis chu dkyil/ la yig gis sa dkyil/ ma yig gis lhun po khams lnga mtshon pa'ang / rgyud las/ ma yig 'dir lagranga'i ris su (bo'i dkar ser nag li khri'i mtshon mdog steng 'og phyogs so sor bkod pa'ang lhun po'i phyogs bzhi mchongan te/ steng ma nag sngo shar dang / cadag ma ser po nub/ g.yas dkar po byang / gamo na dmar sngo lho ru mtshon pa yin/ k+ṣa yig pad+ma'i tshul gyis g.yo ba'i snu gas sku zhes 'asnga da lha drug sogs 'alnga da pa'i khams bcu gcig dang / 'og min sogs gzugs khams bcu drug mtshon pa dang / ha yig gis ni 'du shes med min sogs gzugs med khams bzhi mtshon the// /ha yig las rnam par bcad pas nyi ma dang / thig les zla ba/ nā da rdo rje'i mtshan ma rtse gcig pa ste/ srid pa bcu 14 thams cad la rang bzhin gyis khyab pa 'i de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings masnuran par byed pa mtshan brjod dgongs 'grel (2)las gsungs kyang 'dir dus 'khor lugs ltar sgra gcan nyid mtshon par sbyar ro/ /de ltar gnyug ma'i sems dang ngo bo dbyer med par me dang tsha ba bzhin du gnas pa'i yi ge bcu po 'di las snod

116 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyo gas bsdus bzhugs so///kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag 'byung ba yin zhing / yi ge bcu wa'i steng gi ma dag pa'i snang ba skyed pa'i las rlung bag chags de rnam pa bcu'i bdag nyid bde stong gi ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dag par byas te ma dag pa'i phyi stod kyi dngos po spang dgos pa shes pa'i ched dang / snying 1rware yi ge bcu bzlas cadam byas pas ma dag pa'i sgyu da kyi dasngo sa sngo dag nas dag pa'i lhu da kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub pa yin cad/ /zhes bsta na pa ci)na ྅rte/ /gnyis/ nang the rje'i lus kyi rnam gzhag mtshon tshul/rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge bcu pos nang sho je'i lus kyi gnas dang rtsa'akhor sogs rten gyi rnam gzhag ji ltar mtshon pa'ang /dang sngo / lus gnas ni/ sna rje nyi snang las/ ya yig rkang mthil/ ra yig rje ngar/ ri'iyig gis pus mo// la yig gis dpyi/ ma yig gis sgal tshigs/k+ṣa yig gis mgrin pa nas gtsug lta ra bar/ ha yig gis dbu ma/ rnam par bcad pas ro ma/ thig les rkyang ma/ nā das dbu ma bcas mtshon par gsungs/gnyis pa/ rten rtsa'akhor gyi mtshon tshul 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi dgongs pa ltar na/(3) snga ma ltar rim pas sros tu zhugs pa'i ma(kha dog sna tshogs ljang khu/)yig gis dpra la ba'i 'khor lo/ ya(kha dog nas po/)yig gis snying bi ma'akhor/ ra(kha dog dmar po/)yig mgrin pa'i ma'akhu+or/ wa(kha dog ri thong can mdog dkar po /)yig dpra la ba'i 'khor lo/ la(kha dog gser 'dra/)yig lte ba'i 'khor lo dang sbyar ba'i tshul dus 'alor 'grel chen las gsungs la/ ma yig lte ba nas/ gsang ba'i bar dang / lnga yig gsang gnas pad+ma/ha yig sgra gcan gyi maste dbu ma/ rnam bcad nyi ma'i khams rgyu ba'i rtsa ste ro

rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul / 11 7ma/ thig le zla ba'i khams rgyu ba'i rtsaste rkyang ma dang / nā da ni lus gnas de dag las skyes pa'i gzhi dus kyi ye shes bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi bde ba mcho na par mtshan brjod 'grel pa na gsal ba bzhin/ rtog med lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bzhi'i bde stong ye shes mtshon pa dus 'khor lugs so/ /de la lus gnad rtsa'akhor gyi mtshon don 'di bzhin dri med 'od las 'jig rten gyi khams bsdus pa'i mdor bsdus bdun par bstan pa ltar gyi sngags sgom pa'i gnas kyi don du lus kyi 'khor lo'i dbye ba gsungs pa ltar bkod la/ mtshan brjod dgongs 'grel dang dus 'khor 'grel pa rdo rje nyi snang las ya yig dpral ba'i 'khor 'o/ dang / wa yig snying ga'i 'khor lo zhes ldog ste byung ba dang / yang mtshan brjod dgongs 'grel du/ ha yig zla tshes thig le gsum gyis zla nyi sgra gcan gyi mgasum dang / k+ṣa yig gis pyode gsum gyi mas sna gang du 'dzoms pa'i gsang gnas pad+ma mtshon par bshad la/rdo rje nyi snang du/ ha yig dang rnam bcad thig le gsum gyis thur sel rgyu ba'i pyogasum zhes mas nas rim par bshang gci khu ba gsum rgyu ba'i rtsar bzhed pa ni rten cengadang borten pa khams kyi khyad par dbang las bzhag pa min nam snyam yang dpyad par bya'/ /gsum pa/ gzhan bskyed snga gas skabs mchongan snga na/rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge bcu po de bzhin bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang sbyor tshul gsungs pa las/ dang po/ bskyed rim skabs/ rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa la/ brten pa lha bstan pa las/1) bskyed rim skabs/ gong rim ltar srog tu bzhugs pa'i ma yig rgi nam mkha'/ ya yig rlung dkyil/ ra yig me dkyil/ wa yig chu dkyil/

118 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig chu gas bsdus bzhugs sku //la yig sa dkyil/ ma yig ri rab/ lnga yig ri rab steng gi pad+ma dang / hayig gis zla ba'i gdan dang / rnam bcad kyis nyi ma'i gdan/ thig les sgra gcan gyi gdan so sor mtshon la/ nā das ni gatho lnga the rje sems dpa' sogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha 25gas rnams mchotshon par dus 'khe/ra 'grel chen las gsungs pa mtshan bathe da dbo ngas 'grel kyang gcig tu gnas so///yang dkyil 'kho ra dasngo sa la/ ya yig ni dpal dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i thugs bya grub ye shes las grub pa'i rlung gi khor yug dang / ra yig ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs mnyam nyid ye shes las grub pa'i me'i kho ra yug dang / g.yig ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs sor rtog ye shes las grub pa'i chu'i khor yug dang / la yig ni dus kyi 'kho ra 'o'i thugs cesas dbyings ye shes las grub pa'i sa'i 'khor yug dang / ha yig ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs me long ye shes las grub pa'i nam mkha'i khor yug sho je'i rwa ba dang bcas pa dang / g.yig ni khams lnga'i bdag nyid 'od phreng dang rtsigs pa'i rwa ba rim pa lnga dang / k+ṣa yig ni dus kyi 'khor le'i thugs bde stong gi ye shes las grub pa'i lha rnams kyi gdan gyi pad+ma rnams dang /thig le ni dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i rnam kun masnu ga ldan gyi sku dod rje las grub pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor dang / rnam bcad ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhon med gsung rdo rje las grub pa'i gsung gi dkyil 'khor dang / nā da ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i bde stong thugs rdo rje las grub pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sngo sngo yin no/ /2/ brten pa lha bstan pa ni/ ya yig ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rang nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul ba don yod grub pa la sogs pa lha rlung khams pa brgya dang drug gi sngo bo dang / ra yig ni rin chen 'byung ldan la sku gas pa lha me khams pa brgya

rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul / 119dang drug gi sngo thod/ lhakhayig ni snang ba mtha' yas la sku gas pa lha chu khams pa brgya dang drug la yig ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs lha sa khams pa brgya dang drugak+ṣa yig ni mi ba17da pa la sku gas lha ye shes kyi khams pa brgya dang drug ha yig ni rdo rje sems dpa' la sku/gas lha nam mkha'i khams pa brgya dang drug ma yig ni khams lnga'i bdag nyid la ye shes kyi khams spyi khyab tu sku/da pas khams drug gi bdag nyid can gyi ma yig gi ni rigs drug gi bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang gtso bo dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo dang / thig les ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes kyi sku dang / rnam bcad ni sgra skad kyi rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo dang / nā da ni dpal dus kyi 'khor le'i thugs stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid bde rdo nga thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo mtshon/gnyis pa/ cadags rim skabs/ sku ga tu zhugs pa'i ma yig gis stodang pa nyid dam gtsug tor 'khor lo dang / ya yig gis snying kha'i ma'akhor/ rayig mgrin pa'i ma'akho ra/ wa yig dpral ba'i ma'akhor/ la yig lte ba'i ma'akho ra/ ma yig lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar rnams mtshon/ lnga yig gis gsang gnas 'khenar lo/ ha yig gtsug tor 'khor lo/ rnam bcad kyis khams dmar (rdul) thig les /bams dkar/(khu ba) nā das mthar thug gi bde ba chen po dang bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sbyangs gzhi phyi nang gnyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sgrib bral du 'gyur ba'i ye shes rnams mtshon/ de yang / mtshan brjod dgongs 'grel de nyid snang bar/ rdzogs rim la sbyar na/ gong du bshad pa ltar ya ra la wa yi ge bzhis ma'akhor bzhi dang / lngas mtshon pa'i gsang ba'i pad+mar

120 na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig dre gas bsdus bzhugs so//gnad du bsnun nas balha ma pas gsang ba'i pad+mar gnas pa'i gtum mo/ 'bar te spyi wa'i byang sems zhu ba gtum mo'i me dang 'phrad pa'i khams dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod la brten nas sems bde ba chen wa'i ngo cadar skye ba yin la/ de yang rnam bcad kyis cordog nas gtum snu 'bar ba dang thig les steng nas khu ba 'bab pa dang /nā das sems bde chen gyi lnga bor skyes pa mchodan zhing / khyad par du rnam bcad cadag tu byas pas khams dmar 1/ thur du drangs te brtan par byas pa dang / thig le steng du byas pas khams dkar sngo gyen du drangs te brtan par byas/ nā das nge la brten nas drangs pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen dang / lngas nang gnad du bsnun pa'i gsang ba'i pad+ma dang / phyi las dang ye shes dang phyag rgya chen mo'i chu skyes te bde chen 'dren pa'i rten rnams/ mtshon la/ srog tu zhugs pa'i as ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen wa'i yul rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid mtshon par byed do/ /zhes gsungs/gzhan yang / rdzogs rim bstan pa ni/ dus 'khor lugs kyi lam bgrod tshul ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim gyi lam gyis tshogs lam bgrod nas rdzogs rim sbyor ba dang po lngas sbyor lam dang / tha mas mthong lam dang sgom lam gnyis bgrod de rdo rje 'chang gi sar 'gro ba yin pas lugs 'dir bskyed rim mthar phyin nas/ rdzogs rim gyi jo ga ma bsam gtan gyi ye shes thob pa dang sngags bla med kyi sbyor lam thob pa dus mnyam yin la/ k+ṣa yig ni las rlung ci rigs dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas nas du ba lta bu la sogs pa'i stong gzugs ci rigs snang zhing nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i bde stong gi ye shes sor sdud gyi ngo bo dang / ha yig ni rtag bcu'i stong gzugs kyi snang ba yongs su rdzogs nas gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i stong gzugs kyi snang ba dang bcas par stong nyid la

rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul / 121mnyam par bzhag pa'i bde stong gi ye shes bsam gtan gyi cad cad dang / ya yig ni rdo nga gzugs rtsa'akho ra la sku gas pa'i gnas gang du drangs kyang nus gang du bzhag kyang gasku ba med par gnas pa'i dbang jo ba steng rdo nga gzugs brtan nas sku ga bsdam pa'i bde stong gi ye shes srog rtsol gyi ngo bo dang / ra yig ni rlung bcu dbu mar thim pa brtan nas rlung rnams dbu ma'i nang gi 'kho ra myo drug gi gnas kyi thig le la stim phyir 〉wang gzugs kyi snang ba dang bcas par rlung rnams thig le dang bsres nas thig le 'dzag med du 'ching ba'i bde stong gi ye shes 'dzin pa'i ngo bo dang /g.yig ni rlung dang thig le 'dres shing thig le 'dzag med du 'ching ba la brtan nas phyag rgya gsum sngo gang rung la brten nas dbu ma nas 'bar 'dzag dang / 'khor lo drug nas stong gzugs kyi lha sku yab yum mkha' khyab spro bar byed pa'i ye shes la sogs pa'i bde stodang gi ye shes rjes dran gyi sngo bo dang / la yig ni sngags bla med kyi mthong lam thob pa dang / rnam smin gyi lus dpal dus kyi 'kho ra 'o'i rnam pa can gyi ye shes kyi skur 'gyur la/ de 'dra'i sku dang thugs stong pa nyid ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i ye shes gnyis me dang tsha ba bzhin dbyer med du sku nga ba'i lam gyi zung 'jug dang ngo bo gcig pa'i bde stong gi ye shes ting 'dzin gyi ngo bo'i bdag nyid yin zhing / ting nge 'dzin 'di'i skabs su nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gnyis rim pas spang ba dang sngags bla med kyi mthong lam dang lha ma lam dang sa bcu babo/da pa yin no/ /ma yig ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes lnga dang cha 'dra ba tsam gyi lam gyi ye shes lnga'i ngo bo yin la/ thig le ni slob pa zung 'jug pa'i sku rdo rje dang / rnam bcad ni gsung rdo rje dang / nā da ni thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo yin pa bcas mtshon no/

122 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//gsum pa/ 'aho sa don 'di lugs bzhed pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi sde/ mazurgan ༷ngeng ༄rgam bshad pa/spyir rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi gzugs dbyibs lagranga'i ris dbu zhabs gcig tu byas pa'i srol 'dir mtshon bya don gyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad kyis rkang pa mang nyung dang / yi ge so so'i kha dog mi 'dra ba/ khyad par rnam bcad dang thig le'i gzugs ris mi mthun pa 1/gas kyi cha mang du snang ba las/ 'dir phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rjodar tshul las khyad par phyi nang gnyis 'gal med so sku ra masnuran nus pa'i masnuran gzugs skor mdo tsam gleng na/de yang / skabs su rnam bcu dbang lda na gyi lagranga'i yi ge'i kha dos dang mtshon ris gzugs brnyan rnams dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi dgongs don yin pa sngar brjod zin pa ltar dang / skabs su tha dad pa'i cha rnam bcad dang / thig le/ nā da gsum gro'i gzugs las gong ma gnyis po steng 'og dkar dmar 'di ltar tsu)'bri don yang / 'gre pa chen las/ rnam par bcad pa ni zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pacod//thig le ni zlum sngotshe// /nā da ye shes rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa'o/ /'es 'os ma rnam bcad nyi khams dmar 14 ro ma'i khams mcho na byed zla ba phyed nga/'i gzugs dbyibs su gsungs pa dang steng ma zla khams dkar po rkyang ma'i khrams mtshon byed thig le zhi zlum wa'i gzugs su 'dod la/ nā da ye shes rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i gzugs dbyibs sam rtse mo'i rnam pa can gang rung 'bri dgos pa gsal bar gsungs pa sa 'khrul don mi mnga' snyam la/ sngags kyi skye gnas skabs su'ang zla ba las thig le dang / nyi ma las rnam par bcad pa 'byung bar gsungs pas 'di lugs phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor tshul gang la ltos kyang de ltar du nges shing / steng 'og rim par steng ma zla

rnam bcu dbang ldan mcho na tshul / 1pob dang 'og ma nyi mar 'khrul ba med pa'ang phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi masnu na tshul las rdzogs rim skabs/ khyad par du rnam bcad 'og tu byas pa khams dmar sngo thur du drangs te brtan par byas pa dang / thig le steng du byas pas dkar po gyen du drangs te brtan par byas pa/ zhes mtshan brjod 'grel par gsungs pa'i rigs pas rtogs nus/ gzhan yang / rtsis gzhung be+e dkar le'u gnyis pa nyer mkho bsdus pa las dbyangs tshes la 'char ba'i skabs/ dkar cha'i zla ba thig les brgyan//dmar cha sgrib pas rnam par bcad/ /ces phyi'i nyi zla dang nang gi khams dkar dmar gyi 'phel sgrib mnyam par sbyar ba'i rigs pas mtshon bya'i gzugs kyang dkar cha rgyas pa zla khams thig le zlum po dang / dmar cha nyi ma sgrib pa thig le phyed pa rnam par bcad pas mtshon par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa/ e waṃ pad gdab kyi khri gdan bcas pa'i mtshon don bshad pa la/ spyir rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi g.yas g.yon du 'bri bya'i e waṃ yi ge gnyis po'i 'bri gzugs thad lañdza dang wartu gang rung 'bri ba'i srol khyab che la mtshon don gyi 'grel pa'ang yi ge'i kha dog bstun rgyas bsdus ci rigs mchis/ da lam 'dir bris pa'i rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi g.yas g.yon e waṃ yi ge zung ni dbyangs gsal yi se ste so sos stong pa chen po drug dang lnga mtshon par nus pa'i wartu la'i gzugs klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i gsung 'bum (cha)pa'i nang gsal ltar bkod pa yin cing / mtshon gzugs 'di nyid 'bri tshul cung zad khyab chung ba ltar snang yang mtshon bya'i don mtshon la dgos pa khyad 'phags su mthong nas 'dir bkod pa yin pas skabs su de dag gi mtshon don mdor bsdus gleng ba la/

121 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//dang sngo / e yig gi mtshon don/spyir 'dir ye yig bdag med shes rab kyi rang bzhin chos sku dus 'khor yum mtshon par byas pa dang / bye brag gsal byed kyi rang bzhin sde drug gis stong pa chen po drug mtshon tshul ni/ gong gi kha dog ljang gu thong gshol rnam pa can gyis steng gi ka sde nam mkha'i rang bzhin stong pa dang ngo'i mtshan ma mtshon pa dang /'og gi kha dog nag po rwa gzugs sam zla tshes kyi rnam pa can gyis shar gyi tsasde rlung gi rang bzhin stong pa gnyis pa'i mtshan ma mtshon/ g.yas kyi kha dog dmar po dbyug pa'i rnam pa can gyis lho'i ṭa sde me'i rang bzhin stong pa gsum pa'i mtshan ma mtshon pa dang / g.yon gyi dkar po byang gi pa sde chu'i rang bzhin stong pa bzhi pa'i mtshan ma mtshon/ yang steng gi kha dog ser sngo/ thong garo/la rnam pa can gyi nub kyi ta sde'i rang bzhin stong pa lnga pa'i mtshan ma mtshon pa dang / 'og gi kha dog sngon po rwa gzugs sam zla tshes rnam pa can gyis sa sde ye shes kyi rang bzhin stong pa drug pa'i mtshan ma mcho na cing / hril gyis bsgril na sde tshan drug gi rang bzhin gyis 'dus pa'i dbyangs ye yig wartu la'i gzugs can 'dis bdag med shes rab kyi rang bzhin chos sku nyid mchojun pa yin no/gnyis pa/ bo yig gi mtshon don/spyir 'dir waṃ yig thabs kyi bde bas brgyan pa'i lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi sku dus 'khor yab nyid mtshon par byas pa dang / bye brag dbyangs kyi rang bzhin stong chen yi ge lnga'i mtshon tshul ni/ dbus kyi kha dog lja gu gri gug gi rnam pa can gyis dbus kyi nam mkha'i (a )sa thodan stong pa dang po mtshon pa dang / nag sngo dbyug pa'i rnam pa can gyis e yig rlung gi rang bzhin lha nga pa gnyis pa'i mtshan ma mtshon/

rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul / 125yang steng du kha dog dkar po thig le'i rnam pa can gyis u yig chu'i rang bzhin rdo nga pa bzhi pa'i mtshan ma mtshon pa dang / cordog tu kha dog dmar po zla tshes kyi rnam pa can gyis lho'i ṛ yig me'i rang bzhin stong pa gsum pa'i mtshan ma mtshon/ yang steng du kha dog ser po thong gshol gyi rnam pa can gyis nub kyi '-i yig sa'i rang bzhin stong pa lnga pa'i mtshan ma mcho na pa bcas bsdus na dbyangs kyi rang bzhin stong chen yi ge lnga'i mtshan ma 'dus pa las gsal byed waṃ yig wartu la'i gzugs su grub pa 'dis thabs kyi bde bas brgyan pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi sku mtshon no/ /(masnu/na tshul lta bde gsham 'khod re'u mig kha par gzigs par 'tshal )gsum pa/ e waṃ zung 'jug gi mtshon don/de lta'i gsal byed nyer dgu dang dbyangs bco brgyad thabs shes gnyis su 'dus pa'i e waṃ zung du bkod pa'ang shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi ngo bo dang rnam bcu dbang ldan yi ge bcu wa'i sa bon mtshon pa sku gas 'grel tshul rgya cher ldan no/gnyis pa/ khri gdan pad 'dab bcas pa'i mtshon snga/na/rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi snang brnyan bzhugs su gsol ba'i pad 'dab kyi khrir kha dog dkar sngo ser bzhi'i khri gdan brtsegs mar bkod pa'i mtshon don ni/ mas nas rim bzhin dkar po zla ba'i gdan dang / dmar po nyi ma'i gdan/ sngon po sgra gcan gyi gdan/ ser po dus me'i gdan du gsungs la/ codag ma ljang gu sna tshogs mdog can ni de das kun gyi rten gzhi nam mkha' chen po nyid kyi mchodan don yin pas de rnams kyi go rim dang kha dog bcas pa go 'aX la du mi rung la/ pad+ma'i gdan gyi 'dab ma'ang pad+ma gzhon

126 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//nu ltar kha steng du phyogs pa'i tshul las kha phyir brdzes pa'i rnam pa ni 'bri mi rung ba yin pas mkhyen par mdzod ci+ogamajug dan/spyir mtshon bya 'di nyid kyi don mtshon snying bsdus tsam zhig sa 'brug lo'i lo tho shog rkyang ma'i steng 'don spel gsal bshad gnang 'dug mod/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge bcu wa'i gzugs brnyan mtshon ris dang bcas pa'i 'bri tshul thad rgyu mtshan gsal lha na nus pa zhig ma mjal khar/ bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba'i 'dod tshul gyis snang brnyan 'di nyid kyi bkod pa mi 'dra ci rigs su byas pa 'khyar che bas/ de dag rgyud gang dang gang zag gang gi dgongs don bzhed tshul yin min cha ma 'tshal na/ da lam 'dir dge ba'i bshes gnyen dus rams pa a yu bi dzha mchog dang rnam grwa'i mkhan sprul skyabs rje bya dor bstan 'dzin 'byung gnas zung la bka' 'dri dogs sel zhus shing dus 'khor dang mtshan brjod kyi 'grel chen gnyis gzhir bzhag lnga ga snang brnyan mtshon ris kyang bag tsam bsgyur bcos kyis rgyud kyi dgongs don dang sbyor ci thub byas te mtshon byed don dang bcas pa gsal kha btod gang thub zhus khul lags na mkhyen ldan kun gyis legs par dpyad de nongs pa'i tshogs la bka' bkyon dag ther ci nas gnang skyong yong ba'i re smon dang bcas/ rab gnas sa yos tha skar zla ba'i nyer lnga / res gza' mig dmar/ zla skar nag pa/ 'byung 'phrod me chu/'phrod chen kun tu dga' ba'i dus su sbyar ba 'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs ci mchis 'gro kun bde ba'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /

rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul / 127slar smon pa/ phyi snod phyi yi 'byung bas chags 'jig dang / /nang bcud nang gi 'byung bas skye 'gags te/ /kun kyang kun khyab 'byung bas snang byed pa'i/ /kun 'byung gnad 'dis kun mkhyen gnas mthong snanag /༄༅༅/ /dbya/da gzhi'i yig cha dang mchan 'grel/(1) 'grel chen dri med 'od 'jig rten gyi khams bsdus pa'i mdor bsdus bdun par/de ltar yang a ku ha rnam par bcad pa ni mgrin pa las byung ba'o/ /i tsu ya sha ni rkan las byung ba'o/ /ṛ ṭu ra ṣ+ka ni spyi bo las byung ba'o/ /u bu wa pa rune ma chu las byung ba'o/ /mṛ tu la sa ni sdud las byung ba'o/ /zhes skye ba'i gnas gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs lha// /(2) 7rgyal bo dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod 'grel pa de nyid snang bar ba/tra/05 95/ /(tshon) 'grel chen dri med 'od 'jig rten gyi khams bsdus pa'i mdor bsdus bdun par/'dir a ku ha ka rnam par bcad pa ni gtsug gtor gyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya'o//i tsu ya sha ni snying kha'i 'khor lo la'o/ /mṛ tu la sa ni ste ba'i 'khor lo la bsgom par bya'o/ /sna tshogs ni kha dog sna tshogs ljang khu ste gtsug tor gyi 'bor zhi'o//zhes dang / nag pa ni snying kha'i 'khor lo'o/ /dmar ba ni mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'o//ri bong can gyi mdog 'i dpral ba'i 'khor lo'i/ /gser 'dra ni lte ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /

128 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//lha dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od shog grangs 208(tha brgyab )nam mkha'i khams la sogs pa'i sngags kyi brda rab tu brjod pa'i mtshan nyid can mgrin pa la sogs nas brjod pa'i chos bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ 'dir a ku gi rnam par bcad pa ni mgrin pa las so/ /i tsu ya sha ni rkan las so/ /ri ṭu ra ṣa ni spyi bo las so/ /u pu༄ pa ni mchu las so/ /li tu la sa ni so las so/ /de bzhin du gnas gnyis pa dang gnas gsum pa dang / gnas bzhi pa gnas lnga pa'i (shog grangs 327 nang du'ang gsal/)sngags re brtsegs pa'i sngags rnams kyang rab tu brjod pa'i brdas rig par bya'o/ /༈ོ shog grangs 125 (ra)bskyed rim phreng 7 par/ zla ba zhes pa g.yon gyi rtsadang / /nyi ma zhes pa g.yas kyi rtsa'o/ /༈ོ dpal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi (sngags sdom rdo rje 'chang chen ngo'i lam gyi rim par blta ba'i mig 'byed/)las ོ da lnga / shog ang 24 rgyab/ dbu ma sngon po g.yas su ro ma dkar/ /g.yon du rkyang ma/ dmar po dbus ma ni/ /zhes dang / rgyud brtag gnyis las/ bzlogre ste gsungs pa'ang snga ma g.yas g.yon dbang gis bzhag pa dang / phyi khams gnyis 'bab tshul dbang gis so/ /sa klong rdol bla ma'i sngags ming rnam grangs las/ blo bzang dgongs rgyan deb brgyad pa shog grangs 230 las/ g.ya sa su ro ma dkar po// /gasku na du rkyang ma dmar po/ gsungs so/ /༈ོ shog grangs 313 (tha brgya nga bdun/) sngags kyi skye gnas ni/ zla ba las thig le dang / nyi ma las rnam par bcad pa dang / nam mkha'i khams las a rlung gi

rnam bcu dbang ldan mtshon tshul / 129khams las yi me'i khams las ri dang / chu'i khams las u dang / sa'i khams las li brtan pacir khams las gsal byed/ ma g.yo ba'i khams las gsal byed/ k+ṣa gzugs med khams gsal byed/ ha rnam pa ra bcad pa zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pa/ thig le zlum po'o/ /ye shes rtse mo'i rnam pa'o/ /༈ shog grangs 270 (tha brgya sku/ drug) a yig nam mkha'i khams dang gsang ba'i pad+mo/ de'i 'og tu rnam par bcad pa nyi ma dang rdul lo/ de'i 'og tu a yig sgra gcan dang rnam par shes pa bde bas byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /de'i 'og tu rjes su nga ro zla ba dang khu ba'o/ /༈ོ shog grangs272 (tha brgyab)'dir rtsaba'i rgyud las bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ me+e pyi si sa 4 kha' kham sa dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba len/ /wa yi ga rdo rje sem/sa dpa 'a 'di/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byor las/ /theg le zla ba khu ba sku/ /rnam par bcad pa rdul nyi gsung / /a yig mun can thugs rab brjod/ /mkha' khams e la rnam par gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byor gyis//sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /sku gsung thugs dang chags pa yis/ /srid gsum bdag nyid dag la gnas// zhes gsungs so/ /༈ shos yong 108 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud don la cung zad dpyad pa gsang chen mdzod kyi lde mig mgo log bde legs rab rgyas kyis btus/
༄༅༅/ /e waṃ yi ge zung gi mtshon don garmel sprode dra'e rnye'e rke)bzhugs so//

༄༅༅/ /gso rig rgyud bzhi las rtsabashad phyi gsum gyi rgyud tshig don gnad 'ga' zhig thad cung zad dpyad pa'i tshul gling ba be+eḍūr+ya sngon gro'i bzhed dgongs zhes bya ba bzhugs sku///mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par du bskrun cing mtsho sngon mi rigs par 'debs bzo gas par du bzhengs pa'i (rgyud bzhi)lcags 'byu par mar dpyad pa/༄༅/ /na mo bhiṣadz+re gu ru baiḍūr+ya/ rab brjid seng khri pad sdong nyi zla'i steng //sna tshogs gzi byin rab 'bar sprul pa'i sku/ /rigs 'dus sman lha'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i ga༄ / /rigs lnga'i bdag po sman gyi bla mar 'dud/ /rab tu zhi ba g.yo med chos sku'i dbyings/ /kun tu rol mdzad 'gro lha na gar gyi gnas/ /rab gsal khro ba'i nyams 'gyur yi dam lha/ /mchodag thun dngos ster rta mgrin snying gar bzhugs/ /sngon tshe rdo na pas gso rig bstan srung ga༄yar/ /bka' bstsal phyis nas pad+ma ka ra'i zhabs/ /bstan pa 'di 'dzin bstan dgra rdul chodag pa'i/ /g.yar dam masngo na grub zhang blon ste dgus gzig /zhes mchod yul skyabs gnas cangab gsum la mos gus dang bas btud de skabs su babs pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun cing mtsho sngon mi rigs par 'debs bzo grwas par du bzhengs pa'i rgyud bzhi par thengs gnyis pa las/ rungargyud dang bshad rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud gsum gyi tshig don 'khrul cha sngo gas gnad 'ga'

131 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//zhig la cung zad dpyad pa'i tshul gleng ba baiḍūr+ya sngon wa'i dgongs rgyan/ zhes pa 'di nyid bgyis pa'i mtshams rjodar snying bsdus zhu ba la/dang po/ dpal ldan gso rig rgyud bzhi'i byung ba dang zhus chen rims pa ji byung skor/ gnyis pa/ skabs bab dpyad gzhir khas blangs pa'i rgyud kyi canga'agrel dang der dpyad pa'i rgyu mtsham/ gsum pa/ dngos don gleng gzhir gyur pa'i dpyad bya khag gi don gnad ngo sprod/ bzhi pa/ 'phros don dang mjug bsngo bcas so//dang po/ gso rig rgyud bzhi'i byung ba snying bsdus dang zhus chen rim pa ji byung gi skor/gcig gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'byung ba snying bsdus/deng gi char dpal ldan gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'byung khungs smra ba po phal mo ches gso ba rig pa'i byung ba dang dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i byung ba gnyis ngo ma phyes par/ be+eḍūr+ya sngon po sku/gas rang lugs su khas blangs pa'i rgyud 'grel khag dang / snga dgong nam yin la zhal nas chad med 'don bzhin pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i bla rgyud gsol 'debs/ gzhan yang / mdo rgyud dpang por 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dag gi gsung tshad ma dag rgyang ring du dor ste/ rang gi rtogs bakhro'i blo rig las thon pa'i dpyad pa dang mkhas pa che ge mo'i gsung tshig skam po re lung 'dren gyis gso ba ris pa'i lo rgyus smra ba por rlom pa 'gas/ tshad thub rgyud kyi 'byung khungs kyang kha ༷ gas gzhan zhig tu 'grel bzhin 'dug sna/da/ de dag ni gleng byar ma bab pas btang snyoms su bzhag la/ skabs 'dir rang lugs byang zur gyi dgongs bcud snying por bsdus pa (de la be+e sngon mdzad pa sngo sa/ byang zur mkhas pas bstan bcos

ske rgyud tshig don gnad dga' zhig la dpyad pa glu/ 135mdzad pa la/ /'gran zla min yang dad pas rjes 'brangs nas/ /zung gi gso dpyad dka' gnad 'grel tsho gas la/ /cad ma'i nang nas mar bzhin snying cadar bsdu/(1) /zhes gsungs phyir/)bo dzon dang / rje g.yu lnga ga pa'i thugs sras sum lha na ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i bla rgyud rnam thar snu gas rgyud 'grel phal mo che'i dbo ngas pa gzhir bzhag ste 'chad pa la/ de yang / rgyud 'grel pi sngo na du rgyud 'di nyid bka' bstan la bzhed pa mang tsam sku da pa las cad wa ni bka' kho na yin cing de'i tshul rgyas pa po da kyang skabs 'dir bsdus la mcho na tsam ni phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi lha nas bshad na/ phyi ltar bka' sha stag la sku ma nyi mi dathodas kyang / rje sku na tan mabo na sngo sa bod yul dang 'tsham pa'i tshig don gsal dgos par lung bstan pa ltar nag rtsis kyi gzhung dang bstun dalha sa/ ja/ dkar po la/ ma bu dgra cadags sku gas tshig gi yas mas mang sngo ra rgya gar gyi min pa sku da par brten/ cad snga nga tso gas las rnam rgyal dang stag lo/ lha/gas mkhas pa kha cig kyang ༷/da kyi bstan ba3)sa su 'khrul ba dang /der brten gyi mdzad pa sngo sna snu gas su bshad pa yod na'ang / rgyud bzhi'i rtsabar ma tshang ba rnams g.yu lnga ga sku na tan mgon ྅/ de nyid kyis rgya nag gi 'gyur zla ba'i rgyal po sogs kyi nying khu dang bod kyi yul dang mtshungs par bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa man ngag gi rgyud ces par phyi ma dang man ngag rgyud gnyis la bsnan kha mang ba dang / margyud du rgyud le'i grangs dang / bshad rgyud du sman le sogs la yang thor bu bsnan te mdzad kyang / de la dbye ba med par thams cad bka'i tshul ni snyigs dus kyi skye wa ༄nan la mi dpyod cing tshig la blta ba rnams kyi ngor blo drangs ba'i phyir bka' ltar mdzad pa yin kyang / de la nyes pa mi 'jug pa ni bka' gdams thig le bcu drug jo cad yab sras kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul snga la gar las shar na'ang don

136 se pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs sku //gyis brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang nas rim par 'byung ba ltar yin/ nang ngam gso dpyad rang lugs ltar na/ gser 'od dam pa'i 'gyur gcig tu/ rigs kyi lha mo byang chub yang dag par sdud pa la cho nga dasngo na kyi bu chu 'bebs kyi nad rab tu zhi bar byas pa'i le'u bka' bstsal to/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ru sku sprul nas gso ba rig pa bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa bka' bstsal to zhes pa ltar gnas kyang / sman gyi nags su so/ bzhi ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gnas lnga sde bzang po la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi gnas de'i dbus na sman gyi ri bo dang grong khyer rtsargyud nas bshad pa ltar yod la/ de'i ri thod ni da lta yang yod/ grong khyer ni drang srong dang mnyam du sprul pa bsdus nas med snga / /der rgyud gsungs ba po ni stodan pa shākya thub pa dngos kyis sman rgyal du sprul par rma bya chen mo 'gyur gcig nas gsungs pa ltar sprul gzhi rig pa'i ye shes bzhi yid las skyes dang bcas pas rgyud bzhi snyu gas par gsungs pas bka' sha stag tu bzhed la/ de yang sde sdod gsum du bsdu na mdo sde'i sde stod la 'du ste ci'i phyir na/ macadan pa kun btus las mdo sde dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde/ lung du bstan pa'i sde/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sde/ ched du brjod pa'i sde gang yin pa 'di ni nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i sde snod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gsang ba ltar na/ gsungs pa'i gnas kyi grong khyer de yang margyud skabs bshad pa ltar phyi nang gsang gsum las gsang ba ji skad du/ gsang ba'i grong khyer lta na sdug ces pa/ /rang nyid lus gnas spyi bo bde chen 'khor/ /rang sems baiḍūr+ya yi 'od du sems/ /mgrin pa longs spyod ma la ya ru sems/ /snying ga chos 'khor ri bo sgos ngad ldan/ /ste ba sprul pa'i ri bo 'thigs byed de/ /gsang gnas bde

rgyud tshig dodan gnad dga' zhig la dpyad pa 137skyong ri bo gangs can yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ mtha' gcig tu dka' la/ ngo bo bka' sha stag la bsnon kha rnams kyang ྅ped kyi yul dang 'tsham par sman rgyal dasngo sa sam tha mi dad par mahwa gu ru gu ṇa na tha ste/ rje sku na tan malha na cad gsar ma 'di nyid kyis gsungs shing /(2)zhes dang / khyad du 'phags pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni/ phyi rgyud las/ /rtsab thugs kyi rgyud 'di sa 1/na 'dra/ /'di las ma skyes gasku dpyad yod ma yin/ /sku yi bshad rgyud bar snang nyi zla 'dra/ /tshig don ma lus sgrib med gsal bar ston/ /man ngag yon tan rgyud 'di nor bu 'dra//dbo sa pa ma tshang ba ni gcig kyang med/ /phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud 'di pha lam 'dra//nad kyi steng du cadag pa sku da ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar gyi rgyud chen bzhi po gsungs gnas la dgag bzhag sogs rtsargyud dus bcadad pa ltar snga na u rgyan yul du 'thad na'ang 'phral spyir btang ltar brjod na bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo'i lung du/ chos 'khe ra gnas dang yangs pa can/ /sa dkar can dang lha yi gnas/ /byis pa gasku da dang ko+o sham bhi/ /'brog dang mchod rten ri dang ni// 'od ma'i grong dang sgrar bcas dang / /ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer du/ /'di dag rnams su thub pa yi/ /skyes mchodag 'o/ re 'o/ re bzhugs/ /nyi shu mgasum mnyan sku da du/ /sman gyi nags su sku bzhi ste/ /'bar ba'i phug gi gnas su gnyis/ /rgyal wa'i khab kyi grong du lnga/ /dka' ba spyad pa 'o/ drug ste/ /nyi shu mdagu khab gnas su/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sman gyi nags su lo bzhi ste/ zhes pa'i sman nags de ni drang 1/nga gi gnas yin te/ de dag gi rgyas bshad rungargyud du 1/nga ba bzhin gnas khyad par can sprul zhing lta na sdug phyi nang gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa der bdag cag gi ston pa zas gtsang gi sras po bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal

138 zhe pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs sku //sngo zhes bya ba'i skur bzhengs te/ skye dgu'i bdag po sku gas lha'i 'kho ra dang / rgyun shes bu so/gas drang so/nga gi 'kho ra/ tshangs pa so/gas phyi pa'i 'kho ra/ spyan ras gzigs sku gas nang pa'i 'kho ra mang sngo dang bcas bzhugs pa'i dus su sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs kyi sprul pa'i drang srong mched lnga 'a'o/sa te gsung sprul gyis zhu ba sngo dang / gzhan bzhis 'chad pa wa'i tshul du gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor so so rang rang gi lugs su go ba las snang mtha'i rang gzugs gsung sprul drang sku nga yid las skyes nyid kyis go bar bdud rtsi snying sngo yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces pa'i rgyud bzhi'i bshad rgyud phal cher dang / rtsargyud tho long / phyi ma man rgyud kyi cha tsam dang bcas par go ba ltar/ gser 'drang bdungs kyi spang leb la be+eḍūr+yas bris te/ rim gyis chig brgyud kyis kha che'i paṇ+ḍita zla ba mngon par dga' ba bar meched/(3)ces gsungs pa ltar/ rang lugs dpal ldan gso rig rgyud bzhi'i khungs ni/ bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud nyid yin cing / gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di nyid sdo na pa po ni gong du gsungs pa ltar rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa sku da snga cig gi lha na pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras shākya thub pa nyid yin/de yang rgyud kyi cha lag tu sko na pa bathe ma ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid kyis chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gsungs pa'i dus su 'dul ba sman gyi lung bka' bstsal pa dang / gnyis pa'i dus su kun dga' sngo la gcer mthong rig pa'i rgyud chen po le'u sum stong lnga brgya dang shel gyi me long gi rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa bka' bstsal/ spyodas kyi 'kho ra so/ gsum pa'i dus (bo khyodan rang lugs su lcags lug ye sngo na 890 sku ra gsungs par bzhed/)ston pa nyid sman gyi blar sprul

rgyud tshig don gnad dga' zhig la dpyad pa 139nas gasku ba rig pa'i rgyud bdud rtsi snying sngo/ yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud bka' bstsal dod/(4) /zhes gsungs la/ de lta'i gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di bzhin ston pa las ji ltar brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun g.yu thog gsar ma ba'i dngos slob sum ston ye shes kyi gsungs las/ ston pa sangs rgyas sman bla nas rim par drang sku nga rgyun shes dang / 'chod byed gachodan nu/ mgon po klu sgrub/ dpal ldan pha khol (slob dpon dpa' bo/)kha che zla ba mngon dga'/ bai ro tsa na/ khri srong lde btsan bcas rim par brgyud pa dang / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan nas re zhig gter du sbas pa dang / de nas grwa pa mngo na shes can gyis gter las phyungs te dbus pa dar grags dang 'tsho byed dadodan mchog skyabs la/ de las rje btsun g.yu chodag gsar mas gsan zhes gsal/ de la rje btsun g.yu 1/ga gsar rnying gnyis sku skye gcig yin min sku gas kyi gsung rgyun mi 'dra ba 'ga' mchis rung / g.yu thog rnying ma'i mdzad rnam las/ rgya gar ba'i slo ba dpon tsan dra go mi dang pi ro tsa na las rje btsun nyid kyis gsan cing / de nas rim par rnying ma ba'i rgyud 'dzin lnga sogs sras brgyud rig 'dzin bcu gsum dang / bcu gsum pa gsar ma bar brgyud la/ rje btsun g.yu cadag gsar ma sku na tan mabo na sngo sa gang gi yab dang khyad par 'tsho byed dadodan maspyodag skyabs las dpal ldan rgyud bzhi cadags par gsan par grags/ de yang / cadad rgyal khri rabs sku gsum pa chos rgyal sku nga btsan sgam po byon rjes rgyal po 'di nyid kyi bla na med pa'i dgongs gzhi'i mkhyen rlabs la bsten nas chokhu nga zhing snying stobs can gyi chos blon thu mi sam blo ṭa rgya gar 'phags yul du yi ge cadab tu mngags/ thodan mis ngal ba du ma khyad du bsad de rgya gar du phebs shing / sgra rig pa'i gzhugs lugs la gsan bsam rgya che gnang

140 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig chu gas bsdus bzhugs 1///ste bod yig ka mad sum cu gsar bahwa mdzad pa tsam ma zad/ yi ge la bsten pa'i ming tshig brjod pa sogs kyi lung gzhi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs tshad thub dar spel gnang / brda sprod yig rigs gsar bzo gtan 'bebs mdzad pa des bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas spyi dang sgos su gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur rin thang bral ba'i rmang gzhi btod yod pas gso rtsis rig pa'i gzhung lugs gcig pur mtsho na na 'di'i tshe rgya nag nas thodang ma thang the dzung gi sras mo rgya bza' cardon shing mo nga jog 6)sa rgyal sku nga btsan nyid kyi btsun snu/ra bsus pas/ thodang jos rgya nag nas gso rtsis rig pa'i gzhung lugs skyes su bsnams pa dag rgya bod lo tsā ba rnams kyis bod kyi skad du bsgyur/ lhag par bod kyi sman pa mkhas pa mang po zhig gis rang rang gi rnam dpyod myong goms las thon pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyang ji snyed cig bcoms pa des rang lugs gso ba rig pa'i rmang gzhi gang legs tshugs thub pa byung sku da/dus rab brgyad pa'i nang lha/da kyi rgyal rabs sku/ bdun pa chodas rgyal mes ag tshom (ye 'o/ 764 814)mam khri lde gtsug brtan gyis cadad kyi gasku rig dar rgyas sku nga rgyur thugs dbo/ngas bzhes te/ rgya nag dang rgya dkar/ bal sngo / kha che/ ro/la lnga sku gas nas chu gas rigs sman pa mkhas dgu thodad la gdan drangs te yul lung sku/ so'i sman dpyad lag rtsal brgyud spel sngar na ma grags pa zhig mdzad/de las kyang ches dar rgyas su gdo/nga ba 10 ni/ khri lde gtsug ldan gyi sras chodas rgyal khri srong lde btsan (chu rta ye lo 802 lor 'khrungs)nyid yin/ chos rgyal 'di'i sku ring la bod kyi gso rig lo rgyus thog mdzad rjes che shos kyi sman pa rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po (sa spel ye sngon 708)byon/ rje

rgyud tshig don gnad dga' zhig la dpyad bsnye / 141btsun g.yu lnga ga pa 'dis rang mes gasku rig tsam ma zad/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab khag gi gaskuste rig gzhung lugs la 11sa bsam rgya che gnang / khyad par rje btsun nyid kyi rlabs che sna sa kyi mdzad pa ni bdag cag gi rdo na pas gsungs pa'i galha/ rig rgyud bzhi'i phyi mo bdud rtsi snying po gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud la nyams len gyis rje nyid kyi rnam dpyod dang rang mes mkhas pa'i myong ba sogs la brten nas/ bod rang lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gso rig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi bsdu sgrig gis cha lag kha lta nga bsne na ma mdzad rjes rnam bshad 'chad nyan gyi chu rgyun gangs ljo ngas 'dzin ma'i to ru bskyil bar mdzad/ye lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang / gangs jongs gasku ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi snu la 'byed shing rta gnyis pa rje btsun g.yu cadag gsar ma sku na tan mgon po (me rta ye lo 1126)byon/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyis gso rig rgyud bzhi le'u brgya dang lnga bcu drug cha tshang bsdu sgrig gam rtsom sgrig mdzad par ma zad/rgyab rten lung dang smin byed dbang / grol byed khrid bcas srol rgyun gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi yang dag pa'i 'chad nyan gyi lam sku la bzang wa'i lha 'phar yangs sngo ra phye ste gangs cadangs gso ba rig pa'i ba dan cadags dus kun tu khyab par mdzad/ lhag par galha/ rig rgyud bzhi'i yang gsang zab snu sngags kyi theg pa'i gzhung gi dbo ngas pa hril gyis bsgril ba'i dam pa g.yu lnga ga snying thig gi rgyal bstan rin po che'i nyin byed gsal bar byas pa 'di nyid lugs gzhan la med pa'i rang lugs gasku rig gi gdams pa khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin pa ni gzhung 'di dang thun min gasku rig rgyud bzhi'i 'brel tshul sku gas las sna gas par nges sku /

14 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tso gas bsdus bzhugs sku //gnyis/ dpal ldan gso rig rgyud bzhi'i zhus chen rim pa ji byung gi skor/de yang / dpal ldan rgyud kyi yid ches khungs btsun stodan pa bla ma rgyud pa'i so/ rgyus la/ ce ma gzhi lung gi rgyud pa dang / rnam bshad 'chad nyan gyi rgyud pa/ sprul pa thodan gyi rgyud pa bcas kyi rim pa las/ sprul pa ro/na gyi rgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dngos po rtsagasum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ sman gyi rgyal po mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor gyur kyang gdul bya spyi'i snang ngor mahā gu ṇar grags pa/ rgya bod kyi gso dpyad thams cad gsan cing mkhyen pa rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / slob dpon dpa' bos rjes su bzung bas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa phul du byung ba'i rje g.yu thog pa/ nyid kyis mes po gong mas sku la galta da mdzad pa'i rang lugs thun min gso rig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi shin tu dar rgyas su mdzad par ma zad cha lag dang bcas pa'i gsar rtsom ji snyed mdzad/ las smon dbang gis srid par nying mtshams sbyor ba'i skye rgu mtha' dag dug gsum gyis bskyed pa'i bzhi brgya rtsabazhi'i nad 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i lus la rang chas su sku da pa lnga na las 'phral rkyen gyi byed sngo sa 'du ba cha mi lha mas par nad sna snu gas kyis gtses pa'i 25ra ba drag wa'i ngang tshul snu/nga ba rnams sku ngas gtad kyi le'ur/ 'bo ba'i lus ni 'byung ba bzhi las grub/ /gasku bya'i nad kyang 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed/ /gnyen wa'i sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo rwag nyed//lus nad gnyen cad bdag nyid gcig par 'brel/ /zhes gasku bya gasku byed gasku ba'i yul thams cad phan tshun gcig la gcig 'brel ba'i rten 'brel gyi dbang las/ro nus zhu rjes bsdebs pa'i sman gyi zla nyi rā hu'i mche dug las grol ba ltar lus ngag yid gsum la bde ba'i bcud len chen po ster bar byed pa'i lus can kun gyi spyi nor bla na med pa dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i 'phrin las dal bab gangs ri'i chu

rgyud tshig don gnad dga' zhig la dpyad pa / 12rgyun bzhin galha/ rig bstan 'dzin rims pa'i rdza spang gi thugs mgrin las rgyug ste/ gangs jongs lha yi 'dzin ma'i gasku sa su 'gyur bzhin pa las/ skabs shig ring rgyud bzhi'i rtsaba'i tshig don gyi rgyun la 'khrul lhad kyi rtog ma ji snyed ngang gis 'byung ba de dag sel slad/rab byung bdun pa'i sa lug lor shar dwags wa'i sa'i cha la thog zur mkhar du 'khrungs pa'i lha rje zur mkhar mnyam nyid sho je'am mtshan gzhan dharma su mir (ye 'o/ 1439 1475)grags pa/ dgung grangs bcu bzhes pa'i skabs rje g.yu thog pa nyid kyis dngos su zhal bstan mdzad de gso rig rgyud bzhi'i snying thig shog dril dang bcas pa'i tshig don dgongs gzhi thams cad kyi lung stsal zhing / snying thig gi cha lag 'ga' zhig dang dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'dir rgan rabs sna/ngas pas rnam par bslad de ma dag pa'i cha ji snyed cig zhugs 'dug par byi dor gyis shig ces pa'i gsung gi gnang ba bstsal/ rje 'di nyid thun mong thun min gyi rig pa'i gnas spyi dang khyad par gso ba rig pa la rtsal phul du byung bas/ dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i skabs byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang (ye so/ 1395 1475)gi chodab ma'i mchodag gyur 'cho byed mi'i nyi ma mchodang ba dze na ldan (mtshan gzhan byams pa dkon mchodag rin chen )la gso rig skor gyi don gnad la dri rmed mdzad pa sogs sku tshe der gasku rig gi mdzad don gal che zhig ni/ gso rig rgyud bzhi'i tshig don gnyis ga'i 'khrul char dag sel gyi zhus chen mdzad pa ci tshig wa na gsal ba'i 'grel pa'ang rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen sngo/da shel chen snu/ zhes pa brtsams/ spyir ga1/ rig rgyud bzhi'i bstan 'dzin rim brgyud las byang zur rnam gnyis gtsos gso rig rgyud bzhi'i rtsabar 'grel pa mdzad pa sngo phal snu ches phyi ma phyi mas snga ma snga mas mdzad

15 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig chu gas bsdus bzhugs sku //pa'i rgyud kyi rtsa'agrel la gzhi ba3 la te 'bru ma dag pa dang / chad lhag gab 'khrugs sku gas la zhus chen mdzad sku da snu da/ rim rgyud kyi ma'agrel gang yang gcig las gcig phab shus kyi mdzad thabs las par bamo/ sku/gas kyi mthun rkyen zhan stabs rtsa'agrel snga ma ji bzhin sku/ngas khyab can zhig dka' la/ chad lhag 'khrugs 11gas kyi 'khrul cha 'ga' zhig ni phab bshu sogs kyi rgyud rim nang byung ba sgyu sa med yin/rab byung brgyad pa'i chu bya (ye lo 1453)lor kong stod bla rta phan bde'i yul du 'khrungs pa'i lha rje skyems pa tshe dbang (5)zhes pas rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma/ zur mkhar dharma su mi dang mnyam nyid rdo rje'i bzhes gzhung gtso bzung thog rgyud 'di nyid la zhus chen gnad smin mdzad par ma zad/ mnyam nyid lda je'i dngos slob bla rta lha rje mi dar bkra shis las dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i sprul don brgyud pa bzung ste/ rgyud bzhi'i 'grel pa/ rtsargyud 'grel pa legs bshad smra ba mchodag chodab dang bshad rgyud 'grel pa rnam par bshad pa tshig snga na nyi ma (dgung sob sgor drug pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa khyi ye 'o/ 1478 so/ra brtsams mabo btsugs shing phyi 'o/ sa phag lor yongs su zin/) man rgyud 'grel pa bde ba'i 'dod 'jo/(rab byung dgu pa'i sa 'brug ye so/ 1507 'o/ra brtsams/) phyi rgyud 'grel pa lag len gsal byed (rab byung dgu pa'i lcags lug ye lo 1511 lor bcoms/)bcas mdzad/de yang nyid kyi brtsam pa'i ma'agrel smra ba mchodag cadab las/ yid ches khungs ldan brgyud pa'i 'o/ rgyus las sprul pa the na gyi brgyud pa 'chad pa'i skabs/ snyigs dus kyi sman bla gnyis pa rje zur mkhar bskug sngo/ cesas rje'am dharma sumi'i (mtshan gzhan 'asnu byed grub pa/ kun la byams pa'i chod cadas/ dpa' bos bskyangs/ g.yu lnga ga 'bangs/ mnyam nyid sna rje zhes zhu/)drung nas 'phrin las mthar phyin phrag da1/na

rgyud tshig dodan gnad dga' zhig la dpyad pa / 145bsku da nams bkra shis zhes sgyu ma pa gsum ldan gyi skyes chen skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang 1 des zhus/ de'i drung du bla rta lha rje mi dar bkra shis zhes lugs gnyis kyi rnam dpyod yangs pa des zhus/ de las bdag gis thob ces (6) dang / yang mjug byang las/ rang lugs kyi gatho cad rgyal ba'i bka' dang dpal ldan pha kho la/ kha che zla ba la dga' ba/ rje g.yu thog pa yon tan mgon po/ rje zur mkhar ba dharma sumi rnams kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i khungs btsal/ zhib mo'i blo gros kyis tshig cadan la dpyad/(7) ces pa'i gsungs las mkhas mchodag 'di nyid kyis 'dzin pa'i khungs btsun rgyud kyi gnad dag the gas nus/ ྅rdon te mkhas pa 'dis zhus chen mdzad pa dang rgyud 'grel (skyems 'grel )gyis gzhi 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi rtsab dasngoras de'i dpe rgyun mjal dkon pa ni rgyud 'grel 'di nyid zhib mor mjal ba las rtogs nus/ rab byung bcu pa'i shing khyi lor zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rigs chos kyi dpon po blo gros rgyal po'am legs bshad 'tshol (ye lo 1509 she 1572)du grags pas slar rgyud bzhi'i tshig rtsodan 'khrul lhad 1/gas la zhus chen mdzad de sna ga 'khrul sel ba'i 'grel pa rtsabashad mes wa'i zhal lung (rab byung bcu pa'i chu stas ye so/ 1542sku ra brtsams/)zhes pa brtsams gnang ba'ang / nyid kyi gsung las/de ltar gso rig bstan pa'i rat+na ka /'dam gyis tshul min gyur 'di nyer blangs nas/ /dag pa gsum du byi dor byas yod kyi/ /dngos grub 'awa da kun gsol ba 'debs par gyis// (8) zhes gsungs/me rta ye lo 1546 lor lto kha grwa thang du phebs pa dang der 'jam dbyangs cadan mi sam rje ṭa'i gdung 'dzin pa nang sku/ yar brgyab pas mthun rkyen phul te/ sngar gasku rig rgyud bzhir zhus chen mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhir slar dag ther gyis shing par

116 na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so///du gsar bsgo mdzad pa'ang grwa thang rgyud bzhi zhes khungs btsun gso rig bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur grags/ gasku rig rgyud bzhi'i rtsa'agrel par 'debs kyi rgyud rim nang grwa thang rgyud bzhi ni grags che sna sa zhig dang par grangs mang sna sa khyab che 31sa zhig yin/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu stag ye 'o/ 1662 'o/ra gzhung sa mchodag nas grwa thang rgyud bzhi sku ra bzhag lnga ga par mgasar bsko thengs gcig mdzad/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang grwa thang rgyud bzhir dpyad pas ma khyab pa'i cadar lus kyi lha ga ma phran bu byung ba dag 7mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya masnu ma〉〉ga nas zhus chen mdzad pa dang / nyid kyi gsungs las/ rje bla ma nyid la jo nang kun snying du bka' baspyodan cadar byang zur gnyis bzhed pa mi gcig pa sku gas phebs pa lha rje dkyus ma rnams sngo sman yul babs ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba dang lag len gyi khyad par stod smad phran bu las/ gzhung thodan rim par snga ma'i lam la phyi ma bsten pas mi 'dra ba med pa dang / grwa thang rgyud 'di yang bcos bsgyur gyis sa bcad 'khrug pa tshig chad pa sdudags mang bas ha cang khungs snu da par ma sems (9) zhes dang / grwa thang rgyud bzhir tshig chad pa lha/gas rnying pa rnams mthun par 'dug rigs rang gi rigs pas kyang dpyad de/ dper na sdom tshig tu bshad pa nang gses su ma tshang rigs/nad rtags bshad pa bathodas chad pa/ sa dpyad 'khrug pa sku/gas dang / la la dag 'bru nor gyi rnam pa sogs 'ol spyi rtog bzo min pa'i lung rigs khungs thub kyi sgo nas gtan la phab/ brda rnying bo/ dka' nges rnam gsal du btang ba bcos zhus legs par dag ste par du brkos/(10)zhes gsung ba ltar sde srid nyid dgung grangs so drug la son pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me yos ye lo 1687 lor gso rig rgyud

rgyud tshig wa na gnad dga' zhig la dpyad pa / 147bzhir zhus chen gyis rgyud bzhi'i 'grel pa be+e ḍūr+ya khyodan wa'i mal+li ka zhes pa brtsams pa dang / shing khyi (ye lo 1694)lor dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par brko mdzad pa wa tā la'i par ma'am phun snumags gling par mar grags pa/ da cha rang cag sman pa phal mo ches yid ston rtsa'adzin bya 'os kyi rgyud 'grel bi ḍūr+ya sngon pos gzhi 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi rtsab nyid yin(7mi dbang sangs rgyas masnu ma〉kyig ni rgyud bzhi'i tshig thodan gnyis ma'i char zhus chen mdzad sngo phyi ma de nyid yin/)rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang (ye so/ 1733)lor si tu chodas kyi 'byung gnas kyi dngos chodab sde dge rgyal po'am chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring (ye lo 167871738)nas thugs 'gan bzhes te sngar gyi sngo/ tu la'i par mar gzhi ba3)la te par brko mdzad pa'ang sde dge par mar grags pa de nyid yin cing / par rtsader sngo ta la'i par las 'bru len gyis phyi snu zhus zhes gsal kyang 'di man ni dag zhus tsam las rgyud bzhi ga'i cirgag don gnyis char zhus dag gis rgyud 'grel rtsom palharno sdo/sa chen cisgon snyam/de rjes rab byung bco lnga'i sa byi (ye lo 1888)lor gzhung sa mchog nas sngar gyi po ta la'i par gzhi dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du bzhugs pa de nyid par gzhi gsar bskrun gnang / de'i tshe zhus dag pa gzhan phan cadad zer dang 'tsho byed rdo rje rgyal mtshan gnyis yin/ chu 'brug (ye lo 1892)lor kun mkhyen 7rgyal dbang phyag na pasdu re bla sman pa tse/ rgyan bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / lcags ri'i dge zur dpal ldan phun tshogs/ dbu mdzad dkon mchog dge legs bcas kyis bskyar zhus mdzad cing sho sku ka chad par par shing gsar brje dang / tshig 'byur bcos lhag nor 'khrul yod pa rnams bcos te par du
